    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]During the First World War, France decided to use a special type of small vessel, the Aviso — a heavily armed submarine hunter disguised as a small merchant ship — to fight enemy submarines. The class was named Arras but the lead ship of the class was Amiens, laid down in La Saint-sur-Mer in 1918. This ship is one of the heaviest coastal vessels in the game, with an arsenal of 138.6 mm guns and twin 37 mm autocannon mounts, complemented by a 75 mm universal cannon and small machine guns. 
[/td]
        [td]The development of a new Soviet tank capable of countering German Tigers and Panthers began back in 1943. Despite the start of production in 1944, the T-44 did not take part in any battles during the Second World War, but remained in service with the Soviets until the early ‘70s. The first production vehicles were distinguished by a driver port above the front armor plate and different turret armor. They were armed with a 85 mm D-5T cannon. 
[/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Battle Trophy with Past Vehicles[/h2]
Missed out on previous Battle Pass vehicles? The Battle Trophy has you covered, featuring four vehicles from past Battle Passes or events. Opening this trophy will give you one vehicle from the list. If you have them all, you’ll instead receive Silver Lions and the special “Golden Battles Wager”, allowing you to earn up to 1,000 Golden Eagles.

[h2]Get Silver Lions, Consumables, Premium Account Time and More in the Battle Pass![/h2]
The Battle Pass doesn’t just feature decals, decorations and vehicles, it also contains a lot of other useful items. This includes a large amount of Silver Lions, Warbonds to spend in the Warbond shop, Orders, Wagers and Backups for use in battles, a Test Drive for one of the new vehicles before you get it, 10 days of Premium Account time, unique camouflages for the two new vehicles and a title and loading screen to remember your accomplishments. 

[h2]Get the next Battle Pass for free with Upgrade Coupons![/h2]
Two “Upgrade Coupons” are at levels 105 and 125 in the Battle Pass and are both needed to get the next Battle Pass for free. They also make the two new vehicles tradable on the Gaijin Market if you prefer. 

[quote]To purchase a Battle Pass using the “Upgrade Coupon”, you need to wait until the current season ends and the new season begins. You’ll then be able to exchange two Upgrade Coupons in the Battle Pass purchase window. Upgrade Coupons must be available in your inventory to do this. [/quote]

[h2]The Warbond Shop in Season 19![/h2]
Check out some of the main Warbond shop items in Season 19! You can view the full list of items available as well as the conditions for receiving them in-game.

[quote]The Warbond shop can be accessed by clicking on Shop > Warbond Shop from the hangar or from the Battle Pass window by clicking “Shop”[/quote]

[i][b]What is the Warbond Shop?[/b]
The Warbond shop is connected with and runs in tandem with the Battle Pass. Items in the Warbond shop can be purchased with a currency called Warbonds that are earned in the Battle Pass. There is a total of 6 shop levels and each one can be unlocked by reaching specific levels in the Battle Pass. In addition to purchasing with Warbonds, each item from shop level 3 requires a certain number of medals to purchase. Medals can be obtained through completing Special Tasks. [/i]

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]

[b]MGB-75 (Great Britain)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2c9866f75b92e9a357a9ea630f6f2069f151c825.jpg[/img]
Armed with a potent 40 mm automatic cannon at the front and two 20 mm cannons at the back, the MGB-75 features a great top speed of 78 km/h, allowing it to capture points in good time. It also includes depth charges and 7.72 mm machine guns.

[b]I-153P (USSR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f5814c9e24cae79eff4d698604e925da1bff9b63.jpg[/img]
The I-153P is a small yet deadly biplane, characterized by its outstanding turn time. Armed with two 20 mm ShVAK cannons in the nose for taking out aircraft, it can also fire ROS-82 and RBS-82 rockets and 50 kg bombs for taking out enemy tanks.

[b]M3A3 (1st PTG) (China)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/cd03dfc2eeda009462463002ab643628d5599573.jpg[/img]
During the Second World War, the M3A3 was used under a Chinese-American lend-lease program. A fast light tank, the M3A3 features a 37 mm cannon that can fire AP and APCBC shells. It’s lightly armored and can utilize its speed and shoulder-stop stabilizer to its advantage.

[b]USS Moffett (USA)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0b302b66beafbfdada54af3ee59fc4b4f8bc125a.jpg[/img]
USS Moffett features four turrets housing 5 inch cannons with an excellent rate of fire. Also armed with air defensive capabilities, USS Moffett features a top speed of 69 km/h and has its main ammo storage below the waterline.

[b]Hs 129 B-2 (Romania) (Italy)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8b702f572a32ff63146dba26a04d82d85401a454.jpg[/img]
Romania was one of the primary operators of the Hs 129 B-2 during the Second World War. This aircraft is unusual in that it features a 37 mm BK cannon, excellent for taking out enemy tanks (or planes!) if you can score a hit. It can also swap out this cannon for a 30 mm MK 103 instead, and also comes with 20 mm cannons and four 50 kg bombs.

[b]KW II 754 (r) (Germany)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/59c2ca1ab1ce1fb8ae76fb4a4af0b3e1bdc81271.jpg[/img]
During the Second World War, Germany captured some KV-2s and used them in combat. Its devastating 152 mm cannon can take out any enemy at its rank using SAPCBC or HE shells. Make sure to find somewhere to hide once firing, as its reload speed is upwards of 43 seconds!

[h2]Decals[/h2]
Season 19 returns some decals from the 2018 Warbond shop, plus the new Oni decal, continuing this themed series!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6ab4cf8badb13eca04b9ce75b6f176dcec0f586d.png[/img]
[b]“Oni”[/b] pinup decal

[h2]Trophies[/h2]
Like decorating your ground vehicles? Then check out the Camouflage trophy, featuring several camouflages for your vehicles! Prefer making your player profile unique? Open the profile icon trophy to get yourself a USA tanker! 

[h2]Consumables[/h2]
Alongside trophies, vehicles and decals are a bunch of useful consumable items, including boosters, universal backups, wagers & orders, premium vehicle rentals and talismans — all perfect for helping you through the game.

[b]Get out there and get yourself some goodies![/b]

notes.title: Eye in the Sky: Meteor FR Mk.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c21ce2abb1451eff9f7395fc307126db5a1254d2.jpg[/img]

Today we’ll be taking a look at the main reward in the Eye in the Sky vehicle event that started today: the Israeli Meteor FR Mk.9!

[h2][b]Meteor FR Mk.9:[/b] An Event Vehicle Jet Fighter for Israel at Rank V[/h2]
At a glance:
[list]
[*] Four 20 mm cannons.
[*] Large ammunition capacity.
[*] Good rate of climb.
[*] Ability to fire rockets.
[/list]
[b]Vehicle History[/b]

The Meteor FR.9 modification was developed on the basis of the Meteor F.8 as a fighter-reconnaissance aircraft, where the nose could accommodate camera equipment. In the mid-50s, this aircraft modification began to be withdrawn from Royal Air Force service, causing Great Britain to sell some of the old aircraft to the Israeli Air Force. Almost all of the aircraft Israel received were converted into fighters, and their camera equipment was dismantled. In 1955, the Meteor FR Mk.9 became the first jet aircraft in the Israeli Air Force to achieve an aerial victory when it shot down two Egyptian Vampire fighters.

In the 1960s, the Meteor FR Mk.9 began to be used in secondary roles and was completely withdrawn from operational service soon after. They were listed as part of the Israeli Air Force in some capacity until 1970.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a0a7b5d3c1cad4f8616513b6359f0f9f13edf0c2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introducing the Meteor FR Mk.9![/h2]

The Israeli Air Force Meteor FR Mk.9 is a compact jet fighter distinguished by powerful 20 mm cannons, good acceleration and the ability to carry rockets. This jet aircraft, along with decals and decorations can be obtained in the Eye in the Sky aircraft event that started today — check it out in the link below! Let’s take a closer look at what this aircraft has to offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/553ba95fe5bb4a8a59cd7aaa87fb19f01c0f73bb.jpg[/img]

There are many Meteor variants, but what is this one exactly? The Meteor FR Mk.9 is a reconnaissance modification and a direct relative of the well-known Meteor F.8. It was originally intended to carry camera equipment in the nose, but was mostly used as a fighter jet in Israeli Air Force service instead. Those of you who have played the Meteors in the British or Israel tree will appreciate their good acceleration and cannons with a high ammunition count — and you’ll be happy to know that the Meteor FR Mk.9 retains all these key features!

[b]Did you know?[/b] The Meteor FR Mk.9 was Israel’s first jet to get an aerial victory when it shot down an Egyptian Vampire in 1955.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3599ac3334d88c2f903e9a2fc7efc0d05ddfab0c.jpg[/img]

In battles against other early jet aircraft, the Meteor FR Mk.9 can gain altitude faster than many contemporary opponents and attack in a dive when teams meet at the front line in air battles. The Meteor doesn’t like sharp maneuvers, so in order to conserve energy, be sure to climb back to altitude again after an attack without entering into a turn fight.

As for weaponry, the Meteor FR Mk.9 includes the traditional Meteor gun layout and arrangement of four 20 mm Hispano cannons in the nose with a large ammunition capacity of 780 rounds. While it is more of a fighter than a CAS aircraft, the rockets and cannons can make for a cheap but effective spawn in combined battles. Aside from the rockets, the cannons have quite high penetration, a max of 36 mm! From the top down, these cannons can rip through the engine deck of many ground vehicles and the maneuverability of the Meteor lets it operate well in this environment, so even clean-wing it offers versatility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/98e361e34f14e1053aab2508928f314770226307.jpg[/img]

That’s it for this blog! The Israeli Meteor FR Mk.9 is a competitive early jet aircraft that can be obtained in the Eye of the Sky aircraft event that started today. For some, this jet will be their first aircraft in the Israel tree, for some an addition to their ground forces lineup, and for others the first jet aircraft they ever obtain!

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

	[*][b]F/A-18C Early[/b] — a bug where target acquisition of any target by the targeting pod prevented seeker activation of AIM-7P missiles has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/lTUjg41vyAoR][b]Report[/b][/url]).[/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]Ground Vehicles[/b][/h2]
[list]
	[*]A bug that led to desynchronization of the position of moving ground vehicles has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/xlpk7N3wROvv][b]Report[/b][/url]).[/*]
	[*]The following changes will, among other things, result in the sound on ground vehicles becoming more consistent, stable and predictable overall, in particular, it should no longer be the case that ground vehicles at distances of up to 215 meters, which are behind obstacles, do not make engine and track sounds:
	[list]
		[*]The principle of absolute detection of enemies in ground vehicles has been changed. The "absolute detection" parameter no longer depends on the level of the vehicle crew's "Keen Vision" skill and is equal to the value that was previously the maximum for a fully upgraded “Ace” crew — 215 meters (for vehicles with the "Improved Optics" modification, this parameter is 280 meters). This parameter is responsible for the range at which information about enemy vehicles is transmitted by the server to the client, regardless of whether the player sees the vehicle or whether the terrain or objects in the location interfere with this. The change has been made for transparency — despite the fact that the parameter was described in the crew's “Keen Vision” parameters, its presence, its impact on the game, and connection with sound in cases where the vehicle is out of direct line of sight were not obvious.[/*]
		[*]A bug where the sound of the engine and tracks of a scouted target might sound from greater distances than the engine and tracks of a target detected in other ways has been fixed.[/*]
		[*]The theoretical radius of audibility of the engine and tracks of ground vehicles has been reduced from 400 to 215 meters. In fact, this did not noticeably affect audibility in combat since previously, due to volume settings, vehicles further than 215 meters could only be heard in ideal conditions (in silence) along the line of sight, while behind obstacles, vehicles could be heard at a distance of more than 215 meters only due to a bug with the increased range of sound playback for scouted targets.[/*]

		[*]The ranges of the sounds of gun shots have not undergone any changes and are still always reproduced if the shot occurred within a radius of 2 kilometers.[/*]
		[*]A bug where enemy engine sound could disappear behind obstacles, leaving only the sound of the tracks, has been fixed.[/*]
	[/list]

notes.title: Celebrating International Day of Human Space Flight with a Decal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/64bae79e6d4e37b98d146ecc3a31eac831dfa2e1.jpg[/img]

April 12th, 1961 was a historical date. On this day, humans made the first space flight. In honor of Yuri Gagarin’s flight, April 12th was already established as Cosmonautics Day in the USSR in 1961, and in 2011 the UN called for this date to be celebrated as International Day of Human Space flight. 

[h2]Get the “Cosmonautics Day 2025” decal![/h2]
You can get this themed decal for this day!

[b]When:[/b] From April 11th (10:00 GMT) until April 14th (10:00 GMT).
[b]Task:[/b] Play 3 battles using USSR aircraft at rank III or higher to receive the “Cosmonautics Day 2025” decal!

[b]Additional details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, and [Assault] mode.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Aviation and Cosmonautics Day.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the customization menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7c853e4840bfaf86d3adfdfd20c1d4804b48603e.png[/img]
[b]“Cosmonautics Day 2025”[/b] decal

notes.title: Get the Meteor FR Mk.9 in the Eye in the Sky Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/80676762a6fef13d8af68b3a6984bfca852b45ff.jpg[/img]

Vehicles from many countries have been in the spotlight for our events, and now it’s Israel’s turn! For playing in air battles, you can get the Israeli Meteor FR Mk.9 jet fighter as well as themed decals and other rewards.

[quote][h3]From April 16th (11:00 GMT) until April 30th (11:00 GMT), earn mission points in Air Battles, unlock stages and receive rewards![/h3][/quote]

[h2]Meteor FR Mk.9 — An Event Vehicle Jet Fighter for Israel at Rank V[/h2]
British Meteor FR Mk.9 reconnaissance fighters were supplied to Israel in the mid-1950s. This aircraft became the first jet fighter in the Israeli Air Force to achieve an aerial victory. In the game, this jet is a good early fighter with powerful guns, a good rate of climb and the ability to carry rockets. 

The Meteor FR Mk.9 is a modification of the famous Meteor and will be of interest to collectors and those who have just started to get acquainted with jet fighters. You can get this aircraft without having to research any of the Israeli Aviation tree.

The conditions for obtaining the Meteor FR Mk.9 during this event have been adjusted to balance the difficulty of obtaining and the value of the reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/177a74367749f9527f5918ac866ade9c4b164552.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Emblem of the 122nd Squadron”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Emblem of the 192nd Squadron”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Emblem of the Nevatim Airbase”[/b] decal[/td] 
    [/tr]
[/table]

Among the rewards in the event is also this chest. When opened, there is a chance to receive one of the following items:
[list]
[*] 50,000 - 100,000 Silver Lions
[*] Silver Lion and Research Point boosters
[*] Random Wagers and Orders
[*] Universal Backups (1 - 3) 
[*] A random camouflage for a vehicle you own
[*] 1 day of Premium Account
[/list]

[h2]How to get all rewards[/h2]
Each stage is unlocked for [b]30,000[/b] mission points and brings a new reward.

[quote][b]Please note:[/b] Once the stage is unlocked, you will need to claim your reward manually. To do this, click on your profile, select the Eye in the Sky category, and click Claim Prize.[/quote]

You’re able to earn mission points in [b]Air Battles[/b] at Rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic and Simulator Battles. The number of mission points to complete a stage depends on the game mode and the maximum Rank of the vehicle that you use in battle. There’s a multiplier for earning mission points, which is shown in the task description in-game.

You can also earn mission points by using event vehicles that are Rank I and II. Event vehicles that can be used have the name of the event that they were obtainable in on their stat card.

[quote][h3]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT: April 18th, 20th, 22nd, 24th, 26th, and 28th.[/h3][/quote]

[h2]Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] For [b]1[/b] Stage: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]2[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]3[/b] Stages: the “Infantry Backpack” silver chest
[*] For [b]4[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]5[/b] Stages: the “Infantry Backpack” silver chest
[*] For [b]6[/b] Stages: “Emblem of the Nevatim Airbase” decal 
[*] For [b]7[/b] Stages: a non-tradable coupon for the Meteor FR Mk.9
[/list]

[h3]Discounts on purchasing stages using Golden Eagles[/h3]
Incomplete stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but if you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will now be significantly reduced.

Let’s say you have earned 85% of the required mission points to complete a stage, then the price of purchasing this stage will be halved. If you’re near the finish line for a stage and are at 95% progress, then the price will be reduced by five times. For example, if you’ve earned 26,000 mission points, then the price for unlocking this stage will be 499 Golden Eagles. If you’ve earned 29,000 mission points, then you’ll only need to pay 199 Golden Eagles. Remember to keep this in mind if you cannot complete a stage on time!

[h3]The Upgrade for coupon [/h3]
When you complete 7 stages, you’ll receive a non-tradable coupon for the Meteor FR Mk.9 where using it will immediately activate the vehicle onto your account. If you don’t want the vehicle and would like to sell the coupon on the Market, you’ll need the “Upgrade for coupon” item.

[quote]The “Upgrade for coupon” item can be earned in parallel with the stages throughout the event from April 16th (11:00 GMT ) until April 30th (11:00 GMT) for 550,000 mission points.
[/quote]

After receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” item, you can convert a non-tradable coupon for the vehicle into a tradable one and sell it on the Market. The tradable coupon can be sold after 5 days from the moment it’s created.

The “Upgrade for coupon” item is valid until May 3rd (11:00 GMT). Until this time, you can use it or exchange it for War Bonds. Afterwards, it’ll disappear from your inventory.

[quote]To make a tradable coupon, select the “Coupon Meteor FR Mk.9 (Israel)” in your inventory and click the “Modify” button.[/quote]

You can track the progress of completing stages and receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” by clicking on your Nickname > Achievements > Eye in the Sky. If you don’t manage to complete a stage on time or would like to purchase a stage, until May 5th from the Achievements window, you can purchase each stage with Golden Eagles which will give you the corresponding rewards.

tags.balance_change:
The Meteor FR Mk.9 is a modification of the famous Meteor and will be of interest to collectors and those who have just started to get acquainted with jet fighters. You can get this aircraft without having to research any of the Israeli Aviation tree.

The conditions for obtaining the Meteor FR Mk.9 during this event have been adjusted to balance the difficulty of obtaining and the value of the reward.
Incomplete stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but if you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will now be significantly reduced.

notes.title: Ray Tracing Keeps Improving!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/129a931320dbd4eded8f60ea299147a4563bfeb9.jpg[/img]

This article goes over some points from the VFX team about the improvements made to Ray Tracing technologies in the Hornet’s Sting update.

As promised at the end of last year, work on making Ray Tracing better doesn’t stop! First up, Ray Tracing is now enabled on all PCs, regardless of GPU Vendor. AMD Radeon and Intel Arc users can now enjoy all RT features. We’re still working to make RT available on Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 consoles.

By making several changes in the code, we’ve significantly improved RT performance.
[list]
[*] We have reworked the way rays go through foliage, which helps when going through a forest.
[*] We have updated the denoiser we use to process the RT results. The new version has a bigger improvement in speed, while maintaining the same quality.
[*] We have a new Shadow Quality setting. This is a big one. Low allows us to shoot half as many rays as before, while medium is contextual, but usually removes 30-50% of the rays in fully lighted or shadowed areas. This is a serious improvement, and you should be aware that even on the Low setting, the difference from the High setting is very small if you are using one of the advanced Temporal anti-aliasing methods, like TSR, DLSS, XeSS of FSR. They are for sure more demanding than less advanced methods, but surpass them in image quality in both native resolution and when doing upscaling. The Low setting is also less prone to performance drops in heavily loaded scenes.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=l2mFtV3lRUg;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t see much of a difference? Exactly. And as said before, Low demands two times less resources than High (which was used before the update).

All of these improvements can result in an overall 20-25% reduction of the GPU cost of the RT effects.

We’ve worked on the windows of buildings with Ray Tracing enabled. At launch they were way too mirror-like, but after some love they now look much more natural and physically correct.

[b]Windows before vs after[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/426d77bd728df65884aa3a03a1c700ada6473fc4.gif[/img]

We’ve also identified several code paths where RT became unstable, which lead to GPU or even game crashes. These are now greatly reduced, and RT is much more stable now.

That’s it for now! We’ve got even more great improvements ahead, so stay tuned.

notes.title: It’s fixed! №103
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0b8de70d2f5630c223d006ac83bd61ec53a2a8fd.jpg[/img]

Today, we’ve rounded up and will be going over some of the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past few weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check out [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]the changelog section on our website[/url].

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Non-Exploding Ammo Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/606a001c050e8f969118d7daaa3254db3904ce8f.jpg[/img]
You know how in action movies, cars usually blow up for any reason after a collision, even when there is nothing that could cause them to explode? Tanks definitely have ammunition that can explode, however due to a bug the ammunition, that wasn’t protected or inert, in some vehicles sometimes failed to explode or ignite when it was completely destroyed. 

Ammunition not exploding once it was completely destroyed has been fixed for the following vehicles: T20, M4A4 (SA50), P.7.T (AA), Lorraine 37L, Flakpanzer 38, Flakpanzer I, Kugelblitz, Wirbelwind, Zerstorer 45, Panzerjager I, Sd.Kfz.140/1, Pz.II F, Sd.Kfz.221 (s.Pz.B.41), Pvkv III, Pvlvv fm/42, AEC AA, M2A2, GAZ-MM (72-K), T-60, ZiS-12 (94-KM) and any variant of the M51.

[h2]Camouflage Fixes [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a09e0a2d10ec13c06390631db4ab57a2069bf180.jpg[/img]
Recently, a bug was discovered in the game that affected camouflages, in particular Market and custom ones. This bug caused camouflages to look excessively battle-scarred despite the settings and in some cases they were displayed completely incorrectly. This bug has now been fixed, so you can enjoy the beauty of your camouflages again! 

[h2]Ray Tracing and Graphical Adjustments[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/129a931320dbd4eded8f60ea299147a4563bfeb9.jpg[/img]
Ray Tracing was added to War Thunder quite recently, and we continue to work to ensure that this technology is implemented as fully and correctly as possible. In particular, we’ve fixed all inaccuracies and roughness associated with it. For example, players using Ray Tracing would notice yellow highlights on the walls of buildings, and bright pink flashes on glass when they fired, as if they were shooting some kind of laser instead of regular ammo. We’ve fixed these issues now, as well as another one not related to Ray Tracing, where objects could sometimes flicker just after they were destroyed. 

[h2]Radar Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8e2e4f3e3447b55d61e9dd8fddd5e5ddee43ac86.jpg[/img]
Several radar-related issues have also been fixed and tweaks have been made in recent weeks. For example, the maximum radial speeds of targets have been increased for search and track modes of aircraft pulse-Doppler radars, allowing for the detection and acquisition of, for example, missiles flying towards the radar carrier. It’s useful to know where exactly the threat is coming from!

Here are some other radar bug fixes: Firstly, a bug where it was impossible to move the radar scanning area horizontally or vertically in the track-while-scan mode. Secondly, a number of bugs with the radar getting stuck in memory tracking modes after dropping the target track. Thirdly, the Kopyo-25 radar on the Su-39 no longer locks onto “empty space” when trying to lock on ground targets. And lastly, there was a lack of indication of the player’s own ARH air-to-air missiles on the radar indicator for all AN/APG-65Q radar carriers.
 
[h2]Sighting Enemy Vehicles from the Cockpit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/64ef6845a125e7a5eed048fca4899c3b0924c512.jpg[/img]
A bug was discovered on a number of Soviet aircraft (Su-25, Su-25K, Su-17M2, Su-17M4, Su-22M3, MiG-21S). When looking at a target from the cockpit through the sight glass and through the cockpit glazing, vehicles were displayed at different distances. For example, it was possible to spot an enemy somewhere off to the side, start to approach it to aim, and see nothing through the sight glass as vehicles were displayed at a much shorter distance. 

This bug has now been fixed. Vehicles will display correctly at the same distances, regardless of which part of the cockpit you see them through.

[h2]That’s not all[/h2]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in separate update notes. For example, vehicles no longer appear wet, spectators in Air Realistic  Battles can see allies and enemies again, and bugs in the new weapon stat cards have been fixed.

Today's Update 2.45.1.40:

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused a reduced radius of fragment dispersion for aircraft bombs with a large amount of explosives (more than 100 kg) with a low fill factor (less than 30% of the mass of the munition) has been fixed. For example, this has affected the GBU-27, PC 1400 X (Fritz X), KAB-500Kr, UPAB-1500B, etc. 
[*] [b]Brimstone (SAL)[/b] — maximum launch angle has been increased from 11° to 40°. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Qza4jKAVUH0x]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Su-39[/b] — a bug when Kopyo-25 radar was acquiring “empty space” has been fixed.
[*] A bug that sometimes caused radar to get stuck in TRK MEM mode when trying to drop the target tracking has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the radar mode name in GMTI mode to not change from ACQ GMTI to TRK GMTI when tracking targets has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the radar to get stuck in MEM mode after a target track has been dropped in GMTI mode and then in any of the AA modes has been fixed.
[*] [b]AN/APG-65Q[/b] — a bug that caused the number of available datalink channels to not display in the X-ray has been fixed.
[*] [b]AN/APG-65Q[/b] — a bug that caused the player’s launched ARH missiles to not display on the radar indicator has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/vJi9ZBqKjlwF]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]AM-1[/b] — a bug where parts of the air brake remained floating in the air when the flaps were torn off has been fixed.
[*] [b]F/A-18A[/b] — a bug where text keys were displayed on the HUD in the cockpit when selecting AIM-7M missiles, Mk 83 or Mk 83 AIR bombs, Mk 77 incendiary bombs and Zuni rockets has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/4ccp4HrTycLQ]Report[/url], [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/1hkK56RyAII1]Report[/url]). 
[*] [b]Su-30SM[/b] — a bug where the incorrect pylon was used for the T220 targeting pod, causing them to intersect has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/3JUBorjtgjKy]Report[/url]). 
[*] [b]Su-30SM[/b] — a bug that caused the missile lead and NCTR indicators to be missing from the HUD in Simulator Battles has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/QmmV3OV8iKgt]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Su-30SM[/b] — the thermal imaging resolution in the Kh-38MT missile camera that was different from the same missile resolution onthe  Su-34 and Su-25SM3 has been corrected.
[*] [b]F-15I Ra’am[/b] — a bug where it was impossible to turn on the thermal imager in the AGM-65D missile camera has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Rx9PMjTAlN4e]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]P-51D-20-NA (Israel)[/b] — erroneously increased machine gun recoil has been reduced. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/RNfCm27gHaX9]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Do 217 E-2, Do 217 E-4, Do 217 K-1, Do 217 M-1[/b] — when torpedoes are being used, a restriction on releasing the flaps to the “landing” position has been added. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/YY0WTRduLFmz]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Tornado (all variants)[/b] — a bug where it was possible to continue using countermeasures even when the wing that had the countermeasure pod was torn off has been fixed.
[*] [b]F-104C[/b] — display of the missing RWR sensors has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/q0YjmGl8qAgc]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]F8F-1 (all variants)[/b] — a bug that caused a sharp loss of rudder efficiency at high speeds has been fixed.
[*] [b]Ki-43-III (all variants)[/b] — fuel tanks have been made self-sealing. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/JyvXN0zdExaX]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]30 mm Ho-155, Type 5 cannons[/b] — the incorrectly underestimated sensitivity of the HEF shell fuse has been increased (the threshold has been reduced from 0.8 mm to 0.1 mm). This issue could cause them to penetrate aircraft without exploding.
[/list]
[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Rapier[/b] — a bug that caused the missile warhead to deal too little damage has been fixed. We’d like to note that the mass of explosives in the Rapier missiles is significantly lower than in other SACLOS missiles, therefore Rapier missiles still deal less damage than other missiles of similar calibers. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/iwyduClXEx3s]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Churchill NA75[/b] — the number of smoke grenades has been increased to 30. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/gyYcBzevQem8]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]KV-1 (L-11)[/b] — the material of the skirts has been changed from rolled homogeneous armor to structural steel. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/cpWFdV6TjZ8R]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]2S19, 2S19M1[/b] — thickness and material of armored boxes on the skirts have been corrected. Material has been changed from 4 mm thick structural steel to 10 mm thick armored steel.
[*] [b]R3 T106 FA, FIROS 6[/b] — test drive has been replaced with the more modern one.
[*] [b]90 mm smoke shell M313[/b] — a bug where instead of the smoke screen radius an explosive mass was shown in the header of the shell card has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug where the replay progress and fast forward markers were not displayed on the timeline when viewing a replay from the debreifing window has been fixed.
[*] A bug where the option to call in an artillery strike would not appear in the gamepad radial menu has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/wiKGchG0AxNq]Report[/url]).
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.gaijin.net%2Fissues%2Fp%2Fwarthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

notes.title: Moments of Valor: Philippines
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/613129b9971987b5fec673a930506d543722e1ac.jpg[/img]

April 9th is traditionally observed in the Philippines as a national memorial day known as Araw ng Kagitingan (Day of Valor). This day commemorates the fall of the Bataan Peninsula to Japanese forces in 1942. For nearly four months, the defenders of the peninsula held off enemy attacks despite being starved, short of ammunition and low on manpower. For Filipinos, their feat is a shining symbol of valor and selflessness. 

[previewyoutube=FDWpx3n1gxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In honor of this day, we’ve prepared a special video from the Moments of Valor series, as well as an exclusive bundle with premium vehicles and unique camouflages created by the War Thunder Live community. This bundle is available at a 50% discount in the Gaijin store until April 16th (6:00 GMT). Vehicle owners can purchase camouflages separately for Golden Eagles. 

[b]During the same time period, the F-86F-35 Sabre Skyblazers and Stuart VI (5th CAD) are available to purchase for Golden Eagles on all platforms.[/b]

[quote]To get to the Gaijin Store through Steam, go to the in-game hangar > Shop > Online Store.[/quote]

[h2]Moments of Valor: Philippines Bundle -50%[/h2]
[strike]1̶2̶5[/strike] 62.49
[list]
[*] Sabre Skyblazers Pack + Philippine Air Force Sabre “468” camouflage by RenaiCirculation
[*] F-5C Pack + Philippine Air Force Blue Diamonds Aerobatic Team camouflage by Wilk28

notes.title: War Thunder Esports in 2025: The Beginning Of A New Era
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5613730792a8e4d6bce5a766de53f2fcdf7c94c2.jpg[/img]

Today, we’re excited to announce the start of a new page in history for War Thunder Esports with the arrival of a professional league! April 2025 marks the start of the [b]War Thunder Championships Series [/b](WTCS), a league comprising four major events throughout 2025. 

In this news, we’ll be explaining how this league will work, how you can take part, and the schedule of events! 

Welcome to a new competitive era. #WTCS!

[h2]Plans For This Year[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/473cbd8a4bc94b1a9e7058c6d97d1903ad9e89c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Major Events Explained[/h2]
All major events have a duration of 8 days, split into 3 stages, including 4 days of Open Qualifiers, 3 days of Play Offs and 1 day of for the Final. All tournaments will be in a double-elimination format.

[h3]Open Qualifier[/h3]
Each major event will be preceded by 2 weekends of Open Qualifiers (four days), allowing anyone to create a team and qualify for the rest of the competition.

The top four teams in each Open Qualifier will book their place in the Play Off phases of the major event.

As soon as a team passes the Open Qualifier phases, it will automatically score points for them.

[h3]Major I: Titan 5v5 [Bo5][/h3]
The first major of the year takes place in a 5v5 mixed format. We want to challenge the versatility of players in this competition, as they’ll be made to play tanks and planes in the same battle.

[h3]Major II: Armored Apex 4v4 [Bo5][/h3]
The second major takes place in a 4v4 format with top tier tanks on a wide variety of maps. This major is made for armor lovers who combine strategy and patience.

[h3]Major III: Air Superiority 4v4 [Bo7][/h3]
The best pilots are invited to compete in a 4v4 jet format for this third major of the year, featuring unusual maps and the latest generation aircraft.

During these 3 majors, the line-ups will showcase the latest vehicles added to the game.

[h3]Grand Final: Thunder Cup[/h3]
Thunder Cup is considered to be War Thunder’s most legendary tournament. It brings together all the major formats in a single competition. In other words, during the 3 weekends of Thunder Cup, you’ll have the chance to play in tanks, planes and mixed to find the best team of this first season of the WTCS.

[h3]How do I take part in the WTCS?[/h3]
To participate in this league, you’ll need to build a roster of 8 players.

One week before the start of the Open Qualifier, there will be an announcement allowing you to create your team on our tournament platform: TSS (link)

If your team manages to qualify during the Open Qualifier, the announced roster must be the same for the play-off phases. No player changes will be possible.

As soon as a team starts to score points for the whole season, its roster will be locked. However, the team will have the option to change 2 players between each major event, and must inform the organization accordingly.

[quote][b]Note:[/b] The roster lock does not apply to non-qualified teams. You must pass the Qualification stage in any Major of the year.[/quote]

The 8 finalist teams who accumulate the most Thunder points during the season will qualify for the Thunder Cup Grand Final, in November 2025. The 8 finalist teams will be made up of a roster of 9 players. 

To be eligible for the final roster, each player must have participated in at least one major event during the season, regardless of ranking.

At the end of the “Air Superiority” major event in September, the final qualifying teams will be asked to provide a full list of 9 players for the Thunder CUP Grand Final.

[h3]How do I score Thunder Points?[/h3]
The main way to earn points is directly linked to the overall ranking of each major. In fact, the higher a team is ranked in a major, the more points they will earn. As an indication, here is the number of points related to placements:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d7c9edd8c57f9d4a19606442c857e4d2093dab12.jpg[/img]

If two or more teams finish with the same total Thunder Points after all tournaments, the following tie-breaking criteria will be applied in order:
[list]
[*] Results of head-to-head matches between tied teams in all tournaments.
[*] Number of dominant wins (3-0 matches).
[/list]
The same point system will be applied in the Thunder Cup Grand Final.

Winning is important, but how you win now matters even more. The new system introduces additional points based on match results to reward dominant victories and penalize heavy losses.
[list]
[*] A 3-0 sweep will now grant +3 extra points, while a 0-3 defeat will deduct 3 points.
[*] Close wins (3-2) provide +1 point, while narrow losses (2-3) result in a -1 point.
[/list]

This system ensures that teams pushing for decisive victories will gain an edge, making every round count.

[h3]Rewards and Cash Prizes[/h3]
Prizes for each event will be announced in advance for each Major. Prizes include a total of over 400,000 Golden Eagles distributed at each major event, exclusive Esports skins of the WTCS series, some unique and rare titles and vehicle coupons linked to each major event. Thanks to our sponsors, you’ll  also have the opportunity to win unique War Thunder branded material prizes during the year!

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] For logistical reasons, we are only able to deliver prizes to the following countries and territories:
[i]UNITED KINGDOM, BULGARIA, POLAND, ROMANIA, FRANCE, SPAIN, GERMANY, LUXEMBOURG, NETHERLANDS, DENMARK, BELGIUM, PORTUGAL, FINLAND, ITALY, SWEDEN, CYPRUS, UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, NORWAY, CANADA, CROATIA, SLOVAKIA, IRELAND, AUSTRIA, CZECH REPUBLIC, HUNGARY, SWITZERLAND, SINGAPORE, AUSTRALIA, LATVIA, GREECE, LITHUANIA, ESTONIA, MALTA, BRAZIL, SOUTH AFRICA, MEXICO, SLOVENIA, HONDURAS, TURKEY, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, NEW ZEALAND, LEBANON, ARGENTINA, JAPAN, BOSNIA-HERZEGOVINA, PHILIPPINES, SERBIA, ISRAEL, MOROCCO, UKRAINE, INDONESIA, ARMENIA, CHINA, KAZAKHSTAN, ANTIGUA AND BARBUDA, PUERTO RICO, KUWAIT, REPUBLIC OF KOREA, ICELAND, INDIA, VIETNAM, ANGUILLA, SAUDI ARABIA, ANDORRA, REUNION, MARTINIQUE, MALAYSIA, CHILE, THAILAND, NORTHERN IRELAND, GIBRALTAR, JORDAN, MACEDONIA, TUNISIA.[/i]

notes.title: War Thunder: The Great War!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c39e82c02cc52273c67765905400490dc7681533.jpg[/img]
Wallpapers: [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Other/1920x1080_the_great_war_logo_744d091f4fabee1cd8aa1d6facc9c04f.jpg]1920x1080[/url], [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Other/2560x1440_the_great_war_logo_a76223116a55ca14aa44e54ba5fb09d2.jpg]2560x1440[/url], [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Other/3840x2160_the_great_war_logo_685b3f08d7154ec30b98f4a61969cb15.jpg]3840x2160[/url]

[i]“The situation is getting worse by the day. In the morning we were under heavy bombardment, and in the evening we got bitten by large rats in the trenches. We were ordered to go over top into no man’s land, where many of my friends were gunned down. I couldn’t believe my eyes. I have heard we lost 50 men in a mere few minutes. We are sacrificing so many for just a few feet of land, if that. The war has been raging for 4 years now, and today I saw the latest armored behemoth modifications roll forward and planes fly over and thought to myself: surely the end is in sight — I feel I am close to coming home to you now.” – letter from an Unknown Soldier, KIA, 1918.[/i]

[h2]Welcome to The Great War in War Thunder![/h2]

[quote][b]When:[/b] From April 1st until April 7th (11:00 GMT), play in “The Great War” mode and complete stages to get and keep First World War vehicles![/quote]

The year is 1918. The war between the Entente and Central Powers is raging on in its final year. Soldiers fight on, tanks have made their debut on the battlefield, and planes dogfight in the sky. You have been enlisted to fight for your country. Gear up, new conscript! 

This event takes you back to the brutal battlefields of the Western Front in Flanders during the First World War. Command the first tanks to have ever gone into combat and dogfight in the skies with aircraft, or immerse yourself by piloting a Zeppelin airship, capable of bombing enemy targets. An event like this wouldn’t be complete without AI infantry, who roam around the trenches and in no man’s land at the front line. 

[b]Brief history of the First World War[/b]
[i]The First World War, also known as The Great War, was a conflict that lasted from July 28th, 1914 to November 11th, 1918 between the Entente and Central Powers. Known as one of, if not the bloodiest wars in history, the war was fought in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Pacific and more. 

Some of the main European battles happened in Belgium and France through trench warfare, which were some of the most gruesome places for a soldier to fight in. This war also saw the first combat use of tanks, in particular the British Mk I Male, during the Battle of the Somme. The first major use of aircraft in combat also happened during the First World War. 

The armistice was signed on November 11th, 1918 at the eleventh hour, marking the end of the war after nearly 5 years. Over 9 million soldiers had been killed. [/i]


[previewyoutube=ka-WF2LcG6U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Play in the event & complete stages to keep some iconic First World War vehicles![/h2]

You have the opportunity to complete stages and earn yourself some iconic First World War tanks and a bomber aircraft. These are added to your tech tree after you obtain them, meaning you can keep and use them in regular battles, even after the event ends!

This event features a special difficulty mode where the mobility of the tanks has been improved relative to their real characteristics. The tanks that can be obtained in this event will have their historical speed and maneuverability when using them in regular Ground Realistic Battles. 

[quote]You can get mission points in the “The Great War” event using the Triple Entente and German Empire. Access the event through [b]Events and Tournaments -> Historical Events -> The Great War.[/b] [/quote]

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
The Triple Entente and German Empire have six stages each. One stage per side can be completed each day. To get all of the vehicles, complete 5 stages for each side!
Each stage for each side will be unlocked for [b]5,000[/b] mission points and will bring a new reward.

[quote]Stages change once a day at 11:00 GMT: April 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th.[/quote]

While the fighters are not obtainable in this event, in the future you’ll be able to try them in our VR game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2754090/Aces_of_Thunder/]Aces of Thunder[/url]!

In addition to the rewards below, you can play at least one battle with an activity of 70% or higher to get the “The Great War” loading screen!

[h2]Triple Entente[/h2]
Obtainable vehicles:
[list]
[*] [b]Mark V[/b] — an Event Vehicle Medium tank for Great Britain at Rank I
[*] [b]St-Chamond[/b] — an Event Vehicle Medium tank for France at Rank I
[*] [b]Garford[/b] — an Event Vehicle Light tank for the USSR at Rank I
[*] [b]H.P.12[/b] — an Event Vehicle Bomber for Great Britain at Rank I
[/list]

Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages:
[list]
[*] For 1 Stage: Random Triple Entente vehicle from the list 
[*] For 2 Stages: [b]“Stormbreaker”[/b] decal
[*] For 3 Stages: Random Triple Entente vehicle from the list 
[*] For 4 Stages: Random Triple Entente vehicle from the list 
[*] For 5 Stages: Random Triple Entente vehicle from the list 
[*] For 6 Stages: [b]“Great War Veteran”[/b] title
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/86062d6bf548c2401b03dda489816c5f6a57a63b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b4dcdb7a4908f97619d752e97ce8bd6f3975dd72.png[/img][/url]
[b]“Stormbreaker”[/b] decal 

[h2]German Empire[/h2]
Obtainable vehicles:
[list]
[*] [b]A7V[/b] — an Event Vehicle Medium tank for Germany at Rank I
[*] [b]Beutepanzer Mk.IV[/b] — an Event Vehicle Medium tank for Germany at Rank I
[*] [b]Garford-Beute[/b] — an Event Vehicle Light tank for Germany at Rank I
[/list]

Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages:
[list]
[*] For 1 Stage: [b]“Mephisto”[/b] decal
[*] For 2 Stages: Random German Empire vehicle from the list
[*] For 3 Stages: [b]“Pickelhaube”[/b] decoration 
[*] For 4 Stages: Random German Empire vehicle from the list
[*] For 5 Stages: Random German Empire vehicle from the list
[*] For 6 Stages: [b]“German Empire Tankman”[/b] profile icon
[/list]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0c27cd4f41d75f0863e802f0aa437c778b4fb686.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/64d6acab7e9e4e7d7c92baa05a6821f24acab1ad.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3046a9c1927caa289d2925af4161d99206e08cde.png[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Mephisto”[/b] decal[/td]
        [td][b]“Pickelhaube”[/b] decoration[/td]
        [td][b]“German Empire Tankman”[/b] profile icon[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[list]
[*] You can track the progress of the task by clicking on your nickname and selecting the menu Achievements → “The Great War”. 
[*] Each stage can be purchased for 599 Golden Eagles and unlocks the corresponding reward. 
[*] Please note: After finishing a stage, you need to collect the reward manually. To do this, click on your nickname, Achievements → “The Great War” and click the “Get Reward” button.
[*] You cannot receive the same vehicle twice.
[*] Vehicles are immediately activated onto your account.
[/list]

[h2]Triple Entente vs German Empire[/h2]
This event pits two of the main sides of the First World War against each other: the Triple Entente consisting of Great Britain, France and Russia against the German Empire.

[h2]Triple Entente[/h2] 
Queue up as the Triple Entente in this event to use the following vehicles:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Mark V [b](Great Britain)[/b][/td]
        [td]Garford [b](Russia)[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/43ff2fc5c95a54e07337f38d19fa5d959408a5e2.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/61cc262f97a39e3d1b22c56fc2b640e406a124ae.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]Wallpapers:[/b] [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Ground_Forces/1920x1080_mark_V_logo_f482171c8ff070ed5196d692e308d20e.jpg]1920x1080[/url], [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Ground_Forces/2560x1440_mark_V_logo_bace0a1691cd73e1372e591d8568022d.jpg]2560x1440[/url], [url=https://staticfiles.warthunder.com/upload/image/0_Wallpaper_Renders/Ground_Forces/3840x2160_mark_V_logo_6f1885a8756e0fca196d4fe7d9c57ba1.jpg]3840x2160[/url] 
The British Mark V (Male) tank was first introduced in 1918. This modification featured a more powerful Ricardo engine, a new transmission, a better steering system and two 6-pounder guns on the side of the hull. 400 of this variant were produced, where it served in several battles, including the Battle of Amiens. 

This tank has up to 12-16 mm of armor, two 5.7 cm (6-pounder) guns with one on each side of the hull, four machine guns and a top speed of around 7 km/h. [/td]
        [td]The Russian Garford-Putilov armored car was transformed from the American Garford truck. It saw combat use against the Germans on the Eastern Front from 1916 till the end of the war. Only 48 were built. 

This armored car has 3-6.5 mm armor, one 76 mm gun at the back of the vehicle, and a top speed of around 18 km/h.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]St-Chamond [b](France)[/b][/td]
        [td]H.P.12 [b](Great Britain)[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2cdfb44f4108c39a790c106ec106346815f3798d.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7f40f034d9d4ffc8c4177e836a5c16791f71191c.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]The French Saint-Chamond was first produced in 1917. It first saw combat in May 1917 during the attack on Laffaux plateau. This tank had a 75 mm gun directly at the front and was one of France’s first tanks to see combat during the war, with around 400 built. 

This tank has 5-17 mm of armor, one 7.5 cm (75 mm) gun at the front of the hull, four machine guns and a top speed of around 12 km/h. [/td]
        [td]The British Handley Page O/400 (H.P.12) bomber entered service with Great Britain in 1917. This aircraft featured a large payload and could carry the largest bombs in the RAF’s inventory, up to 1,650 lb. During World War I, these bombers operated as part of the naval and army aviation on the Western Front. In addition to Great Britain, H.P.12 bombers were also produced under license in the United States.

This bomber features three seats, is all-wood, has two engines and a total payload of up to 1,800 lb. The aircraft’s defensive armament consists of five 7.7 mm Vickers machine guns. [/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]SPAD S.XIII [b](France)[/b] 
Please be aware that the SPAD S.XIII (France) cannot be obtained as an event reward. You’ll be able to fly this fighter in Aces of Thunder soon™![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0a86cbd8ec8919d598c24e35ce1debb62c987d0d.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]The French SPAD S.XIII was a further development of the S.VII model. Due to its successful design and high performance, it was widely used not only by France but also by Great Britain, the USA and Italy. The aircraft took to the skies on April 4th 1917 and remained in service in France until 1923.

This biplane fighter has a wooden propeller, two British Vickers 7.7 mm machine guns and a top speed of over 200 km/h. [/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]German Empire[/h2]
Queue up as the German Empire in this event to use the following vehicles:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]A7V [b](Germany)[/b][/td]
        [td]Beutepanzer Mk.IV [b](Germany)[/b][/td]
        [td]Garford-Beute [b](Germany)[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/13072f9a99a55cff76a45b1288a16b32e52d9352.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/52d3bb42707bba3bcbcc73ec6921523b2af98ff8.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e4aa8aa4bdaed6179d0a86f93925bcf4320ae51e.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]The German A7V tank was first produced in 1918. The A7V first saw combat in April 1918 at Villers-Bretonneux. Only 22 were built and just one survives to this day, nicknamed “Mephisto” at the Queensland Museum in Brisbane, Australia.

This tank features 15-30 mm of armor, one 5.7 cm cannon at the front, six machine guns and a top speed of around 12 km/h. [/td]
        [td]The British Mk.IV tank was captured by the Germans, repainted with German camouflage and markings that included the Iron Cross, and went back into combat. Germany designated captured tanks as “Beutepanzer” (“captured tank”).

Did you know? The Germans had more trophy tanks in service than their own domestic design! 

This tank is almost identical to the British one, except the speed is slower, and the guns are the same from the ones from the A7V. [/td]
        [td]A limited number, around five, Russian Garford-Putilov’s were captured by the Germans and the MGs were changed.

The Germans designated captured tanks as “Beutepanzer” (“captured tank”). 

This tank has identical weaponry (except the MGs), armor and speed as the Russian one.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Fokker D.VII [b](Germany) [/b]
Please be aware that the SPAD S.XIII (France) cannot be obtained as an event reward. You’ll be able to fly this fighter in Aces of Thunder soon™![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/48c35112824d27b6d6a2a695cdbd3fa54c82446f.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]The German Fokker D.VII is considered one of the best German fighters of the First World War. This aircraft had a metal frame, allowing it to withstand higher overloads in flight. It began entering service with the Imperial German Air Force in 1918 and more than 3,000 were produced before the end of the war. In addition to Germany, the Fokker D.VII was later in service with many countries, including Belgium, the Netherlands, the USSR and USA. 

This biplane features a mixed construction, characterized by high resistance to overloads and allowing for good maneuverability. The aircraft’s armament is standard, featuring a pair of rifle-caliber machine guns synchronized with the engine.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Take control of a Zeppelin![/h2]
Zeppelins were used by Germany during the First World War. Inflated with hydrogen gas, they were mainly used as reconnaissance but were also equipped with bombs for use against military targets and cities in France and Britain.

Used by the German Empire in the event, you can use this flying behemoth and drop 14 x 300 kg SC AG bombs on enemies and fire with 7.92 mm machine guns. Lead from a zeppelin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b2137a9500941923d26e36b86b7c923f363736e5.jpg[/img]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e0bceb9f6e3b601ffd0523c7c447ea9915e47bfa.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a14cf5fe174d1ab99d5bd78f0556ff166bfdfc90.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Battle it out in Flanders[/h2]
Flanders is an area of Belgium where some of the bloodiest battles of the First World War took place. Featuring an intense layout of trenches, bunkers, barbed wire, gun entrenchments and a neutral area known as no man’s land, the Triple Entente and German Empire will pit against each other on this barren landscape. What was once peaceful fields has now turned into a bloody battle for a mere few yards of land. [i]“In Flanders Fields, the poppies blow” - John McCrae[/i]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/277a1eae0add69ca3b4b8f6bf260cc532ee10723.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/09be6574c4e685b24d2b1bf84ed453eb27b94a04.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/497554eecfe154bdd6fcdd4819c46025ebb1b041.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/50a401c91879e0ce964efe99003e91486fe566ac.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]AI infantry in the trenches[/h2]
Infantry played a major role during the First World War. Trenches were muddy and wet, rats roamed around and “trench foot” was rampant. Most soldiers had no choice but to go over the top of the trenches into no man’s land on first command, to then get gunned down or shelled with little to no gain for their side. [i]“The most appalling conditions met the men as they endeavoured to cross No Man’s Land.” – Extract from The Wipers Times, Third Wipers 1917 [/i]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/840074d77156b2ab57b45e1f715babd5659c8716.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/305b919504c3721b72a4404a2a45343189926488.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

AI infantry roam the trenches and are a target while in your tank and plane. The British and German soldiers wear authentic uniforms from the time period and also charge into no man’s land. They can fire back at you and throw grenades, so watch out! Taking out one AI infantry will yield 5 mission points, up to a maximum of 500 mission points per battle (100 soldiers), helping to contribute to stage tasks.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b07d25c905a103d7421d3052b4e28946b9c0536a.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/42e1bf3e222a61d05711c0d883d51737e46702eb.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Good luck out there, new conscript.[/h2]

The Triple Entente and German Empire have six stages each.
You can get mission points in the “The Great War” event using the Triple Entente and German Empire.
You can track the progress of the task by clicking on your nickname and selecting the menu Achievements → “The Great War”.
Each stage can be purchased for 599 Golden Eagles and unlocks the corresponding reward.
After finishing a stage, you need to collect the reward manually.
This event pits two of the main sides of the First World War against each other: the Triple Entente consisting of Great Britain, France and Russia against the German Empire.
Queue up as the Triple Entente in this event to use the following vehicles:
Queue up as the German Empire in this event to use the following vehicles:
Zeppelins were used by Germany during the First World War.
Used by the German Empire in the event, you can use this flying behemoth and drop 14 x 300 kg SC AG bombs on enemies and fire with 7.92 mm machine guns.
Flanders is an area of Belgium where some of the bloodiest battles of the First World War took place.
AI infantry roam the trenches and are a target while in your tank and plane.
Taking out one AI infantry will yield 5 mission points, up to a maximum of 500 mission points per battle (100 soldiers), helping to contribute to stage tasks.

notes.title: Update 2.45.1.22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/dd25eaae6eea1d3d84e5e9091e4346aab6ff4888.jpg[/img]

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]F-117[/b] — a task to acquire an additional camouflage has been changed. Now to obtain the camouflage, a player needs to destroy any ground vehicles (both AI controlled and players) instead of destroying players’ vehicles. The number of vehicles to destroy and the game mode multipliers have not been changed.
[*] [b]Tiger HAD, Tiger HAP[/b] — a bug that caused the landing gear to be shifted has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/k7numa76O4h0]Report[/url]).

[/list]
[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]T-10A[/b] — an ability for an additional respawn in the Ground Simulator Battles, which was present by mistake, has been removed.
[*] [b]AMC.34 YR, H.35 and FCM.36[/b] have been grouped together.
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The damage to a naval vessel caused by an explosion in the ammunition storage rooms has been adjusted.[/b] Explosion power now depends on the amount of ammunition in the storage — the more explosives there are, the more powerful the explosion will be. Damage from their detonation is now considerably larger and has a greater radius of effect, in which it damages modules. We’d like to note that different vessels are built differently and while on some the ammo storage is separated from each other by thick armor, others can lack such armor or not have such thick armor, which can cause the explosions effect to drastically differ from one vessel to another.
[*] [b]The propagation dynamics of fire on main caliber turrets via ammo elevators towards the ammunition storage rooms have been adjusted.[/b] On larger ships with inhabited ammo elevators the fire can spread through them upwards (towards the main caliber guns) and downwards (towards ammunition storage). Fire in the elevator can start from its destruction as well as from the damage received by the elevator (for example, an explosion of a shell inside it). Moreover, fire in the turret can spread down, to the elevators and if a player doesn’t react in time to extinguish it, the fire can spread through the elevators to the ammunition storage rooms. If that happens, there is little time to react — an explosion can happen at any moment while the fire affects the ammunition.
[/list]
[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Karelia[/b] — errors that caused visual artifacts to appear on the landscape have been fixed. Low-quality trees around the ground battle zone have been removed. 
[*] [b]Advance to the Rhine[/b] — the orientation of the distant helicopter spawn for the northern team has been adjusted. It is now facing the ground battle zone. 
[*] [b]Carpathians[/b] — areas that allowed climbing onto the cliffs in square G5 have been blocked.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Client stability has been improved.
[/list]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

notes.title: Infantry and Expanded Tech Trees in War Thunder!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f4fa6f677d523f1789d144147f2ac44c0cbea454.jpg[/img]
[h2]Infantry and Expanded Tech Trees in War Thunder![/h2]

Introducing a revolutionary update! The long awaited and highly requested addition of infantry to the battlefields of War Thunder is finally here!

[previewyoutube=vZA0GkLNDeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re always striving to push the boundaries of our game — an online military combat simulator that brings to life legendary weaponry from various eras. That’s why War Thunder is about to grow not only in depth with the introduction of armored vehicles and aircraft from World War I, but also in scale, with infantry now joining the fight!

[h2]What does this mean?[/h2]

Very soon, a large-scale closed beta test of infantry will begin. We’ll share more details about the tech trees, weaponry, gear, and gameplay features in future devblogs. But in THE NEXT 24 HOURS, you'll have your first chance to take part in test battles featuring infantry during a special event dedicated to World War I.

It’s time to see war from a completely new perspective. You’re already familiar with the devastating power of machines — on land, in the sky, and at sea. But everything is about to change when infantry, the true decisive force of the battlefield, finally enters the fray.
Get ready for all new battles like you’ve never seen before, and stay tuned for updates. 

Forward, soldiers!

notes.title: Discounts for the RAF’s Birthday & the Introduction of the Harrier!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fc164ee9883f827f35764778feba7ad1fa1ead5c.jpg[/img]

The British Royal Air Force was founded at the end of the First World War on April 1st, 1918. During the interwar period, the RAF became the largest air force in the world. Thanks to its excellent aircraft and skilled pilots during the Second World War, the RAF achieved victory in the skies during the Battle of Britain, successfully defending the homeland against Nazi Germany.

One of the Royal Air Force’s most famous aircraft in the second half of the 20th century was the Hawker Siddeley Harrier jet. It was the first aircraft to enter production that featured vertical/short takeoff and landing (V/STOL) capabilities. It entered service on April 1st 1969 and served until 2006 after several upgraded modifications. 

[h2]The Typhoon Mk Ib and Attacker FB.2 are temporarily available for Golden Eagles! [/h2]
In honor of the RAF’s birthday, the Typhoon Mk IB and Attacker FB.2 are available for 1,930 and 8,020 Golden Eagles respectively.

[quote][b]When:[/b] From March 28th (14:00 GMT) until April 2nd (11:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b] Great Britain > Aviation > Premium vehicles.[/quote]

[b]About these aircraft[/b]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/typhoon_mk1b]Typhoon Mk Ib[/url] differs from the Mk Ia model in that it has four 20 mm Hispano Mk.II cannons instead of machine guns. It can carry a variety of bombs from 250 lb to 1,000 lb, as well as eight RP-3 rockets. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f58ac6b4e073ae296958abcc41fa3b6d60041d20.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/attaker_fb2]Attacker FB.2[/url] was a carrier-based jet fighter produced by Supermarine in the 1950s. This variant features a more powerful engine and four 20 mm Hispano Mk.V cannons, while its external weaponry includes 500 lb and 1,000 lb bombs and 12 RP-3 rockets. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/069c5d6c06ecc676291a706e4ead6af96097a187.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]The return of the AV-8 and discounts on British and American Harriers![/h2]
[quote][b]When:[/b] From March 28th (14:00 GMT) until April 2nd (11:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b] USA / Great Britain > Aviation > Premium vehicles.[/quote]

The AV-8A makes a return and is available to purchase for Golden Eagles! There’s a 30% discount on this aircraft during this event, where it costs 6,237 Golden Eagles. When this event finishes, it will stay and cost 8,910 Golden Eagles. 

During the same period, you can get the Harrier GR.1 (rank VI) for 6,363 Golden Eagles and the AV-8B Night Attack (rank VII) pack in the Gaijin.net store with a 30% discount!

[h2]AV-8B Night Attack Pack[/h2]
[strike]69,99[/strike] 48,99
[list]
[*] AV-8B Night Attack (Rank VII, USA)
[*] 2500 Golden Eagles
[*] Premium account for 20 days
[/list]
To get to the Gaijin Store through Steam, go to the in-game hangar > Shop > Online Store.

[b]About these aircraft[/b]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/av_8a]AV-8A[/url] (rank VI) is the American designation for the Harrier and was the first American aircraft in the game capable of VTOL. This aircraft can accelerate and climb very quickly, and its wide range of weapons — from rockets and bombs to AIM-9G Sidewinder air-to-air missiles — make it a good all-rounder! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4505db49e705a79af87b8681389dfc53c225554c.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/harrier_gr1]Harrier GR.1[/url] (rank VI) was the first Harrier production variant, put into service in 1969. This aircraft can accelerate and climb very quickly, and can carry a wide range of weaponry, from rockets and bombs to the very short-range SRAAM air-to-air missile! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7c82d9973759a2c93843d6ca15ad7ba14ece0d22.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Get the “RAF Day 2025” decal![/h2]

For the anniversary, you can get this themed decal.

[quote]When: From March 31st (10:00 GMT) until April 3rd (11:00 GMT).
Task: Play 3 battles using British aircraft at rank III or higher to receive the “RAF Day 2025” decal![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e5a88ddd84fd9b50e680eac312f327eb7ca444aa.png[/img]

Additional details:
[list]
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, [Assault] mode and Helicopter PVE battles.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → RAF Day.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the customization menu.
[/list]

18 camouflage coupons for aircraft.
1 camouflage coupon for naval vessels.
2 camouflage coupons for helicopters.
Coupon for the Hornet’s Sting decal.
To unlock the trophy, you’ll need the new “Hornet’s Sting” key that can be purchased on the Market for GJN.
Camouflage trophies can be earned with a certain probability after any battle on vehicles rank II or higher, with activity of no less than 50% (except for [Assault] PvE mode).
PlayStation and Xbox players can purchase the trophy in the Item Shop and open it with Golden Eagles.
PC players must purchase a key from the Market to open the trophy, with part of the cost going to the camouflage creators.
You can activate a key from the trophy on your account or sell it on the Market for Gaijin Coins — just like the trophy itself.
You can become a creator of user camouflages — check out an updated guide on our wiki!

It will bring you both glory and real money as a part of the War Thunder partnership program Additionally, all authors who are included in these trophies will receive a unique title, player icon and decal.
Join the creative team over on WT Live!

notes.content:

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]

[*] A bug that made it possible to select a target that had moved outside of the current radar scan zone when switching targets cyclically has been fixed.
[*] As it is now possible to move the radar scan zone horizontally in TWS mode with cyclic target switching turned on, the values set by the player for the horizontal radar target cue control axis and the radar tilt control axis are now in sync with the automatic changes in the scan zone's location due to tracking. Just as they were in sync when cyclic target switching was turned off. [*] [b]F/A-18A, F/A-18C Early, AV-8B Plus (all variants), F-4F KWS LV[/b] — a bug that caused the game to crash when launching radar homing missiles has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/JXDFtZIzYfQg]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

tags.bug: [b]Su-33[/b] — a bug with the landing gear animation that caused some pieces to clip through the plane has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/BG8p9M5XIc6Q]Report[/url]).
A bug that caused vehicles to excessively slide on rocky surfaces has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bOPYnJ94WDhn]Report[/url]).

[b]XM246[/b] — a bug that caused the tracking radar dome to move when the turret was aimed vertically has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/JigWiY4yXWEy]Report[/url]).

tags.balance_change: [b]Rapier[/b] — the maximum overload of the Rapier Mk.2 missile has been increased to 35G ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/U4H1xv8A79NU]Report[/url]). Source: BAE press kit.
[b]Rapier[/b] — the maximum speed of the Rapier Mk.2 missile  has been increased to M2.5 ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/dvFnzAl852Zq]Report[/url]). Source: BAE press kit.
[b]Rapier[/b] — the range of the Rapier Mk.2 missile has been increased to 8.2 km. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/8duQeT6FPEhj]Report[/url]).

tags.bug: [b]Advance to the Rhine[/b] — a bug where the detailed cathedral building was only displayed at low altitudes for aircraft has been fixed.

[b][Operation] Kamchatka[/b] — a bug that caused allied air defense vehicles to appear on the runway has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/zRrZ49uxiJ2M]Report[/url]).

tags.feature: Support for DLSS 4 has been added.

tags.bug: A bug that caused the feed from the UAV (picture-in-picture) to turn white if the player turned on night vision while in the tank and thermal while in the UAV has been fixed.

A bug that caused aircraft-launched rockets and missiles to not have the cumulative and high-explosive armor penetration values in the stat card has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/XBrBF8STQnx8]Report[/url]).

[b]F/A-18A, F/A-18C Early, AV-8B Plus (all variants), F-4F KWS LV[/b] — a bug that caused the game to crash when launching radar homing missiles has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/JXDFtZIzYfQg]Report[/url]).

notes.title: Meet the “Hornet’s Sting” Major Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/968ebcf6d9b3f9dc28a72c1a80da51ee05b25b11.png[/img]

[h3]Meet Hornet’s Sting, War Thunder’s first major update in 2025![/h3]

Hornet’s Sting introduces the F/A-18 for the USA and Sweden in several variants, along with the Su-30SM for the USSR that features thrust vectoring, enhancing its maneuverability. For ground forces, the Tracked Rapier, CLOVIS and 2S19M1 / M2 take the spotlight thanks to their excellent capabilities. Rhine, Sinai and Jungle have received graphical overhauls, refreshing their visuals, all while maintaining their familiar layouts. Next up for naval forces is HMS Warspite, one of the most decorated warships in naval history! To top it off, the game has had some interface improvements, item recycling and new player profile showcases.

[h3]Check out the changelog to see the fixes, vehicles and other features that we’ve included in this major update.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ufk9SI6q1GA;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/0/552359583936463932/ style=button]Please feel free to leave your feedback on this Major update in the feedback thread here.[/url]

[h2]Aircraft: The F/A-18 Hornet Is Here to Sting[/h2]
The Hornet’s Sting update adds a variety of top-tier aircraft to several nations. 

The highly anticipated F/A-18 Hornet joins the game for USA and Sweden. There’s four examples to choose from: the A variant, the late C variant, and the premium early C variant for the USA, to the Finnish variant for Sweden, built as a pure fighter version. All ready to be used in top-tier jet battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f1fa1cb09096dd6686a048744efb535429a60cb3.jpg[/img][b]F/A-18С Early[/b]

Take a look at the Su-30SM, featuring a whopping 12 hardpoints for a multitude of weaponry, plus a new type of engine nozzle mechanic to the game: thrust vectoring! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b97d3a786847b64ba6b2987d452797aeaeba8959.jpg[/img][b]Su-30SM[/b]

If you’re a fan of British aircraft, then the premium Harrier T.10 will certainly be up your street. Featuring two cockpit seats, this strike aircraft is a great addition to your lineup in combined battles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0227da2c9437b1cb30cf13bde85938178e49e2cc.jpg[/img][b]Harrier T.10[/b]

[h2]Ground Vehicles:  SPAA, Premium Tanks and a Mix of Modern and WW2 Vehicles![/h2]
A variety of ground vehicles that span across several nations have been added.

This is the premium CLOVIS, a light tank that features an oscillating turret and an autoloader, joining Germany as a pack vehicle and France for Golden Eagles. The CLOVIS will shape up to be a potent light tank thanks to its quick reload, mobility and scouting abilities! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/60e47cf3de174e4ca01cb985344e757f1225a659.png[/img]
[b]Marder CLOVIS[/b]

The Tracked Rapier features the all-new Rapier missile! This missile is proximity-based and has SACLOS guidance, making it an excellent air defense platform for Britain. Check out the two autoloading howitzers as well — the 2S19M1 and M2 for the USSR as a researchable and squadron vehicle respectively, brilliant for putting plenty of fire down range.

[h2]Helicopters: New Modules and Tigers[/h2]
We’ve worked on adding new modules to the AH-64, Tiger, Ka-50/52 and Mi-8 helicopters to reduce the amount of “empty space” in them. Fan of the Tiger helicopters? Then check out the Tiger HAD that comes as a premium pack for Germany and Tiger HAC for France as a researchable helicopter.

[h2]Naval Fleet: The Grand Old Lady Joins The Fleet![/h2]
One of the most iconic and decorated warships in naval history has joined naval battles! Meet HMS Warspite, a beastly battleship for Great Britain ready to take on all types of enemies. Additionally, we’ve replaced some reserve boats for the USSR, Germany, Great Britain, Japan and France to ones that feature more effective weaponry so that the early ranks will be a more enjoyable experience for beginners.
