To make sure that we can keep adding emblems across the board for everyone for the foreseeable future, we’ll have 10 per month — 5 new emblems and 5 emblems from previous events, that way new players will be able to unlock some old emblems they wouldn’t have been able to get previously as well.
The unlock requirements will be simple: frags, missions played, score earned, things that are universally achievable.

Some special markings will be a little more challenging such as finishing at a certain position on the leaderboard, but in general the requirements will be simple and able to be achieved gradually as you play normally.
While we have many months worth of decals created and planned, you’re welcome to leave your own suggestions on the forum [url=https://forum.warthunder.com/c/suggestions/skins/37]here[/url].
Going forward we want to avoid any divisional or formal markings belonging to currently active units.
Though personal markings, modern insignia of deactivated units, or older versions of emblems used by active units will generally be fine.
No promises of course, but if you can find some interesting examples (especially for nations that have fewer options in general) we can potentially include some down the line.
You can track the progress of completing tasks for these decals by going to your Player Profile > Decals > Monthly Decals.
From here, click the “Track progress” button on each decal to track from the hangar.
“Enemy Planes If You Can Read This You’re Too Close” Inscription, USA
Defeat 70 players using American aircraft at rank III and above
“61st Keibitai Insignia, Japan
Defeat 50 players using Japanese light tanks at rank III and above
“Kör Asz” Emblem, Hungary
Finish in position 1-3 five times while flying Italian or Hungarian Aircraft at rank III and above
6ème Escadrille GC III/6 Emblem, France
Play 20 battles while using French aircraft with a minimum of 60% Battle Activity at rank III and above
3. SFltl Emblem “Tiefseefisch”, Germany
Can be purchased for 200 Golden Eagles
Guards Armoured Division Emblem, Britain
Defeat 50 players using British Heavy Tanks at rank III and above
269th Mechanized Infantry Brigade Emblem, China
Defeat 50 players using Chinese Light Tanks at rank III and above
“Bear Bomber” Personal Marking, USSR
Earn 10,000 score while flying Soviet Bombers at rank III and above
Brigade Nord Emblem, Norway
Play 20 battles while using Swedish Ground Vehicles with a minimum of 60% Battle Activity at rank III and above
319th Division Emblem, Israel
Play 20 battles while using Israeli Ground Vehicles with a minimum of 60% Battle Activity at rank III and above
Monthly markings can be found in a special tab in the customization menu, (Monthly Decals) after a month, they’ll be moved to their corresponding category.
All of the emblems will come with a detailed description.

This will generally consist of the history of the marking, its design, which vehicles used it, and where it was often placed on vehicles historically if applicable (some emblems are taken from badges, which weren’t always applied).
This way you can more easily recreate the original positioning if you’d like.
In addition to tasks, all markings can be purchased for 200 Golden Eagles as well.

notes.title: Freedom Fighter: F-5A(G)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/06b11e5509e1cefd00276b49e202ae8af7a43c72.gif[/img]

Meet the protagonist in the Freedom Fighter event: the Norwegian F-5A(G) multi-role jet fighter!

[h2][b]F-5A(G):[/b] An Event Vehicle Jet Fighter for Sweden at Rank VII[/h2]
At a glance:
[list]
[*] AIM-9L Sidewinders!
[*] Penguin Mk.3 guided missile.
[*] Countermeasures.
[*] RWR.
[*] Unique camouflage on the missiles!
[/list]
[b]Vehicle History[/b]
[expand type=details]
The first foreign operator of the F-5A jet fighter was the Royal Norwegian Air Force. At request from the Norwegians, an export modification was developed for operation from Arctic airfields. Deliveries of the aircraft began in 1966, and several air squadrons were equipped with the F-5A and two-seat F-5B. During upgrades, this Norwegian variant received an updated cockpit, a new sighting system with the ability to control advanced weaponry such as the AIM-9L Sidewinder air-to-air missiles and Penguin anti-ship missiles, an RWR and countermeasure pods. The F-5A was in service with the Norwegian Air Force until December 31st 2007 and also took part in the Eye of the Tiger (EoT) program, where the aircraft tested anti-ship guided missiles.
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9c45fcd89b566a412a8da45ad743b62880f88a57.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introducing the F-5A(G)![/h2]

The Norwegian F-5A(G) has arrived to War Thunder in the Freedom Fighter event! This is a very special variant of the F-5 with new combat capabilities and a cool unique camouflage. Let’s take a look at the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/78158ba99e0a577150659eb5c5b26f8388204f52.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/46dda5db8a22f8602485261c398a4306bf95a5b6.jpg[/img]

The F-5A(G) is an export modification of the American Northrop F-5A jet fighter, developed for the Norwegian Air Force and represented in its latest modification when it participated in testing anti-ship missiles. This Norwegian variant differs from the American one both externally and internally — the shape of the nose cone has changed, the pods for launching countermeasures are located on the vertical stabilizer, and a tail hook was added! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d23393951ce1a0d481b299ecf84365f49064de2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ad0c525745e66fa2efe3678ae67211b5115b5332.jpg[/img]

There has been some improvements in the weaponry department as well. Instead of the early rear-aspect AIM-9E air-to-air missile, the F-5A(G) is capable of carrying two all-aspect AIM-9L missiles with an increased launch range and a much higher maximum overload. In addition to this, the central pylon under the fuselage can hold the new Penguin anti-ship missile with IR+IOG guidance. Despite ships being the intended target, this heavy missile with a large explosive load can combat tanks in Ground Battles — capture a target from a long distance and then fire the missile, which will then operate in “fire and forget” mode. The destructive power is enough to destroy any tank upon impact!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/68c2cdac7104ae7425761871614e8095845abd72.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/be6de54922d1bb850d84aa44abf0a2a1bddfe9e7.jpg[/img]

For flight performance, the F-5A(G) retains all the great features of the F-5 series. That’s excellent maneuverability, high resistance to overloads, a good rate of climb and fast-firing 20 mm cannons. In addition to the guided weaponry mentioned above, the F-5A(G) can also carry regular and incendiary bombs, plus Zuni and Mighty Mouse rockets.

That’s it for this one! The Norwegian F-5A(G) is the main reward in the Freedom Fighter event that started today, featuring a special Eye of the Tiger camouflage, with a grinning tiger on the vertical stabilizer and tiger stripes on the fuselage, external fuel tanks and even Sidewinder missiles!

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/530963170347450602 style=button]Click here to find out more details about the Freedom Fighter event[/url]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №102
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e362d6409b5a423aef8a163377c93028108ed22b.png[/img]

Today, we’ve rounded up and will be going over some of the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past few weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check out [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]the changelog section on our website[/url].

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Helicopters that had magic tricks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9a174fb01f03744988f4659e07cdf63854a3c02b.jpg[/img]

Helicopters are pretty fragile vehicles, but a couple of bugs that crept into the game made them much more durable. One of these bugs allowed bombs to pass through helicopters without causing any damage. Another gave helicopters the ability to deflect bombs with its rotor blades, with the slower the bomb fell, the more chances the blades had to deflect it. Both of these bugs have been fixed. 

[h2]Crew incorrect voices after firing[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c831b3013678d1e5f2f69e08157f00d48d314f2d.jpg[/img]

You aim your gun, fire and hit your target and smile — however, your crew said that it was a miss and to adjust your aim. What kind of shenanigans were going on here? There was a bug where the crew called out a hit a miss when the discarding sabot part of an APFSDS shell flew past the enemy vehicle, even though the armor-piercing part of the shell itself hit the target. We’ve fixed this bug!

[h2]Missile launch line displaying at all times[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ed0f291e78396090adb9a596b11fd35c9636053d.jpg[/img]

When launching air-to-surface guided missiles, the launch zone is outlined with a green line for clarity. But a bug caused this line to remain on the screen if you were destroyed and respawned in another aircraft, even if you left the battle and went into another. This bug has been fixed!

[h2]Stuck bomb bay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/78a816d10fe913075ef601c48f5d53a8b58cd28a.jpg[/img]

Aircraft capable of carrying different bombs either externally on hardpoints or internally in the bomb bay were found to have strange behavior. If you opened the bomb bay and then selected bombs on the external hardpoints, the bomb bay closed by itself and did not open again until either selecting the bombs in it or deselecting the external weapons. We’ve fixed this bug too. 

[h2]That’s not all[/h2]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in separate update notes. The display of water near the shore has been improved, the voice announcer no longer reports the direction of the previous missile, and the hit analysis no longer shows shells that are not in the feed.


[h1]Today's update: Update 2.43.0.87[/h1]

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tu-2S-44, Tu-2S-44 (China), Tu-2S-59[/b] — the M44 bombs have been replaced with the M43, with more explosives.
[*] [b]Mirage 2000-5F[/b] — Mirage 2000-5F — a bug where the HMD wasn’t being displayed when the pilot’s head was turned away from the sights at small angles has been fixed.  ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/drM0BB4ILYcw]Report[/url]). 
[*] [b]F-8E, F-8E(FN)[/b] — EEGS (unsynchronized shooting) has been added.
[*] [b]Matra R550 Magic 2[/b] — engine operating time and total thrust have been clarified. Operating time has been reduced from 2.2 to 2s, total thrust has been increased from 55,000 N to 55,900 N. Source: Solid propellant rocket motor manufacturer website www.bayernchemie-protac.com
[/list]
[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]MIM-146[/b] — the burn time has been changed from 2s to 3.17s while maintaining total thrust impulse. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Z0lh2xQLGLMB]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]MIM-146[/b] — missile autopilot has been updated, trajectory sway has been reduced. Rocket dynamics have been updated.
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]RN Duilio[/b] — the thickness of aft casemate armor belt has been increased from 20 to 70 mm.
[*] [b]Nurnberg[/b] — the display of main caliber ammunition in the ship’s X-ray has been fixed.
[*] [b]HMS Spey[/b] — elevation angles of the 40 mm Bofors 90 mounts have been reduced to 85 degrees.
[*] A bug where on some vehicles it was possible to buy and accordingly take into battle fewer shells than were in the ammunition has been fixed. 
[*] For playability reasons, the following naval weapons have been stabilized:
[list]
[*] “Plamya” 30 mm automatic grenade launcher
[*] 57 mm Type 97 mod. 1937 gun
[*] 75 mm anti-aircraft Type 88 gun
[*] 76 mm/40 F-34 gun
[*] 85 mm/54.6 ZIS-S-53 gun
[/list][/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug where the hit analysis could show shells that were not in the feed has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] The delay for sending messages to the in-game chat has been reduced: for unique messages the delay is 2 seconds, for repeating messages the delay is 5 seconds.
[/list] 

[hr][/hr]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.gaijin.net%2Fissues%2Fp%2Fwarthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

notes.title: Meet the Auction!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/049a4193b9dbcc55ade7fad73be4217562d9f0a1.jpg[/img]

The auction is a new way to distribute player-created content. In addition to trophies, we’ll now select a few more pieces of work from those not included in them and release them to the auction in limited edition. 

[b]How does the auction work?[/b]

Trading is carried out using a special currency called [b]Gaijin Coin[/b], the same currency already used on the Gaijin Marketplace.

“Lots” with a minimum bid are put up for auction, which will open for bids at a set time and date. Bidding lasts for a certain amount of time so that everyone who wants to can make their bids. 

There is a starting price for each item, so to make a bid you’ll need at least that amount of GJN on your account. The amount you bid is frozen until the end of the bidding or until you make a new bid. Be careful, as you cannot cancel the bid. If you win, you receive the item and the amount is debited from your account, otherwise the amount you bid is returned to your account. 

If you’re outbid, (or in the case of multi-item auctions, if your bid is no longer high enough to win the item), you’ll receive a notification about this. At the end of the auction, you’ll also receive a notification of the auction result. 

An auction may contain several identical items in the form of many lots — one item per lot. If this happens, they’ll be received by the players who made the highest bids, and the number of winners will be equal to the number of auction lots. For example, if there are 1,000 participants in an auction for 100 lots, the item will be received by 100 players who had the highest bids at the end of the auction. 

If players with the same bid compete for the remaining item, then the first bidder will have the advantage since they bid first. One player can only buy one lot from an auction. 

In the auction interface, you’ll see the values ​​of the current leading bids.

[b]Auction Rules[/b]
[list]
[*] After the auction ends, items that are not declared as coupons will be automatically activated on your account. Camouflage coupons will be added to your inventory.
[*] Players who purchased camouflage coupons will not be able to sell them on the Market immediately, but after at least 180 days.
[*] Items that are put up for auction cannot appear there again for a year.
[/list]

[b]Testing the Auction[/b] 
To test out the new auction system, we’re offering the first lots dedicated to the Lunar New Year: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/504bbbdbc13b7b606bef8a71261c985f4a688360.png[/img]

Lot #1 “[b]Spring Festival[/b]” avatar frame
Quantity: 100 pieces
Starting price: 0.50 GJN
Bid Increment: 0.50 GJN

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/91ae21b0db65fee9e52d39df35fdd71030cc854f.jpg[/img]

Lot #2: Coupon for the VT4A1 “[b]Year of the Snake[/b]” camouflage
Quantity: 100 pieces
Starting price: 1 GJN
Bid Increment: 1 GJN

Possible to sell on the Market from August 11th 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9e25aa441eff67d4687fb6e1f54dcaaa1ab75073.jpg[/img]

Lot #3: Coupon for the J-10A “Y[b]ear of the Snake[/b]” camouflage
Quantity: 100 pieces
Starting price: 1 GJN
Bid Increment: 1 GJN 

Possible to sell on the Market from August 11th 2025.

[url=http://trade.gaijin.net/market/auction]Click here to go to the Auction[/url]

Bids on these lots will be accepted until February 10th (15:30 GMT).

Players who purchase at least one of these lots will also receive the “Inverted Jenny” decal. This is a 1918 U.S. postage stamp, where the Curtiss JN-4 airplane was mistakenly depicted upside down. This stamp has become especially rare and valuable among philatelists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e29af74e0bab80c33ad5f9b9ffb7c8897a468afe.png[/img]
“[b]Inverted Jenny[/b]” decal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3569f0af4de1a58a39b744d1fac9a38a90a8a367.png[/img]

In this next aviation event, we’re celebrating the Norwegian Air Force. Take part in air battles to get unique decals as well as this special version of the F-5A fighter, nicknamed the “Freedom Fighter”, designed for export to Norway!

[quote][h3]From February 6th (11:00 GMT) until February 24th (11:00 GMT), earn mission points in Air Battles, unlock stages and receive rewards![/h3][/quote]

[h2]F-5A(G) — An Event Vehicle Jet Fighter for Sweden at Rank VII[/h2]
The F-5A(G) is a Royal Norwegian Air Force multi-role fighter jet. This modification is equipped with a new sighting system, all-aspect AIM-9L Sidewinder air-to-air missiles, and the Penguin guided anti-ship missile with a thermal imaging homing head, which will prove itself in battles against tanks. The F-5A(G) is the first Norwegian aircraft in War Thunder and also has a unique “tiger” camouflage! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6205bd3c6ee2d1761b1bbf5a3618bec0f261a0a9.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Emblem of the Royal Norwegian Air Force”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Emblem of the 332nd squadron”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Emblem of the 336th squadron”[/b] decal[/td] 
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]Special camouflage[/b]

Among the rewards in the event is also this chest, where, when opened, brings the chance to receive one of the following items:
[list]
[*] 50,000 - 100,000 Silver Lions
[*] Silver Lion and Research Point boosters
[*] Random Wagers and Orders
[*] Universal Backups (1 - 3) 
[*] A random camouflage for a vehicle you own
[*] 1 day of Premium Account
[/list]

[h2]How to get all rewards[/h2]
Each stage is unlocked for [b]45,000[/b] mission points and brings a new reward.

[quote][b]Please note:[/b] Once the stage is unlocked, you will need to claim your reward manually. To do this, click on your profile, select the Freedom Fighter category, and click Claim Prize.[/quote]

You’re able to earn mission points in [b]Air Battles[/b] at Rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic and Simulator Battles. The number of mission points to complete a stage depends on the game mode and the maximum Rank of the vehicle that you use in battle. There’s a multiplier for earning mission points, which is shown in the task description in-game.

You can also earn mission points by using event vehicles that are Rank I and II. Event vehicles that can be used have the name of the event that they were obtainable in on their stat card.

[quote][h3]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT: February 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th, 20th and 22nd.[/h3][/quote]

[h2]Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] For [b]1[/b] Stage: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]2[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]3[/b] Stages: a silver chest “Snake Box”
[*] For [b]4[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]5[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]6[/b] Stages: “Emblem of the 336th squadron” decal
[*] For [b]7[/b] Stages: a silver chest “Snake Box”
[*] For [b]8[/b] Stages: a non-tradable coupon for the F-5A(G)
[*] For [b]9[/b] Stages: unique camouflage and four random modifications for the F-5A(G)
[/list]

[h3]Discounts on purchasing stages using Golden Eagles[/h3]
Unfinished stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but if you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will now be significantly reduced. 

Let’s say you have earned 85% of the required mission points to complete a stage, then the price of purchasing this stage will be halved. If you’re near the finish line for a stage and are at 95% progress, then the price will be reduced by five times. For example, if you’ve scored 39,000 mission points, then the price for unlocking this stage will be 499 Golden Eagles. If you’ve scored 43,000 mission points, then you’ll only need to pay 199 Golden Eagles. Remember to keep this in mind if you cannot complete a stage on time!

[h3]The Upgrade for coupon [/h3]
When you complete 8 stages, you’ll receive a non-tradable coupon for the F-5A(G) where using it will immediately activate the vehicle onto your account. If you don’t want the vehicle and would like to sell the coupon on the Market, you’ll need the “Upgrade for coupon” item.

[quote]	The “Upgrade for coupon” item can be earned in parallel with the stages throughout the event from February 6th (11:00 GMT ) until February 24th (11:00 GMT) for 750,000 mission points.[/quote]

After receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” item, you can convert a non-tradable coupon for the vehicle into a tradable one and sell it on the Market. The tradable coupon can be sold after 5 days from the moment it’s created.

The “Upgrade for coupon” item is valid until February 27th (11:00 GMT). Until this time, you can use it or exchange it for War Bonds. Afterwards, it’ll disappear from your inventory.


[quote]To make a tradable coupon, select the “Coupon F-5A(G) (Sweden)” in your inventory and click the “Modify” button.[/quote]

You can track the progress of completing stages and receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” by clicking on your Nickname > Achievements > Freedom Fighter. If you don’t manage to complete a stage on time or would like to purchase a stage, until February 27th from the Achievements window, you can purchase each stage with Golden Eagles which will give you the corresponding rewards.

[previewyoutube=FKI_91zdqnA;full][/previewyoutube]

2024 was an incredible year — we held several major Esports events that were high-intensity, with many teams taking part and coming out with success, victory and lots of emotion. Now it’s time to find out who will take home the Grand Champion title of 2024! 

What better way to do this than to bring together the 8 best teams of the 2024 season and have them battle it out in a unique tournament featuring a variety of new game modes? Will the DODEC Team continue their success story with 3 major wins out of 4? That’s what we’ll find out in Thunder CUP 2025. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]All about the Thunder CUP 2025 tournament[/h2]
This year, we’ve decided to make the teams compete in a variety of formats that are representative of the Esports 2024 season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/61edf0dcdf89a4d3d7132ebbd39d35589d118e0e.png[/img]

Each team will consist of a roster of 8 players. 

We’ll start with the first weekend in 4v4 tank format for our tank commanders.

During the second weekend we’ll feature a 4v4 jet format with 4-point maps that include the much sought-after “D” point.

During the last weekend, the final of this event will take place in a format most known and loved by Esports players, the 5v5 mixed format. Teams will clash on the beloved Advance to the Rhine map, which has been reworked to make gameplay truly epic!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3f0650874ec032c397e1ac76d974bed336a9248b.png[/img]

January 29th marks the Lunar New Year, and we at War Thunder have traditionally prepared a ton of activities and discounts for you to celebrate it properly!

[h1]Earn the “Red envelope” decal! [/h1]
Get this Year of the Snake related decal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/080212c4269e051a3b6b3ab98fd3508b70fe0bee.png[/img]
[b]“Red envelope”[/b] decal 

[quote][b]When:[/b] From today until February 5th (12:00 GMT).
[b]Task:[/b]  Play 3 battles using Chinese vehicles to receive the “Red envelope” decal!

[b]Additional details:[/b]
[list]
[*] You must use a minimum of rank III.
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, [Assault] mode and Helicopter PVE battles.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Lunar New Year. 
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.
[/list]
[/quote]

[h1]The ZTZ96A (P) and A-5C are back for good for Golden Eagles![/h1]
These two vehicles are back on sale and will not be going away. Each cost 9,270 Golden Eagles.

[quote][b]When:[/b] From January 29 (12:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b]  China > Aviation / Army > Premium vehicles.
[/quote]
[h3]About these vehicles[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d2d5e5cd1a5d73d8f0978d593844211a70664ad0.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/cn_ztz_96a_prot]ZTZ96A (P)[/url] is an MBT that features a unique turret armor layout and the JD-3 optical-electronic suppression system. This tank can fire 125mm HEAT-FS, or a heavy hitting APFSDS shell with over 450 mm of armor penetration. Additionally, the ZTZ99A (P) can find enemies with a thermal imager, and fire these rounds accurately with its laser rangefinder, making it a strong tank at rank VII!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/eabbb8bab31e8cdc77bb24de455d941db7071ec3.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/a_5c]A-5C[/url] is a rank VI export variant of the Q-5, created at the request of the Pakistan Air Force. This attack aircraft features two 23 mm cannons, countermeasures and powerful Matra Magic air-to-air missiles. For ground targets, it features large high-explosive rockets as well as bombs, which can be aimed accurately with the ballistic computer. 
[/list]


[h1]The Type 69-IIa and Т-62 №545 are temporarily available for Golden Eagles![/h1]
These two tanks are temporarily available for 8,380 and 8,730 Golden Eagles respectively.

[quote][b]When:[/b] From January 29th (12:00 GMT) until February 5th (11:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b]  China > Army > Premium vehicles.
[/quote]
[h3]About these tanks[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d4de4d676e61770b80320b1d83b1bdbccb7ee6f5.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Type_69-IIa]Type 69-IIa[/url] is an export variant of the Type 69, created for the Iraqi Army. This tank is better protected and equipped with a laser rangefinder and smoke grenades. Thanks to its 100 mm rifled gun found on the Type 59, the Type 69-IIA is great in the sniper role at rank V! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ea69701bfc2c40911a8782cde8c4a79b3a7d79db.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/T-62_545_(China)]Т-62 №545[/url] is a Soviet tank that was captured by the Chinese Army. It has everything needed for a good MBT — mobility, a two-plane stabilizer that allows you to maintain accuracy, good frontal armor and powerful shells. This tank can be found at rank VI in the Chinese ground forces tree. 
[/list]

notes.title: Moments of Valor: Australia
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LiU9zIE_g7E;full][/previewyoutube]

On January 26th, 1788, the British flag was raised for the first time on the coast of Australia, marking the establishment of the first colony on the continent. Each of the colonies celebrated its own foundation day throughout the 19th century, but at the beginning of the 20th century, Australia was united. In 1935, January 26th was chosen as the date of the main national holiday. 

In honor of this holiday, we’re continuing our “Moments of Valor” video series, this time dedicated to the armed forces of Australia. We’re also offering some premium vehicles in a special pack with a discount in the Gaijin store, plus some Australian camouflages that can be purchased for Golden Eagles if you have the vehicles, created by players on the War Thunder Live portal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e85e3dd89d595f1cc274e01f9ff231e3f28a7d86.png[/img]

The “Per Ardua Ad Astra” title and portrait “Corporal Skippy” will also be automatically granted to all players who own all vehicles from the Moments of Valor: Australia Pack or who purchases it until February 3rd (11:00 GMT).

[h2]Discounts on Australian vehicles![/h2]
Each vehicle in the Moments of Valor: Australia pack can be purchased separately at a 50% discount! This means that Plagis’ Spitfire LF Mk.IXc and the Boomerang Mk.II are temporarily available to purchase with Golden Eagles during the event. Please note: the Boomerang Mk. II can only be purchased if you already own the Boomerang Mk.I.

[quote][b]When:[/b] From today until February 3rd (11:00 GMT).

[b]About these aircraft[/b] 
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/boomerang_mkii]Boomerang Mk.II[/url] is an Australian-made aircraft that was widely used in the Pacific theater of World War II. The Mk.II is highly maneuverable, armed with 20 mm cannons and 7.7 mm machine guns. And unlike the first model, it’s capable of carrying two 250 lb bombs for ground attack. 
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/unit/spitfire_ix_plagis]Spitfire LF Mk.IXc[/url] was flown by RAF ace John Plagis in 1944. This fighter is armed with two 20 mm Hispano cannons and four 7.7 mm Browning machine guns. This aircraft is available in the camouflage of Captain Clive Caldwell, the highest scoring ace of the Royal Australian Air Force in World War II.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6556adea9ddef2d33961395819c75da9703f257b.png[/img]

[b]Task:[/b] Play 3 battles using British vehicles at rank III or above to receive the “Australia Day 2025” decal!

[list]

[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, [Assault] mode and Helicopter PVE battles.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Australia Day.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the customization menu.	
[/list][/quote]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №101
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e6e9d64ed626f60a3ffd292c69972ab7a035117e.jpg[/img]

Today, we’ve rounded up and will be going over some of the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past few weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check out the changelog section on our website.

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Claiming rewards[/h2]
Many of you reported a bug related to the free Battle Pass reward levels. Essentially this bug meant that the rewards in these levels couldn’t be claimed immediately, even though the level was unlocked and the previous reward was already claimed. We’ve fixed this bug, meaning you’ll be able to get Battle Pass rewards instantly without any delays! 

[h2]Missing T-34 fragments[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/486d5e66d8e43ef586124deb84f418f44d8bf166.jpg[/img]
When shells hit the joints of the armor plates of the upper frontal part of the T-34 series of tanks, they did not form any fragments. Specifically this meant that hits on the armor overlap around the driver’s hatch and UFP, as well as the beak joint between the UFP and LFP of this tank was less effective. We’ve fixed this problem and the T-34’s armor will now properly form fragments when hit.

[h2]Squad markers now work in Custom Battles[/h2]
The squad marker is a very useful tool when you’re playing in a squad full of your friends (or a random player), allowing you to mark an enemy’s position for them. This works fine in regular battles, but didn’t in Custom Battles. You’ve let us know about this, so we’ve  added the squad marker to custom battles! 

[h2]Vapor cloud positioning [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6bc38712dd492970fb0380670da635a333bee77b.jpg[/img]
When Mach speed is reached, a vapor cloud, also called the Prandtl-Glauert effect, forms around the aircraft. However, there was a bug that caused this vapor cloud to display in an incorrect position — for many aircraft, it could even be seen in the cockpit while in first-person view. We took a closer look at this issue and have corrected the position, moving it closer to the tail of the aircraft, ensuring it won’t be displaced any longer. 

[h2]Kopyo radars [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0f4fb7489ed7f4e68682d20f5f55c2643c4ad586.jpg[/img]
We found a bug in the operation of the Kopyo-21 and Kopyo-25 radars. If the player’s aircraft was not flying parallel to the ground — for example, it was banking or started to dive or pitch up — then instead of the enemy in the radar’s coverage area, it would capture an empty space. This bug has now been fixed! 

[h2]Sight settings[/h2]
We’re continuing to refine tank sights and their settings. In the last It’s Fixed, we mentioned some related fixes, and since then we’ve fixed some other things. For example, if you had the “Ready indicator” turned on in your tank sight and fired an autocannon, the indicator would constantly blink. Another one in the Sight Settings menu, the on/off setting in the “Reticle Parameters” section did not turn off the text size setting. Both of these issues have been fixed. 

There were also some bugs when moving elements around. For example it was possible to drag the Rangefinder, Gun ready and Bullet type options to the bottom of the screen behind the map preview boxes, causing them to be unable to be moved around without reopening the settings window. Lastly, when zooming in, the range marks in the sight stretched vertically. These have been fixed too.

Thank you for your feedback and reports that allowed us to quickly resolve these issues!

[h2]That’s not all[/h2]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in separate patchnotes. In the “Favorite Vehicles” showcase you can now select a mode, the landscape no longer leaves too “harsh” shadows on the water, and the mechanics of volumetric shells now work again in regular battles! 



[h1]Today's update: Update 2.43.0.68[/h1]

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Su-33[/b] —  a bug where the under-fuselage pylon was taken into account when calculating the combat load of the wing has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/J8FcJOJKLW5q]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]FFA P-16[/b] — a bug that caused the rockets to have an incorrect firing sequence has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/OMYVWWQ8ljgq]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Z-9W, Z-9WA[/b] — 3rd person camera position has been changed. Prior to that the rocket sight was sometimes located beyond the screen limits when zoomed in. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/q5dQNkW1xEKZ]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Luchs A2[/b] — a bug that caused the vehicle to be left without a driver after a crew member was knocked out and swapped position has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/simMskvu0Oey]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Sd.Kfz.234/1[/b] — a bug that caused the vehicle to be left without a driver after a crew member was knocked out and swapped position has been fixed. 
[*] [b]MBT-70[/b] — a bug that caused the incorrect display of the amount of ammunition for the 20 mm cannon has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/5MGe5qLWKfSx]Report[/url]). The amount of ammunition for the 20 mm cannon has been reduced from 2000 to 750.
[*] [b]MBT-70[/b] — the 20 mm cannon depression and elevation angles have been corrected. Previously it was possible for the gun to pass through the optics cover. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/pSE0XtHHqx22]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]VK 45.01 (P)[/b] — vehicle mass has been reduced from 57 to 52.5 tons. 
[b]Source:[/b] [i]Wichtige Daten einzelner Panzerfahrzeuge.[/i]
[*] [b]12.7 mm M2HB machine gun[/b] — a bug with the lack of machine gun overheating functionality has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/PvpzO3y4rUj7]Report[/url]). Time to jam when firing continuously has been adjusted.
[*] [b]12.7 mm M2HB machine gun[/b] — the amount of ammunition in the belt has been reduced from 200 to 100. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/f6ejx6wFzeN8]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Freccia, CV 90 Mk.IV[/b] — the Janus commander sight now has a magnification of 2.5x-10x on both of these vehicles. 
[*] [b]BMP-2MD, BMP-2M, BMP-2[/b] — speed on water has been reduced from 10 km/h to 7 km\h. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/4scqfVeV0EPc]Report[/url]). 
[b]Source:[/b] [i]Боевая машина пехоты БМП-2. Техническое описание и инструкция по эксплуатации. Часть 1.[/i]
[*] [b]Matilda III[/b] — vehicle mass has been reduced from 27.3 to 25.4 tons. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/nPuaz8ezvdAx]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]VBCI-2 (MCT30)[/b] — vehicle mass has been reduced from 32 to 27 tons. The turning diameter of the vehicle has been changed from 22 to 17 meters. The names of the transmission and engine have been added to X-ray mode.
[*] [b]ZiS-30[/b] — transmission gear ratio values have been adjusted.
[*] [b]Chi-Ri[/b] — transmission gear ratio values ​​have been adjusted. Reverse speed has been increased from 8.4 km/h to 12.5 km/h. 
[b]Source:[/b] [i]チリ車説明図, 1945.3.1.[/i]
[*] [b]Chi-Ri[/b] — the 37 mm cannon ammunition capacity has been reduced from 120 to 102 rounds. The machine gun ammunition capacity has been increased from 3000 to 5000 rounds. Vehicle mass has been reduced from 41 to 37 tons.

Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

tags.bug: Many of you reported a bug related to the free Battle Pass reward levels. Essentially this bug meant that the rewards in these levels couldn’t be claimed immediately, even though the level was unlocked and the previous reward was already claimed. We’ve fixed this bug, meaning you’ll be able to get Battle Pass rewards instantly without any delays!

When shells hit the joints of the armor plates of the upper frontal part of the T-34 series of tanks, they did not form any fragments. Specifically this meant that hits on the armor overlap around the driver’s hatch and UFP, as well as the beak joint between the UFP and LFP of this tank was less effective. We’ve fixed this problem and the T-34’s armor will now properly form fragments when hit.

tags.feature: You’ve let us know about this, so we’ve added the squad marker to custom battles!

tags.bug: However, there was a bug that caused this vapor cloud to display in an incorrect position — for many aircraft, it could even be seen in the cockpit while in first-person view. We took a closer look at this issue and have corrected the position, moving it closer to the tail of the aircraft, ensuring it won’t be displaced any longer.

We found a bug in the operation of the Kopyo-21 and Kopyo-25 radars. If the player’s aircraft was not flying parallel to the ground — for example, it was banking or started to dive or pitch up — then instead of the enemy in the radar’s coverage area, it would capture an empty space. This bug has now been fixed!

For example, if you had the “Ready indicator” turned on in your tank sight and fired an autocannon, the indicator would constantly blink. Another one in the Sight Settings menu, the on/off setting in the “Reticle Parameters” section did not turn off the text size setting. Both of these issues have been fixed.

There were also some bugs when moving elements around. For example it was possible to drag the Rangefinder, Gun ready and Bullet type options to the bottom of the screen behind the map preview boxes, causing them to be unable to be moved around without reopening the settings window. Lastly, when zooming in, the range marks in the sight stretched vertically. These have been fixed too.

tags.feature: In the “Favorite Vehicles” showcase you can now select a mode, the landscape no longer leaves too “harsh” shadows on the water, and the mechanics of volumetric shells now work again in regular battles!

notes.title: Meet The Last Legionnaire, the 18th Season of the Battle Pass!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/efc106a5f11a991e7bc787e18a339f97fd4622e5.png[/img]

The new Battle Pass season celebrates the French Foreign Legion, a military unit made up mostly of foreigners. This season’s top reward is the M46 Patton medium tank — Pattons were the last foreign tanks used by France, hence the name of The Last Legionnaire! 

To receive Battle Pass rewards, you’ll need to regularly log into the game and complete tasks and challenges to progress. Each level of the Battle Pass will earn you a reward, be it a player icon, loading screen, title, decals, decorations, or premium vehicles!

[quote][b]Please note:[/b] We’ve created a trophy for premium vehicles that includes three Battle Pass rewards from previous seasons that were not available on the marketplace, as well as one event vehicle. Opening this trophy will guarantee you either the Type T-51a, Voroshilov, LVT-4/40 or Type K-8 No.13i, if you don’t have them currently. If you have them all, you’ll receive Silver Lions and a “Collector Golden Battles Wager” instead.[/quote]

[h1]Collector Golden Battles Wager[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4a11f203af4167778add14bcd08ae4f38dcf5ac0.jpg[/img]

The maximum reward for this wager is 1,000 Golden Eagles. To receive it, you need to win 12 battles using rank III and higher vehicles while destroying at least one player vehicle in each match. If you lose your match or don’t destroy a player three times, the wager will be over and the reward corresponding to the progress made will be given to you.

[h1]Meet Season 18 of the Battle Pass![/h1]

[h3][quote][b]When:[/b] January 22nd until April 23rd.[/quote][/h3]

[h2]This Season’s Rewards![/h2]

A new season means a new set of rewards! The full list can be found in the Battle Pass window or on our Wiki. Here are the main ones for Season 18:

[h2]Trophy containing previous vehicles[/h2]
[b]Get vehicles from past Battle Passes or events: Type T-51a, Voroshilov, LVT-4/40 or Type K-8 No.13[/b]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a8ffc530093a1edf229cd4175b507656b3d0ed21.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/16292427965fb98c739b6ff242f728808b5eebde.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b81d795ee4b68ed16962238b88255bb33291109d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4f2cecfc648fe29b175ccd39ea11c237c4fc76f1.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

Opening this trophy will give you one vehicle from the list. If you have them all, you’ll receive Silver Lions and a “Collector Golden Battles Wager” instead.

[h2]SB2C-5 (Thailand)[/h2]
[b]A Premium Dive Bomber for  Japan at Rank III[/b]

A high-speed bomber with good secondary weapons at its rank. Various bombs and torpedoes, rockets and machine gun pods make the SB2C-5 relevant in any mode!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/501688597272854581]More details here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0a6e2ab15904d55cce4f2282cb53bbb7f3ba7479.jpg[/img]

[h2]M46 Patton (France)[/h2]
[b]A Premium Medium Tank for France at Rank IV[/b]

The M46 Patton in service with France is an agile and mobile sniper with an excellent range of shells to use in various combat situations.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/501688597272854599]More details here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1a10589c32c563d95c94c6743fad7cc22462a53f.jpg[/img]


[h2]Decals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6d7799d75f6f691bc2233876761d360b1cee5775.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]Emblem of the Legion Engineers[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Emblem of the 1st Cavalry Regiment[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1a50b1fb7cc38c6a2b202175b3cd267ecd2af736.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]Emblem of the 1st Regiment of the Foreign Legion[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Emblem of the 1st Legion Airborne Regiment[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]


[h2]Decorations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2e598ab88f913c843a296d7c5ff4b7ee40757895.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]MAS 49/56 (ground forces)[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Anti-tank rocket launcher (France) (ground forces)[/b][/td]  
        [td][b]Towed mortar (France) (naval)[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Profile Icon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/89ee1323f5be88007655103b3c9c0ed602f1deb4.png[/img]
[b]Foreign Legion Sapper[/b]


[h2][quote][url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/battlepass/bp_18_season style=button]All Rewards and Challenges for Season 18[/url][/quote][/h2]

[h3]About the Battle Pass[/h3]

[h3][quote]If you’ve got two Coupon Upgrades from stages in the previous season, then you can claim the new Battle Pass for free! Exchange them in the purchase menu of The Last Legionnaire season.
[/quote][/h3]

The Battle Pass is a seasonal event where players can earn many rewards, from Silver Lions and boosters to exclusive season prizes: decorations, profile icons and premium vehicles. The rules are simple: you earn progress points and use them to unlock new stages, earning valuable prizes in the process. 

You can unlock new stages and receive awards at any time during the season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/318c275070116f5d9abc04bd89c196c075a79e2d.jpg[/img]
You can access the “Battle Pass” window through the promo block on the right side of the hangar screen.

[h3]How to participate[/h3]
[b]Play[/b]
[list]
[*] You get progress points every day for entering the game.
[*] From 1 to 5 points.
[/list]
[b]Complete Battle Tasks[/b]
[list]
[*] You can check your Battle Tasks in the game. Complete them and receive progress points.
[*] From 2 to 5 points.
[/list]
[b]Complete Season Challenges[/b]
[list]
[*] One Challenge is available at the start of the season. Every week you get a new one, while three more can become available by unlocking stages.
[*] 30 points.
[/list]
[b][url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Battle_Pass_Seasons style=button]Learn more about the Battle Pass[/url][/b]

notes.title: Server Update 17.01.25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ba707fdb4d07c72785f6d6a71bbe8b43ce0b2ed1.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Aircraft[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]J7W1[/b] — engine characteristics and the effect of the airspeed pressure at the altitude limit have been brought to the parameters of a similar engine, found on the A7M2. Max speed has been set to 740 km/h at 9200 m at 100% thrust. Weight has been adjusted and an issue that caused the landing gear elements to be visible through the wing in turns has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/LQKADMtIXk7C]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Rafale C F3[/b] — turn speed has been adjusted according to available video materials by ～ +0.5...0.7 g/s. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/6dKurgoa95XA]Report[/url]).
[*] Rafale C F3 — landing roll has been reduced. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/MzLpm6gU4Y5p]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]EF-2000, Typhoon FGR.4, F-2000A[/b] — the RWR band coverage range has been extended to include K-band. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/shubLlMRGW7w]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]F-15 (all variants)[/b] — a bug that caused the amount of specific types of countermeasures to show up on the MFD weaponry screen as the maximum possible amount instead of 0 if the player had taken 0 countermeasures of this type into battle has been fixed. notes.title: Battle Pass Vehicles: M46 Patton (France)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/91174e6e38163e1cb6ddc11ddbf2ea57fce220c1.gif[/img]

Meet the M46 Patton that saw service with France! Today, we’ll take a look at the main reward for the next Battle Pass, The Last Legionnaire!

[h2][b]M46 Patton:[/b] A Premium Medium Tank for France at Rank IV[/h2]
At a glance:
[olist]
[*] Strong HEATFS and APHE shells.
[*] Good protection at the front of the turret.
[*] Effective mobility. 
[/olist]
[b]Vehicle History[/b]
[expand type=details]
In 1945, a program to create a new medium tank for the U.S. Army based on the M26 Pershing was launched. The Detroit Arsenal built 10 prototypes with a new engine, slightly longer chassis and a modernized M3A1 gun with a new muzzle brake. The prototypes were submitted for testing in 1949, but even before being completed, the vehicle was approved for serial production and standardized as the M46 General Patton medium tank. M46 tanks took part in the Korean War and were also supplied to European countries in the 1950s, in particular France and Belgium. 
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2eea6f9b0839fde4ff35a130ded8dee86ac236aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introducing the M46 Patton! [/h2]

The premium M46 Patton is joining France as the main tank reward in The Last Legionnaire Battle Pass season! This tank is exceptionally versatile, allowing it to be used in any role during battle and will also make for an excellent addition to several French lineups, helping to add some variety and speed up research due to its premium status. Let’s take a closer look! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/bbd13a18b192a07395bd06e3655d30e61f72fd89.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e10c83f5d0cfa55f47d07719533f4a1cdd0f6cab.jpg[/img]

In general, the M46 is slightly superior to its direct ancestor, the M26, in several key aspects. One area where it has improved is its engine — although the top forward speed hasn’t changed, the horsepower has improved significantly. This extra power means the M46 can reverse slightly faster and can boast greater overall agility, making it fairly effective in this regard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a5773c2da0b717d1b6afbffadaa6b82e0b90cc60.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2d2a9eaf9d4f6607c4360933342a510522593d10.jpg[/img]

The M46 uses a functionally identical cannon to the M26, keeping its horizontal and vertical aiming angles, however it offers increased firepower. Aside from a new muzzle break, the most important addition is the new HEATFS shell, featuring high muzzle velocity and good penetration of up to 305 mm at all distances. Since the M46 participates in battles where ERA and spaced armor are rarer, the HEATFS shell is reasonable to use as the main round on this tank. Although the APCBC shell is best used for those side shots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/97b9949ef53c761cf68a2842b2c60ef4051357b3.jpg[/img]

Moving onto armor now, where the M46 has not undergone any significant changes compared to the M26. The turret front and mantlet area can easily withstand hits from weaker tank guns, and while the hull is relatively unimpressive front-on, when angled it can defeat many of the weaker guns around the rank as well. The internals however are fairly cramped and full of ammo, with a frontal penetration usually resulting in an ammo explosion or the loss of most crew members. The new shell and engine does make the M46 significantly more versatile than the M26, the mobility comfortably allows for rushes and flanks, while the HEATFS rounds make sniping defensively at long range much more viable. There’s rarely a situation the M46 can’t deal with.

That’s it for today! You can get the premium French M46 Patton for completing challenges in the upcoming Battle Pass season, The Last Legionnaire that starts on January 22nd. Stay tuned, we’ll soon announce the full list of details and rewards for this new season! 

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

notes.title: Battle Pass Vehicles: SB2C-5 (Thailand)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c7336dcd9eba796afb89bc35a5b09be5a4c9b35c.gif[/img]

Meet the American Helldiver dive bomber in service with the Royal Thai Air Force, joining the game as the aircraft reward in The Last Legionnaire Battle Pass season!

[h2][b]SB2C-5:[/b] A Premium Dive Bomber for Japan at Rank III[/h2]
At a glance:
[list]
[*] Excellent range of bombs.
[*] Decent maneuverability.
[*] 20 mm offensive guns.
[*] Air brake.
[/list]
[b]Vehicle History[/b]
[expand type=details]
The SB2C-5 was the last production variant of the Curtiss Helldiver two-seat carrier-based dive bomber. The aircraft was produced in both the U.S. and Canada under license during the final stages of World War II, however did not have time to participate in combat over the Pacific Ocean. In the post-war period, the SB2C-5 modification was actively exported, including to Thailand, where they were used during the suppression of the uprising in the north of the country during the 1950s.
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5a56ba3f1ceca62eea340bcb235d2bea8821da5f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introducing the SB2C-5![/h2]

In The Last Legionnaire, a brand-new Battle Pass season, you’ll have the opportunity to get the excellent SB2C-5 premium dive bomber, well known to you if you’ve played the US or French aviation tree. This aircraft is an invaluable assistant in Ground Battles and a classic in War Thunder Air Battles, so let’s take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/85dc04d6588c8583a30c757ecfa16886c1e9580d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7c83e86c7f49c237e6db78717a55f3b8bc3f2433.jpg[/img]

The SB2C-5 dive bomber is going to offer an excellent choice of bombs for Japan at rank III. There’s two types of torpedoes, rockets, machine gun pods, and most importantly 250 to 1000 lb bombs (high-explosive) and 1000 to 1600 lb armor-piercing bombs. As for guns, the SB2C-5 features two 20 mm autocannons in the wings with a total of 400 rounds. These guns play an important role in tackling enemy aircraft especially at the lower ranks and make this aircraft a worthy choice in any game mode. Despite this, ultimately this aircraft is best in Ground Battles, where it will still be capable of taking out lightly armored vehicles with the cannons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e7ec50f7426d0281eddc9a832bd94ee98fb0f39f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3622f05548e65705d8838e8fa1c2f56b265637b5.jpg[/img]

Despite having a poor rate of climb and lower maximum speed, the SB2C-5 still has the advantage of spawning in the air in Air Battles thanks to its class as a bomber. This allows it to gain sufficient speed to dive on enemy AI ground targets, also being able to use the air brake to avoid ripping the wings. With minimal maneuvering, the SB2C-5’s speed can be maintained for quite a long time, or you can utilize its decent maneuverability, choosing to hunt other bombers and attack aircraft instead of going for ground targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4d311ee5a9342d740fc81e2073dd021830d012ff.jpg[/img]

The Last Legionnaire Battle Pass season starts on January 22nd and very soon we’ll be letting you know about the other rewards coming in this season. Keep an eye out for that!

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

notes.title: Get the FV4030/3 in the Enter the Serpent Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/78202139cb5d1581aea097818b0e8dd9144746e3.png[/img]

Welcome to War Thunder’s first event of 2025! January 29th marks the Lunar New Year, and this year it’s the Year of the Snake! Celebrate it in this event, which features themed decals, a decoration and a camouflage for the new and obtainable British FV4030/3 Shir 2 medium tank.

[quote][h3]From January 17th (11:00 GMT) until February 4th (11:00 GMT), earn mission points in Ground Battles, unlock stages and receive rewards![/h3][/quote]

[h2]FV4030/3 Shir 2 — An Event Vehicle Medium Tank for Great Britain at Rank VI[/h2]
The FV4030/3 Shir 2 is a modified and modernized Chieftain, designed in Great Britain to meet the needs of Iran. Featuring a 1,200 HP engine, the FV4030/3 can reach speeds of up to 56 km/h and can fire the L23 APFSDS round from its 120 mm gun. Additionally with a laser rangefinder, this tank is good for long-range engagements! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a65d17983b1b8e84e87842a9a80a1f332c605a07.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Snake”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Year of the Snake”[/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Ouroboros”[/b] decoration[/td] 
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]“Year of the Snake”[/b] camouflage (screenshot will be added at a later date) 

Among the rewards in the event is also this chest. When opened, there is a chance to receive one of the following items:
[list]
[*] 50,000 - 100,000 Silver Lions
[*] Silver Lion and Research Point boosters
[*] Random Wagers and Orders
[*] Universal Backups (1 - 3) 
[*] A random camouflage for a vehicle you own
[*] 1 day of Premium Account
[/list]

[h2]How to get all rewards[/h2]
Each stage can be obtained for [b]45,000[/b] mission points, where every new stage obtained will give you a new reward.

[quote][b]Please note:[/b] After finishing a stage, you need to collect the reward manually. To do this, click on your name in-game, go to “Enter the Serpent” and click the “Get Reward” button.[/quote]

You’re able to earn mission points in [b]Ground Battles[/b] at Rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic and Simulator Battles. The number of mission points to complete a stage depends on the game mode and the maximum Rank of the vehicle that you use in battle. There’s a multiplier for earning mission points, which is shown in the task description in-game.  

You can also earn mission points by using event vehicles that are Rank I and II. Event vehicles that can be used have the name of the event that they were obtainable in on their stat card.

[quote][h3]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT on January 19th, 21st, 23rd, 25th, 27th, 29th, 31st and February 2nd. [/h3][/quote]

[h2]Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] For [b]1[/b] Stage: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]2[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]3[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]4[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]5[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]6[/b] Stages: the “Ouroboros” decoration
[*] For [b]7[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]8[/b] Stages: non-tradable coupon for the FV4030/3
[*] For [b]9[/b] Stages: a unique camouflage and 4 random modifications for the FV4030/3
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] You can only receive the modifications if the FV4030/3 is activated on your account.

[h3]Discounts on purchasing stages using Golden Eagles[/h3]
Unfinished stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but if you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will now be significantly reduced. 

Let’s say you have earned 85% of the required mission points to complete a stage, then the price of purchasing this stage will be halved. If you’re near the finish line for a stage and are at 95% progress, then the price will be reduced by five times. For example, if you’ve scored 39,000 mission points, then the price for unlocking this stage will be 499 Golden Eagles. If you’ve scored 43,000 mission points, then you’ll only need to pay 199 Golden Eagles. Remember to keep this in mind if you cannot complete a stage on time!

[h3]The Upgrade for coupon [/h3]
When you complete 8 stages, you’ll receive a non-tradable coupon for the FV4030/3, where using it will immediately activate the vehicle onto your account. If you don’t want the vehicle and would like to sell the coupon on the Market, you’ll need the “Upgrade for coupon” item.

[quote]The “Upgrade for coupon” item can be earned in parallel with the stages throughout the event from January 17th (11:00 GMT) until February 4th (11:00 GMT) for 750,000 mission points.[/quote]

After receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” item, you can convert a non-tradable coupon for the vehicle into a tradable one and sell it on the Market. The tradable coupon can be sold after 6 days from the moment it’s created.

[quote]To make a tradable coupon, select the “Coupon FV4030/3 (Great Britain)” in your inventory and click the “Modify” button.[/quote]

The “Upgrade for coupon” item is valid until 11:00 GMT on February 7th. Until this time, you can use it or exchange it for War Bonds. Afterwards, it’ll disappear from your inventory.

You can track the progress of completing stages and receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” by clicking on your Nickname > Achievements > Enter the Serpent. If you don’t manage to complete a stage on time or would like to purchase a stage, until [b]February 7th[/b] from the Achievements window, you can purchase each stage with Golden Eagles which will give you the corresponding rewards.

notes.title: Pages of History (January): Defender of Leningrad
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/370dffd1aef89abf301b254d89b723cf7ee3cd70.jpg[/img]

In this month’s Pages of History, you’ll be at the center of events that took place in different theaters of war. Iran and Saudi Arabia, the Philippines and East Prussia: take part in battles with the vehicles corresponding to these historic battles and receive prizes. 

[h3][quote]From January 1st until January 31st, you’ll be offered 8 tasks consecutively. Completing each will reward you with a trophy, and completing all of them will earn you a unique player icon.[/quote][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/851732a4051b2aaf6aae5878ef838fc419962f23.png[/img]
[h3]Vasily Antonovich Matsievich[/h3]
Vasily Antonovich Matsievich was an ace pilot who fought in World War II from 1941. The fighter squadron he commanded defended besieged Leningrad from enemy raids and carried out assault raids on Wehrmacht positions. Soon after the siege of Leningrad was lifted, Matsievich was awarded the title of Hero of the Soviet Union for his courage.

You can immediately purchase this profile icon for Golden Eagles until February  3rd, 11:30 GMT without completing tasks. To find it, go to your Nickname → Achievements → Pages of History.

[h2]Trophy reward for each task[/h2]

Completing each individual task will give you a trophy with one of the following rewards:
[list]
[*] 20-50% RP booster for 3-10 battles;
[*] 20-50% SL booster for 3-10 battles;
[*] 3-5 universal backups;
[*] Premium account for 1 day;
[*] A random camouflage for ground vehicles (out of the selection of camouflages currently obtainable in game for completing tasks, or purchasing with Golden Eagles).
[/list]

[h2]Other terms[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tasks are available from 11:00 GMT until 11:30 GMT on the final day of each task.
[*] Tasks can be completed in random battles except for “Assault” mode.
[/list]

[h2]January 1st — January 4th[/h2]
[h3]Operation Bodenplatte[/h3]
On January 1st 1945, German aircraft launched a massive attack on Allied airfields in the Netherlands, hoping to gain air superiority to support the Ardennes counteroffensive. They managed to destroy almost 500 Allied aircraft, but the losses among pilots were minimal, since the attack was sudden and the aircraft were on the ground. The Allies quickly replenished the lost equipment, but the Luftwaffe was unable to recover from the losses in personnel — this was their last strategic operation.

[h2]January 4th — January 7th[/h2]
[h3]Operation Nasr[/h3]
The largest tank battle of the Iran-Iraq War took place from January 5th to 9th 1981. The Iraqis knew that the Iranians were coming and prepared well, burying their tanks up to the turrets. They often practiced this tactic because they were not skilled enough to maneuver in combat, but in this case the swampy terrain played into their hands. The Iranians were ambushed, attacked from the front and flanks — they tried unsuccessfully to break through, then began to maneuver and got stuck in the mud. Operation Nasr, designed to liberate cities in southwestern Iran, completely failed, causing hundreds of vehicles to be lost.

[h2]January 8th — January 11th[/h2]
[h3]Battle for Luzon[/h3]
On January 9th 1945, the Battle of Luzon, the largest island of the Philippine archipelago, began. It lasted until the very end of the war, although the Americans and Filipinos managed to recapture most of the island by March. At the beginning of the battle, 175,000 American soldiers landed on the island, although the landing operation was hampered by attacks from  kamikaze pilots. In late January and early February, the island saw the largest tank battle in the Pacific theater.

[h2]January 12th — January 15th[/h2]
[h3]Operation Blackcock[/h3]
This little-known operation, named after a type of grouse, took place from 13th to 27th January 1945 on the border between the Netherlands and Germany. Having won the Ardennes, the Allies began to advance towards Germany, and in the “Roermond Triangle” between the Ruhr, Wurm and Maas rivers, British forces encountered three lines of German defense. However, the Germans were outnumbered and lacked air support, so their defeat was only a matter of time. Operation Blackcock had been fully achieved.

[h2]January 16th — January 19th[/h2]
[h3]Breaking the Blockade of Leningrad[/h3]
On January 18th 1943, the Red Army broke the blockade of Leningrad, which had been going on since September 1941, as part of Operation Iskra. Although the corridor controlled by the USSR was initially only 8-11 km wide, a highway and a railway were built in the shortest possible time to provide the city with everything it needed and to evacuate people. The Red Army was unable to continue its success, as it was only a year later that the enemy was completely driven away from Leningrad.

[h2]January 20th — January 23rd[/h2]
[h3]Battle of Anzio[/h3]
In December 1943, Allied forces in Italy were stopped by the Gustav Line. In order to bypass the Axis fortifications from the flanks, the Allies carried out an amphibious operation, landing on January 22nd 1944 at Anzio. American General John Lucas, who commanded the operation, did not believe in its success and, instead of using the element of surprise to attack the German from behind, began to fortify himself in the Anzio and Nettuno area. Field Marshal Kesselring transferred all available troops to this area, flooded the Pontine Marshes and pinned the Allies down with continuous artillery fire. A month later, General Lucas was removed from command, and the Battle of Anzio ultimately lasted until June.

[h2]January 24th — January 27th[/h2]
[h3]Heiligenbeil Pocket[/h3]
On January 26th 1945, the 4th Army of the Wehrmacht made a final attempt to break out of the encirclement near Heiligenbeil in East Prussia (now Mamonovo in the Kaliningrad region). The attempt ended in failure, as on January 30th, the ring of Soviet troops closed, and the Germans could only hold their positions and evacuate civilians across the Baltic Sea (the high command forbade the evacuation of the military). On March 29th, the pocket was liquidated.

[h2]January 28th — January 31st[/h2]
[h3]Battle of Khafji[/h3]
Throughout the second half of January 1991, the international coalition effectively attacked Iraq from the air. Saddam Hussein wanted to engage his opponents in ground battles, where the Iraqi army had more experience due to the recently concluded Iran-Iraq War. On January 29th 100 Iraqi tanks crossed the border between Kuwait and Saudi Arabia to attack the forces of the international coalition and take the city of Ras al-Khafji. The city’s population had been evacuated in advance. Throughout January 30th, the Iraqis managed to defend the city, but on February 1st they were forced to retreat. This battle demonstrated the importance of air support in modern warfare.

notes.title: It’s fixed! №100
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ed23ae0a6747f756a8a70ac5714f83772d04e754.png[/img]

Welcome to the 100th edition of “It’s fixed!” Today, we’ll be going over the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game since the release of the Storm  Warning  update. Let’s take a look!

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Better profile customization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/69f15d5dd05cedc03dca315c892ab8c34758dcd2.jpg[/img]

We keep expanding your profile customization options. Now you can choose a player icon frame and a profile backgound, and there’s also a number of backgrounds and frames available for all players.

Profile showcases have received a number of fixes and improvements since their recent launch. Now all UI elements fit into the screen at “Medium” and “Large” interface scale. In the “Favorite vehicle” showcase, vehicle search by name now works. Searching for your favorite vehicle is now easier thanks to the option to sort the vehicle list by the number of respawns.

We’ve also fixed a number of errors related to showcase editor. One of them closed the editor without saving if you clicked on a showcase, another prevented the editor from launching, and the third one made the Esc key to close the entire profile menu instead of the editor.


[h2]Ground Vehicle sight settings[/h2]
Several bugs have been fixed relating to the ground vehicle sight settings menu. Reloading the sight caused the color values in the “Rangefinder” section and options’ values in the “Bullet Type” section to reset. Additionally, the settings in the “Bullet Type” section contained two black color options.

Thank you for reports that helped us find and fix these errors faster!

[h2]Falling mines[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/eeb4a6c05f2a753ab296777cc2c747a82e8fc58f.jpg[/img]

We’ve discovered erratic behavior in mines dropped from aircraft: when observed from a naval vessel, they fell at an irregular speed, slowing down as they approached the water surface. At the same time, the aircraft that dropped the mine observed no issues. Now their points of view are in sync and correct.


[h2]Large caliber artillery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5dfe20c74518819e7df8fc630b7cfe3f3a7dd664.jpg[/img]

In the Storm Warning update we added a large caliber howitzer PzH 2000 to the game (two variants). It required a number of fixes: in the the armor of the hull sides, in the shapes and locations of internal modules, and in the folding animation of the shield plate. As part of its fixes we’ve added an autoloader module to the PzH 2000, and also Sholef and PzH 2000 have received the first-stage ammo stowage mechanic.

[h2]That’s not all[/h2]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in separate patchnotes. Target markers no longer appear outside of boundaries of the radar indicator when in TWS mode, and torpedo trails appear properly at the low setting of water effects quality.


[h1]Today's update: Update 2.43.0.38[/h1]

[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] JAS39A — a bug that caused HMD to overlap with HUD has been fixed.
[*] F-2000A, Typhoon FGR.4 — a bug with IRST search pattern that sometimes caused the IRST to not see a target has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/ZDBeRSwcKGrq]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]PzH 2000 (all variants)[/b] — autoloader module has been added. The bug which caused the vehicle to drown in shallow water has been fixed.
[*] [b]ADATS (all variants)[/b] — maximum single-plane overload of MIM-146 missile has been increased to 42G (60G dual-plane). ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bV3p1UrBSOcv]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]RDF/LT[/b] — the engine sound has been changed from gas turbine to a diesel one. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Eoue6cQHRrfq]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that sometimes caused the scout hydroplane to be invulnerable has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/7BdstURg5qzb]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Ersatz Yorck[/b] — armor scheme has been corrected: armored decks, transverse bulkheads, casemate armor, barbettes and other elements have been reconfigured and the correct thicknesses and types of armor have been assigned. Ship type in the card has been corrected. Locations of internal modules have been corrected, crew number has been increased, ammo magazines have been added.
[*] [b]Arkhangelsk[/b] — armor scheme has been corrected: armored belts, armored decks, transverse bulkheads and barbettes have been remodeled, armor thicknesses have been corrected. The number and locations of ammo magazines have been corrected.
[*] [b]HMS Rodney[/b] — armor scheme and modules locations have been corrected. Armored belts, armored decks, barbettes anti-torpedo bulkheads, transverse bulkheads and armor plates of main caliber guns have been remodeled, correctly placed and have received the correct thicknesses.
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Vehicles in the “Favorite vehicle” showcase configuration window are now automatically sorted by the number or spawns on them from highest to lowest to make search easier.
[*] A bug that caused “Track progress” buttons for night battles rewards to be inoperative has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Y0vJGaCxPW7Q]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused ready indicator to not show up in ground vehicle sight settings window when reload indicator was off has been fixed.
[*] A bug when using search that caused the automatic scroll to vehicle in the tech tree to not work has been fixed.
[*] A bug when searching the vehicle in the tech tree that caused the mouse drag-and-drop to not work on a found vehicle has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused a lack of thousands separator for rating and place in the leaderboard to be missing in the “Battle-Hardened” showcase has been fixed.
[*] A bug in the “Battle-Hardened” showcase that caused the shown ratio to be kills to spawn and not kills to death has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/VWHvsgKCv4tA]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that sometimes caused fonts in the drop-down menus of showcase settings to be different sizes has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the tooltip on “Track progress” button in the “Decals” window of player profile to be missing has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list][*] Gaijin.Net achievements are now available on consoles.

[hr][/hr]

Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from [url=Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the bug reporting service, forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.]the bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.

notes.title: The Holiday Crate for Golden Eagles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2b8a214c2945cef9264b83f12abcb95191f197a3.png[/img]

We’re pleased to present you with a Holiday Crate, available in the in-game Item Shop! This crate can only be purchased with Golden Eagles, and inside it is a large set of useful items: Premium Account, Silver Lions, universal backups and boosters, premium vehicles and also all vehicles that have ever been sold for Golden Eagles or Warbonds that aren’t currently obtainable in-game or on the Market (full list below).
[quote]The Holiday Crate can be purchased for 999 Golden Eagles in the in-game store from December 25th (11:00 GMT) until January 14th (11:00 GMT).[/quote]
Picking up a Holiday Crate is a bargain! If you have opened enough crates, you’ll be guaranteed to receive talismans and premium vehicles. And that’s not all, as the average value of the crate contents are almost one and a half times the price of the crate itself!

Plus, after opening a specific number of crates, you’ll receive memorable additional rewards:

notes.title: Update 2.43.0.31
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6c7b3b38cc1bcc2b7e87a884c53644562f353814.jpg[/img]


[h1]Aircraft[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Typhoon GR.4, EF-2000, F-2000A[/b] —  empty mass has been  reduced. Previously the empty mass included the weight of countermeasures.
[*] [b]EF-2000[/b] — a bug that caused the “Targeting Optics View” control to not switch the view to the targeting pod camera has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/LqEu4m9QkXkV]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Typhoon GR.4, EF-2000, F-2000A[/b] — IR AAM seeker indication has been added to HUD and HMD.
[*] [b]Rafale C F3[/b] — IR AAM seeker indication has been added to HUD.
[*] [b]Rafale C F3[/b] — the number of datalink channels for the MICA-EM missiles has been increased to 8. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/1WGRQX5VhvhJ]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Rafale C F3[/b] — MAWS dead zones in vertical coverage have been removed.
[*] A bug that caused mines dropped from aircraft to slow down when approaching the water has been fixed.
[*] A bug in Air Simulator Battles that caused some aircraft to sometimes roll backwards when spawning on airfield after rearming has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/x5Gpki1exVRt]Report[/url]).
[/list]

[h1]Naval Vessels[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]HMS Rodney [/b]— the ship flooding system has been fixed. Now flooded bow compartments don’t critically impact the trim, so the ship’s bow doesn’t dive as much blocking the fire of main caliber guns.
[/list]
[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] A bug that sometimes caused the vehicles acquired from the “Snow globe” to be marked as already owned even if the player just got them for the first time has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Wjjq41zKEHII]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused the vehicle search by name in “Favorite vehicle” profile showcase to not work has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/MQv3yQezMZ6N]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused the Caps Lock state indicator on the login screen to differ from the actual state of the key if the Caps Lock had been switched when the game wasn’t in the focus has been fixed.
[/list]

Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]
