notes.title: It’s fixed! №98
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5bdc113df254997fa7ad564ca8c35c088c9d6b83.jpg[/img]

Today, we’ll be going over the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game over the past 2 weeks. Let’s take a look!

[quote]Have feedback? Feel free to leave it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/3/4699035108378161531/]in this thread here[/url] or in the comments of this news post![/quote]

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder?from-ts=1704096000&to-ts=1722495599]our community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]New Naval Loading Screen Tips[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2c56b374971ea08f4ac6ea75796b0b9f787d133f.jpg[/img]
Loading screens are not just for loading the game, but can also be a source of useful information. We’ve added a bunch of tips dedicated to naval battles now. They’ll remind you about mines and depth charges, situational effectiveness of high-explosive and armor-piercing shells, features of early battleships, the ability to capture points with reconnaissance aircraft and many other things that’ll be useful for new players.
 
[h2]Sound Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c135d63f5081853e98e2be78e14acb47e71b0c64.jpg[/img]
Some helicopter pilots took advantage of the ability to adjust the volume of their own engine so that when they were in cockpit view and opened the doors, they could orient themselves to what was happening around them by ear. This gave them an unintended advantage, so now with the doors open, the sound of the helicopter rotor is independent from their engine volume settings and enough to mask external sounds. 

We also received a handful of feedback from players about the engine sound of the CV9030FIN, CV9035DK and CV9035NL being unrealistic, too harsh and lacking the diesel engine howl, so we’ve improved it. Have a listen to how they sound now!

[h2]An Additional Tutorial Mission for Testing Weaponry and Equipment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/da31524631e4292291ecf72dd82cc423bf97c740.jpg[/img]
We recently added tutorial missions for ground vehicles, allowing you to get to know various weapons and equipment better. In today’s update we added another one! This new mission allows you to train with the Strela-10M2 and its surface to air missile with a multi-channel optical homing head. As with all tutorials, you can access these through Battles > Tutorial from the hangar. 

[h2]Optical Thermal Tracking Fix[/h2]
The optical and thermal imaging capture should not be distracted by chaff, but due to a bug this happened when playing SPAAGs and IFV vehicles. We’ve identified a problem here and have fixed it. 

[h2]That’s not all![/h2]
You can find the full list of improvements in our main changelog! Here’s a bit more: the TNT equivalent of HMX-based explosives has been corrected, the torpedo aiming marker no longer disappears after each launch, and target markers have been added to AGM and Guided bomb tutorial missions.


[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4657375543619979097]Update 2.39.0.61[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4534653358951907518]Update 2.39.0.78[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Today's update: Update 2.39.0.83[/h2]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Vilkas[/b] — engine power has been reduced from 815 HP to 720 HP.
[*] [b]ZTZ99A[/b] — a bug that knocked out the crew when the lower frontal plate was fired at with medium-caliber HE shells has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/KkW70S8hNTYj]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused optical thermal tracking of IFVs and SPAAGs to get distracted by chaff has been fixed.
[*] Reduced repair time and decreased durability of  commander sights.
[*] The TNT equivalent of octogen-based explosives has been changed. Octogen (HMX) from 1.59 to 1.656, Okfol from 1.59 to 1.62, Okfol-3.5 from 1.325 to 1.598. 
[b]Sources:[/b] [i]Химия и технология бризантных взрывчатых веществ. Орлова Е Ю, Химическая физика энергонасыщенных материалов. Д.Д. Талин, Основы технологической безопасности производств энергонасыщенных материалов и изделий. Д.Д. Талин.[/i]
[*] A new ground vehicle training mission that allows you to familiarize yourself with weapons and equipment has been added. This mission can be started through the Battles > Tutorial menu from the hangar:
[list]
[*] SAM with multi-channel optical homing head
[/list][/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]F-5E (FCU), AIDC F-5E[/b] — a bug that caused the drop-tanks to not display in x-ray mode has been fixed.
[*] [b]Mi-28NM[/b] — the 9M123 Khrizantema ATGM has been replaced by the 9M123M Khrizantema-VM. The range has been increased from 6 to 9 km. The maximum speed has been reduced from 550 to 400 m/s.
[*] A bug where the sunrise or sunset time would cause the sun to appear below the horizon, visually turning the time of day into night has been fixed. Please note that some cloudy weather may also appear as night, but the sun will be above the horizon. This update does not fix this specific issue. 
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug where there were no waves and the water surface was mirror-like and looked like it was calm in any weather has been fixed.
[*] A bunch of [b]new gameplay and control tips[/b] suggested by players have been added to the loading screen.
[*] [b]Pr. 206, Pr. 206 (Germany), Pr. 206-M[/b] — a bug that blocked torpedo firing when the bridge was destroyed has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]CV9030FIN, CV9035DK, CV9035NL[/b] — the engine sounds have been adjusted and reworked in accordance with  feedback. Previously, the sound was considered unrealistic, too harsh and lacking the diesel engine howl. 
[*] For all helicopters when viewed from the cockpit with the doors open, the sound of the external rotors is now independent of their engine volume settings. Their volume is set to an acceptable average level and is designed to mask external sounds. This is done in order to eliminate open cockpit doors as a way of orientation by hearing.
[/list]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.gaijin.net%2Fissues%2Fp%2Fwarthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

notes.title: T77E1: The Last Cowboy + Skink & Ram II News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/27ec2525d4d40a7e0e0c71a9f0de419b208961d5.gif[/img]

Today we’re very happy to introduce the long awaited T77E1 SPAAG for the American ground forces tree! This addition will be finding its way into a lot of lineups when it arrives as part of the next major update.

[h2][b]T77E1:[/b] An SPAA for the USA at Rank II[/h2]
At a glance:
[list]
[*] Six .50 cals! 
[*] Fast turret traverse and high elevation angles, can fire 85 degrees upwards.
[*] Gunner and Commander are exposed, but both can fire the guns.
[*] Limited anti-tank ability, but great at defeating unarmored vehicles.
[/list]
[b]Vehicle History[/b]
[expand type=details]
Development started in July of 1943, when a new SPAAG based on the M24 Chaffee was requested, a modern design at the time which proved to be a malleable platform for additional development opportunities. A mockup was created in December, and two prototypes were ordered in April of 1944 after some design tweaks. The first prototype was designated as the T77 and arrived at the Aberdeen Proving Ground in July 1945. The second prototype was delivered a little later and featured several differences, enough to warrant a new designation: T77E1. Despite displaying impressive ability for its intended purpose, the conclusion of the war and the introduction of jet aircraft deemed the design ineffective for large-scale future use. While the army pursued additional testing into the early 1950s, nothing came of this development, and the prototypes were likely scrapped shortly after.
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5494aa35c00a4a9c9de3ffeb76645d723eb514e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meet the T77E1![/h2]

This six-shooter prototype will be arriving at the early ranks of the American ground forces tree in the next major update. The USA has been missing some SPAA diversity in the earlier ranks, so we’re very happy that the T77E1 is ready to join the game, and thanks to its more forgiving attributes, it’ll make a fine partner for several strong lineups well beyond its Battle Rating. We also have something to talk about regarding the Skink and Ram II! So, saddle up, and let’s take a closer look. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/713136f9e49ad3e597fde6577079308d32979c07.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4c555aca4d5d8242ffd99b298201493a91991e97.jpg[/img]

The T77E1 ups the firepower drastically from the M16, featuring six M2 .50 cals in the turret complete with 900 rounds of ammunition each, allowing for long bursts of sustained fire. The platform is also impressively equipped for combating low-flying aircraft on the spur of the moment — it can point upwards almost vertically at 85 degrees, in addition to having a fast traverse speed of 65 degrees per second with a top crew! 

Since the internal workings take up a fair bit of room, the gunner and commander are positioned slightly outside of the turret. Their plexiglass housing offers no tangible protection against incoming fire, but as the T77E1 features tandem controls, both crew members can fire the guns, so if the gunner is knocked out the commander can keep firing! While the hull remains functionally identical to the regular M24 Chaffee, the turret protection is reduced. The overall thickness is 12.7 mm, or half an inch — the same thickness as the M18 — enough to withstand small arms fire but not much else. Thanks to the Chaffee hull, the T77E1 maintains the same impressive mobility, allowing it to traverse the map and reposition quickly to remain less predictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/491e780ff50ebf560560fe0c2acc45bb511e7eb2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1dcb0fdef902c0dbdd2c77d4b95634d6785091df.jpg[/img]

The T77E1 will remain a fairly comfortable SPAA to use, its sustained fast traverse speed will make tracking enemy aircraft nice and easy. The six guns will also accommodate for some degree of inaccuracy thanks to their wide spread of fire, meaning enemy aircraft should think twice before a standoff with this one! 

[h2]Skink and M4A5 (Ram II)[/h2]

[b]USA gets:[/b] Skink
[b]Great Britain gets:[/b] Ram II

But that’s not all. In addition to the T77E1, we’ll be adding the much-loved Skink to the American tree in the next major update too! As part of this Canadian exchange, the Ram II will also be added to the British tree as a premium, with this one receiving a unique Canadian skin. 

[h3][b]Both vehicles will not be removed from their current trees.[/b][/h3]

[b]Developer note:[/b] We’d like to note that the addition of the Skink to the American tree is not in place of any other unique vehicle — we have more SPAA planned for the tree and the Skink is just a bonus on top. The Skink will add more gameplay options and diversify lineups for the USA, and the Ram II has been requested for Great Britain for a while now, so this is a great opportunity for them to receive it. 

That’s all from us today, the T77E1 will be arriving with the Skink to the American ground forces tree in the next major update to help keep the skies clear, with Great Britain also receiving the premium Ram II. We’ll see you again for more news on new vehicles and features in the near future, enjoy your matches and see you again soon!

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

notes.title: Mobile Sniper: Boxer MGS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/aea794d21d2be8dc6c88a8081977e17b0a00718b.gif[/img]

The Boxer MGS is one of the latest iterations of the Boxer IFV, originally developed under a German-Dutch joint venture, featuring a larger Belgian turret fitted with a powerful 105 mm main gun.

[h2][b]Boxer MGS:[/b] An Event Vehicle Light tank for Germany at Rank VII[/h2]

At a glance:
[list]
[*] Excellent mobility!
[*] Powerful 105 mm cannon.
[*] Autoloader.
[*] Light protection.
[/list]
[h3]Vehicle History[/h3]
[expand type=details]
Nearly a decade following its entry into service, the Belgian company John Cockerill developed a new modular turret system for the German-Dutch Boxer IFV under a private venture. Although supporting a wide range of armaments, the highlight of the upgrade was the possibility to equip the Boxer with a 105 mm cannon, turning it into a fully fledged fire support vehicle. The aim of the modification was to showcase the upgrade potential of the Boxer to potential customers. As of today, no orders have been placed by potential operators yet.
[/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7da94a4b6c34f3c3083eadd545ddb02dd85b3ee1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meet the Boxer MGS![/h2]
The Boxer MGS is the main reward for the Mobile Sniper event that started today, joining the top rank of the German ground forces tree and expanding the Boxer series of fighting vehicles! This further development of the Boxer brings with it some unique upgrades and tradeoffs, which we’re eager to share with you in today’s devblog. So let’s get right into the details!

For those of you who took part in last winter’s marathon event, you may have got your hands on the nimble Vilkas IFV. Although it introduced the German tree to Spike missiles, the Bushmaster autocannon and offered unrivaled mobility, the Boxer MGS builds upon the Vilkas’ strengths and mixes things up considerably. For instance, the most striking difference can be observed in the different turret featured on the Boxer MGS. Unlike the Vilkas, this variant of the Boxer features a larger, manned turret housing a more powerful 105 mm cannon. Not only does the cannon enable the Boxer to engage even MBTs in long distance gun duels, but its autoloader also ensures that several shots can be put down range before being forced to move switch positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1f34b8b9b45cf9790a3bdd6ebd6d13fec2ae53d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f1fed5ca295ed62b4362cb349ae2355657efc9ff.jpg[/img]

Unlike the Vilkas however, this variant of the Boxer doesn’t come equipped with ATGMs, thus somewhat decreasing the vehicle’s flexibility on the battlefield. As for the available ammo, the Boxer has access to several types of shells, including a HESH round for lighter vehicles and stinging DM63 APFSDS for MBTs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/22941ae7dbfcf897e8d9c7b89e9ca12be834a65c.jpg[/img]

What remains unchanged however, is the vehicle’s protection and, more importantly, its mobility! Just like the Vilkas, the Boxer MGS can reach a top speed of 103 km/h on paved roads, thanks to its powerful 720 HP engine. However, being outfitted with a much larger turret, gun and housing additional crew members means that the weight of the Boxer MGS also increased to 38 tons. As a result, the vehicle’s power-to-weight ratio has decreased, leading to slightly slower acceleration compared to the much lighter Vilkas. Being a wheeled gun platform also puts increased strain on the vehicle when faced with extreme terrain conditions such as deep snow or mud. Therefore, it’s best to stick to firm soil or even roads if you need to move locations quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6fb556c0473df83b03d1da4e319016187015612a.jpg[/img]

The menacing Boxer MGS can be earned during the Mobile Sniper event and will further expand the selection of heavily armed wheeled fighting vehicles for the German ground forces tree. Don’t miss your chance to get this unique IFV to strengthen your top tier vehicle setups! Happy hunting!

[i]Please note that this vehicle’s characteristics may be changed before it is added to the game.[/i]

notes.title: German Unity Day: A Tank and Plane for Golden Eagles, plus a Festive Decal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/281da8a233bc47f59c1c99bdf15bee53472c1a67.jpg[/img]

In 1945, the Allies divided Germany into zones, which later turned into two countries, the GDR and FRG. In 1989, the process of their unification began, officially completing on October 3rd 1990. Since then, this date has been Germany’s main national holiday! 

[h2]The Sea Hawk Mk.100 and the Pz.Sfl.Ic are temporarily available for Golden Eagles![/h2]
The Sea Hawk Mk.100 carrier-based jet fighter and the Pz.Sfl.Ic light tank will be temporarily available for 8,560 and 1,000 Golden Eagles respectively.

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (09:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b] Germany > Aviation / Army > Premium vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9346ab929f5b29d8c33edd3999dee4f7b0bd47dd.jpg[/img]
[h3]About the tank[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Pz.Sfl.Ic]Pz.Sfl.Ic[/url] is good at scouting and capturing points, and even good at being a tank destroyer in experienced hands. It’s ready to penetrate almost any armor, but it’s also quite fragile! It relies on sneaking around using its decent top speed of 56 km/h.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/230795fc3bcab5b183c374e24e77e00bad25358e.png[/img]
[h3]About the aircraft[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Sea_Hawk_Mk.100_(Germany)]Sea Hawk Mk.100[/url] for Germany is a capable of firing air-to-air missiles and use its effective 20 mm cannons in air battles. For ground battles, it’s also a great attack aircraft thanks to its range of bombs and rockets available. 
[/list]

[h2]Get the “German Unity Day 2024” decal! [/h2]
For this day, you’ll be able to get this decal by completing the task below.

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (12:00 GMT).
[b]Task:[/b] Play 3 battles using German vehicles at rank III or higher to receive the “German Unity Day 2024” decal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5c60a747cc48f58663f5ea0fc4744b5f38bf5b6d.png[/img]
[b]“German Unity Day 2024”[/b] decal

[b]Additional details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, [Assault] mode and Helicopter PVE battles.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → German Unity Day.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customization menu.
[/list]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №97
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/bfd33b30aaa72b548a249450023ad361b5fdfc7c.jpg[/img]

Today, we’ll be going over the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game over the past 2 weeks. Let’s take a look!

[quote]Have feedback? Feel free to leave it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/3/4851030327579605245/]in this thread here[/url] or in the comments of this news post![/quote]

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder?from-ts=1704096000&to-ts=1722495599]our community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Countermeasures that divert missiles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9cbe70b143c8fcde193b3704be3cc782f0064e29.jpg[/img]
Players reported strange behavior with laser-guided or semi-automatic missiles. They’d lose control if the vehicle that fired them began firing flares or chaff. This bug rendered many popular ATGMs useless if the helicopter that fired them was forced to use countermeasures to escape return fire. It has now been fixed.

[h2]Damage to helicopter avionics[/h2]
Thanks to player feedback and collected statistics, we’ve found out that the chance of damage to avionics in helicopters that had not yet received detailed internal modules when the fuselage was damaged was too high, so we’ve significantly reduced it.

This is how it works! The high explosive impact of ammunition of calibers that are less than 23 mm and the kinetic impact of ammunition of calibers less than 25 mm will not damage helicopter avionics in principle. This does not apply to shells with radio fuzes, which still effectively destroy various elements of avionics. Ammunition of calibers that are less than 30 mm will almost never knock out all the avionics of a helicopter with a single hit. 

As more helicopters get additional modules, their damage model will become more realistic. Be sure to stay tuned as we’ll let you know when more helicopters get detailed avionics!

[h2]New ground training missions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1bc13758ea2ddc224edb01802bc8a15ce111bd65.jpg[/img]
The list of available training missions is growing. We’ve added tutorials on how to use binoculars, a laser rangefinder and anti-aircraft guided missiles with infrared seekers, both with and without uncaging. 

You can launch these missions under Battle > Tutorial from the hangar. Laser rangefinder training is also available from the vehicle modification research window when you open the corresponding modification there.

[h2]That’s not all![/h2]
You can find the full list of improvements in separate changelogs! Here’s some more: the J-10A received an additional 800 liter drop-tank, which doesn’t replace missiles, the sounds of fires no longer resemble engine sounds, and the aircraft available for research now again display the button for selecting secondary weapons for a test flight.

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4657374909371848251]Update 2.39.0.46[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4657374909374994025]Update 2.39.0.47[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4657374909379487258]Update 2.39.0.49[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4657374909392941706]Update 2.39.0.51[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Today's update: Update 2.39.0.53[/h2]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] New ground training missions have been added that allow you to familiarize yourself with weapons and equipment:
[list]
[*] Laser rangefinder;
[*] SAM with IR seeker with uncaging;
[*] SAM with IR seeker without uncaging;
[*] Binoculars.
[/list]
[*] These new training missions can be found under Battles > Tutorial from the hangar. The laser rangefinder mission can also be launched after receiving this modification via the vehicle modification window. 
[*] Dispersion fields from secondary fragments in [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Tank_ammunition#Solid_Armour-Piercing_Rounds]AP caliber  shells[/url] — the armor penetration of secondary fragments when a shell penetrates at the limits of its armor-piercing capabilities (for example, when a shell penetrates 284 mm of armor when its penetration capability is 286 mm penetration) has been increased. This means that in these cases secondary fragments will now penetrate more inside a tank and do more damage. 
[*] [b]Following the Roadmap:[/b] armor-piercing high-explosive (APHE) shells — the warhead now remains intact after the shell explodes, provided that the mass of the explosive is less than 1.33% of the mass of the shell. This means that in these cases, the warhead will now act as a mini-AP round inside the tank after the initial shell penetrates the armor. 
[*] [b]M830A1[/b] — flight time until self-destruction has been increased from 6 to 9 seconds. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/uTOSCgSf946B]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]MIM146, RB 70 Mk.2, BOLIDE[/b] — a bug that caused the armor penetration on non-normal angles to be lower than it should have been has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/sHIWDcRcO2xi]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Spike LR2 missile[/b] — armor penetration has been increased from 700 to 900 mm. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/crOHk9w4IxuU]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]DKY-1, DTB-1, DTB12-125, 57х438 HE-VT, OTO HE-VT, 76/62 HE-MOM, kulsgr m/90, slsgr m/484, M822, XM884, M830A1, 3UO8[/b] — the arming distance of the radio fuze has been decreased to 200m.
[*] [b]OR-281U, BR-281U, BR-281SP, DKY-1[/b] — external ballistics have been corrected.

Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

tags.bug: Players reported strange behavior with laser-guided or semi-automatic missiles. They’d lose control if the vehicle that fired them began firing flares or chaff. This bug rendered many popular ATGMs useless if the helicopter that fired them was forced to use countermeasures to escape return fire. It has now been fixed.

tags.balance_change:
Thanks to player feedback and collected statistics, we’ve found out that the chance of damage to avionics in helicopters that had not yet received detailed internal modules when the fuselage was damaged was too high, so we’ve significantly reduced it.
This is how it works! The high explosive impact of ammunition of calibers that are less than 23 mm and the kinetic impact of ammunition of calibers less than 25 mm will not damage helicopter avionics in principle. This does not apply to shells with radio fuzes, which still effectively destroy various elements of avionics. Ammunition of calibers that are less than 30 mm will almost never knock out all the avionics of a helicopter with a single hit.
As more helicopters get additional modules, their damage model will become more realistic. Be sure to stay tuned as we’ll let you know when more helicopters get detailed avionics!

tags.feature:
The list of available training missions is growing. We’ve added tutorials on how to use binoculars, a laser rangefinder and anti-aircraft guided missiles with infrared seekers, both with and without uncaging.
You can launch these missions under Battle > Tutorial from the hangar. Laser rangefinder training is also available from the vehicle modification research window when you open the corresponding modification there.

the J-10A received an additional 800 liter drop-tank, which doesn’t replace missiles, the sounds of fires no longer resemble engine sounds, and the aircraft available for research now again display the button for selecting secondary weapons for a test flight.

tags.balance_change: Dispersion fields from secondary fragments in [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Tank_ammunition#Solid_Armour-Piercing_Rounds]AP caliber shells[/url] — the armor penetration of secondary fragments when a shell penetrates at the limits of its armor-piercing capabilities (for example, when a shell penetrates 284 mm of armor when its penetration capability is 286 mm penetration) has been increased. This means that in these cases secondary fragments will now penetrate more inside a tank and do more damage.

Following the Roadmap: armor-piercing high-explosive (APHE) shells — the warhead now remains intact after the shell explodes, provided that the mass of the explosive is less than 1.33% of the mass of the shell. This means that in these cases, the warhead will now act as a mini-AP round inside the tank after the initial shell penetrates the armor.

notes.title: Discounts, Rare Tanks, and a Decal for the National Day of the PRC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c002fde36857f65f48be4a84d3675a59bf6d3ffa.jpg[/img]

Today, the People’s Republic of China turns 75! The official announcement of the formation of the PRC was made on October 1st 1949, and since then this day has become the country’s main national holiday. A flag-raising ceremony takes place in Tiananmen square, cities across the country are decorated with flowers, fireworks are set off, and a series of holidays begins on this day — Golden Week.  

[h2]Chinese aircraft and tank bundles at a 50% discount![/h2]
Looking for some aircraft or tanks on sale? There’s a 50% discount on two bundles in the Gaijin Store: an aircraft one consisting of the J-7D and A-5C, and a tank one consisting of the Type 96A Prototype (ZTZ96A (P)) and the T-69 II G.

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (11:00 GMT).

Can be purchased through the store in-game through Shop > Online Store.

[h3]“Adamant Fortress” Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b33dc214ab3273112fd6402ba22a344c5e41e864.jpg[/img]
This bundle includes:
[list]
[*] Type 69-IIG Pack
[*] Type 96A Prototype Pack
[*] Unique “Adamant Fortress” title
[*] Unique “Great Wall of China” decal
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0519706e6b1d074ce7ae42b2b922140da6482b1a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6a6187ce1f86d9e1776def698d6a7f208183f5fa.png[/img][/url]
[/list]
[h3]“Loong's Awakening” Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/68e66f8848439e8a636bafd05e2c0260f546dda3.jpg[/img]
This bundle includes:
[list]
[*] A-5C Pack
[*] J-7D Pack
[*] Unique “Loong’s Awakening” title 
[*] Unique “J-10” decal
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/91ba5ab4cb1ebc5209cb632fe4aba555eca224e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/29cb2955a7f93d93a034e6839a88edb530190a8d.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[i]Players on all platforms who already own the Type 69-IIG or ZTZ96A (P) can earn the “Adamant Fortress” title and the “Great Wall of China “decal by playing 3 battles with either tank before October 7th.

Players on all platforms who already own the A-5C or J-7D can earn the “Loong's Awakening” title and the “J-10” decal by playing 3 battles with either aircraft before October 7th.[/i]

[h2]The Type 96A Prototype, J-7D and A-5C packs are available at a 30% discount![/h2]
In honor of the anniversary, the above vehicle packs have a 30% discount in the Gaijin Store!

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (11:00 GMT).

Can be purchased through the store in-game through Shop > Online Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/606aa9668ce81d691f340e4f6336091fcac5aa86.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Type 69-IIa and Т-62 №545 are temporarily available at a 30% discount for Golden Eagles![/h2]
These two tanks are available at a 30% discount for 5,866 and 6,111 Golden Eagles respectively.

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (11:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b] China > Army > Premium vehicles.

[b]About these vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Type_69-IIa]Type 69-IIa[/url] is an export tank that’s very popular in the Middle East. This tank features a 100 mm rifled gun from the Type 59 that can fire an APDS, APCBC, HEAT-FS and HE shell. Additionally, this tank has ESS and smoke grenades and a laser rangefinder. And thanks to the slat armor around the turret, it can sometimes survive a hit from HEAT shells!
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/T-62_545_(China)]Т-62 №545[/url] is a Soviet tank that China captured during the Battle for Damansky Island in 1969. It’s well armored, has a powerful gun and has access to powerful APFSDS and HEAT rounds. It’s generally a good universal medium tank!
[/list]

[h2]Get the “National Day of the People's Republic of China 2024” decal![/h2]
For this day, you’ll be able to get this decal by completing the task below.

[b]When:[/b] From today until October 7th (11:00 GMT).
[b]Task:[/b] Play 3 battles using Chinese vehicles at rank III or higher to receive the “National Day of the People's Republic of China 2024” decal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/864f5efe88ebfd8a457546f8cc494f14ac83ace8.png[/img]
[b]“National Day of the People's Republic of China 2024”[/b] decal

[b]Additional details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] You can complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions, [Assault] mode and Helicopter PVE battles.
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → National Day of the PRC.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customization menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Get the Boxer MGS in the Mobile Sniper Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/56ab08c35fb179369e3a7e330ce0c226f58ae7b3.jpg[/img]

Welcome to this new event dedicated to a modern German armored vehicle. Fast, accurate and deadly, the Boxer MGS is the main reward in the Mobile Sniper event!

[quote][h3][b]When:[/b] From October 3rd (11:00 GMT) until October 21st (11:00 GMT), earn mission points in Ground Battles, unlock stages and receive rewards![/h3][/quote]

[h2]Boxer MGS — An Event Vehicle Light Tank for Germany at Rank VII[/h2]

The Boxer MGS is another combat vehicle from the Boxer family. This vehicle is on an all-wheel drive platform which is capable of accelerating the vehicle to speeds of over 100 km/h and features a Cockerill turret with a 105 mm gun and autoloader. The Boxer MGS can fire several types of ammunition, including a shaped-charge round, a HESH round and two APFSDS rounds including the powerful DM63 that can handle the armor of almost any tank at its rank. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ea5eb33222b572bb208303f4a5975437767a214a.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
[td][b]“Sniper Chevron”[/b] decal[/td]         
[td][b]“Born to be a sniper” [/b] decal[/td] 
        [td][b]“Modern Sniper Rifle (Germany)”[/b] decoration[/td] 
    [/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4a75349afd7dc3ce5c4e673ccf6b559046ebc2a7.jpg[/img]
[b]"Demonstration"[/b] camouflage

Amongst the rewards in the event is also this chest, where, when opened, brings the chance to receive one of the following items:
[list]
[*] 50,000 - 100,000 Silver Lions
[*] Silver Lion and Research Point boosters
[*] Random Wagers and Orders
[*] Universal Backups (1 - 3) 
[*] A random camouflage for a vehicle you own
[*] 1 day of Premium Account
[/list]

[h2]How to get all rewards[/h2]
Each stage can be obtained for [b]45,000[/b] mission points, where every new stage obtained will give you a new reward.

[quote][h3][b]Please note:[/b] After finishing a stage, you need to collect the reward manually. To do this, click on your name in-game, go to “Mobile Sniper” and click the “Get Reward” button.[/h3][/quote]

You’re able to earn mission points in [b]Ground Battles[/b] at Rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic and Simulator Battles. The number of mission points to complete a stage depends on the game mode and the maximum Rank of the vehicle that you use in battle. There’s a multiplier for earning mission points, which is shown in the task description in-game.  

You can also earn mission points by using event vehicles that are Rank I and II. Event vehicles that can be used have the name of the event that they were obtainable in on their stat card.

[quote][h3]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT on October 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.[/h3][/quote]

[h2]Rewards are given when you complete a specific number of stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] For [b]1[/b] Stage: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]2[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]3[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]4[/b] Stages: one of the decal rewards
[*] For [b]5[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]6[/b] Stages: the “Modern Sniper Rifle (Germany)” decoration
[*] For [b]7[/b] Stages: trophy with a random reward
[*] For [b]8[/b] Stages: non-tradable coupon for the Boxer MGS
[*] For [b]9[/b] Stages: a unique camouflage and 4 random modifications for the Boxer MGS
[/list]

[h2]Discounts on purchasing stages using Golden Eagles[/h2]
Unfinished stages can be purchased for Golden Eagles, but If you’re significantly close to completing a stage, its price will now be significantly reduced. 

Let’s say you have earned 85% of the required mission points to complete a stage, then the price of purchasing this stage will be halved. If you’re near the finish line for a stage and are at 95% progress, then the price will be reduced by five times. For example, if you’ve scored 39,000 mission points, then the price for unlocking this stage will be 499 Golden Eagles. If you’ve scored 43,000 mission points, then you’ll only need to pay 139 Golden Eagles. Remember to keep this in mind if you cannot complete a stage on time!

[h2]The Upgrade for a coupon [/h2]
When you complete 8 stages, you’ll receive a non-tradable coupon for the Boxer MGS, where using it will immediately activate the vehicle onto your account. If you don’t want the vehicle and would like to sell the coupon on the Market, you’ll need the “Upgrade for coupon” item.

[quote]The “Upgrade for coupon” item can be earned in parallel with the stages throughout the event from October 3rd (11:00 GMT) until October 21st (11:00 GMT) for 750,000 mission points.
[/quote]

After receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” item, you can convert a non-tradable coupon for the vehicle into a tradable one and sell it on the Market. The tradable coupon can be sold after 6 days from the moment it’s created.

[quote]To make a tradable coupon, select the “Coupon Boxer MGS (Germany)” in your inventory and click the “Modify” button.[/quote]

The “Upgrade for coupon” item is valid until 11:00 GMT on October 24th. Until this time, you can use it or exchange it for War Bonds. Afterwards, it’ll disappear from your inventory.

You can track the progress of completing stages and receiving the “Upgrade for coupon” by clicking on your Nickname > Achievements > Mobile Sniper. If you don’t manage to complete a stage on time or would like to purchase a stage, until [b]October 24th[/b] from the Achievements window, you can purchase each stage with Golden Eagles which will give you the corresponding rewards.

notes.title: Update 2.39.0.47
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b1717789dfed71b45d72d2cf294aa4ac70f1af8b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that sometimes caused the binoculars to face East on first use regardless of the third person view direction has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/nD6gl5YiKqJg]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]M1128 Wolfpack[/b] — the ability to control the hydropneumatic suspension has been added. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/977m4QWoJ4N0]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]ZTZ99A[/b] — a bug that caused the equivalent protection to be lower than it should have been has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/ACRCX6pB2UEU]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]CTWV RCV[/b] — area coverage of the the spall liner has been corrected, the spall liner has been divided into more sections.

notes.title: Following the Roadmap: Vehicle Research Bonuses
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/93b5ce987d5a0c4cb729f82ad938d298a49ac708.png[/img]

Today, we’re ready to present to you the final version of the Vehicle Research Bonuses, which has just gone live today! For those of you who participated in the recent testing, the following changes have been made since then:
[list]
[*] The number of battles with a bonus has increased from 3 to 5;
[*] A 25% bonus has been added to ranks I-III;
[*] While a vehicle is considered new, the bonus does not apply to it;
[*] The bonus will stay active for all remaining vehicles in a tree even if you have the top vehicle unlocked;
[*] The bonus now applies to the top vehicle in each nation as well. Due to this we’ve dropped “new nations” in the name of the bonus. It has instead been renamed to Vehicle Research Bonuses.
[/list]
If you didn’t participate in the recent testing or would like a recap, this article explains how research bonuses will work after the changes made from your testing and your feedback.  

[quote][b]In summary:[/b] Each day, an independent research bonus for up to 5 battles will be available for each vehicle type (Army, Helicopters, Aviation, Bluewater, and Coastal) for each nation. The bonus will be available if you have unlocked and purchased a “top” vehicle of the same type in any nation.

Bonus numbers can be seen in the “Table of research bonus numbers for each tree type and rank” table below. The bonus is calculated from the base amount of RP received in the battle and is displayed in the battle results window. The 5 battles with bonuses reset everyday at 00:00 GMT.[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/aff0a545c9df27f55c5e5557bb787ed2283c2d2c.png[/img]

[h2]How do Research Bonuses work?[/h2]
Each nation and type of vehicle (Army, Helicopters, Aviation, Bluewater and Coastal) will each receive a bonus when researching vehicles that are not considered new. This bonus will be active for 5 battles each day if you have researched and purchased a “top” vehicle in one of the respective trees in any nation.

In each tree there are vehicles that are considered “top”. Once you’ve researched and purchased one of these vehicles, you’ll receive research bonuses for that vehicle tree. The size of the research bonus depends on the rank of the vehicle being researched.

[h2]What counts as a “Top” vehicle?[/h2]
A “top” vehicle is (all conditions must be met):
[list]
[*] A researchable vehicle. The following do not count: premium and squadron vehicles,  event vehicles, store pack or marketplace vehicles, and hidden vehicles.
[*] A vehicle that is last in its line in the research tree. If the last in the line is in a group, then the first vehicle is considered the “top” one.
[*] A vehicle that is located at the maximum rank in the research tree.
[*] A vehicle whose maximum Battle Rating among all modes is no more than 2 Battle Rating steps lower than the maximum Battle Rating of this tree. For example, the maximum Battle Rating of France’s aviation is 13.7. 2 steps lower would be 13.0 (13.7 to 13.3, then to 13.0). Meaning a vehicle in this tree below 13.0 even at the maximum rank does not count as a “top” vehicle.
[/list]
You can easily find the “top” vehicle by looking in the tree — it’s connected by an arrow to the new Research Bonus Block at the bottom. If at least one arrow from the “top” vehicle to the research bonus block in the research tree is not red, then the bonus is unlocked in this tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/77d8d11b51cda0abeeae92b267a56baaa8de067d.jpg[/img]

[h2]An example of this feature in use[/h2]
If you’ve purchased the M1A2 SEP V2 in the US Army tree — which is the last rank VIII vehicle here — you’ll get a bonus when researching ground vehicles in all nations. This means that you can research, for example, the Strv 81 with a 50% research point bonus (which is the bonus value for rank V ground vehicles), for the Swedish ground tree for the first 5 battles of each day. 

[h2]Checking which nations you currently have bonuses for[/h2]
To see which nations still have research bonuses for the day, hover over this new block section in each of the Army, Aviation, Helicopters, Bluewater / Coastal fleet trees. In the example below, one battle for US ground vehicles has already been played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/207ed284e3dd3d9085f95cd6a3913655b9307174.jpg[/img]

The daily Research Bonus icon is shown on each nation. Hovering over it will show you which vehicle will receive the bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ff9bdace3709569ba3d204f019bd8ed0cce48ca1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ecdb0f48c26d20c70420e019c53dcf35a1617319.jpg[/img]

If you already have “top” vehicles for several types, nations or trees, this list can quickly become very large. In this case you can disable the “Show the remaining bonus in headers” option for individual trees that you don’t want to advance through at the moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ab3085c30075c03bdffe71278836f8d416614936.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8852d899ea3a20ff51a52edd417f1df0f6b58121.jpg[/img]

[h2]The numbers[/h2]
Table of research bonus numbers for each tree type and rank:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b9b82a839cb9e872b949caf5fb13971a3835e7c0.jpg[/img]

This information can be seen by hovering over the new research icon on a vehicle that you’re researching. This icon will only appear if the current vehicle type already has Research Point bonuses and will only be displayed as active (bright) if bonus battles for today haven’t yet been spent and the vehicle is not considered new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c0d7a12ea80fbfb9254a384b2a35cbd8ff1a7444.jpg[/img]

Once you’ve played all 5 research bonus battles for a nation and vehicle type, the reset happens at 00:00 GMT everyday (the time shown in-game is specific based on your local time). The bonus amount is calculated on the base Research Points gained in a battle, the same as how Skill Bonuses work.

For Enduring Confrontation (EC), every 30 minutes spent in battle will use up a bonus battle, similar to how boosters work. Although, as the bonus applies to base RP earned, using up multiple bonus battles in one match won’t increase the earnings. 

For example, if you have 5 bonus battles left and play a 3 hour long EC match, you will receive the same bonus amount as if you played 1 bonus battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a053982c22d6d9b6e882debc8f4ee0a7053ba919.png[/img]

[h2]How to see your bonuses after a battle[/h2]
Research Bonuses work in any random battles game mode, and will be applied if a valid vehicle was used. For example, if you spawn an aircraft and tank in combined battles and have the bonus active for both, the bonus will apply to the base reward for both vehicles (and a bonus battle will be used up for both aircraft and tanks in this case).

If you played a battle and received 0 mission points and 0 base RP with a respective vehicle, for example a helicopter in Ground Realistic Battles where the battle ended and you had no time to do anything, you will not receive any research bonus to helicopters. The research bonus battle for helicopters also won’t be spent, so you’ll not waste one of the 5 bonus battles for helicopters in this case.

If you played a battle and received a bonus, this is shown in the My results screen under “Vehicle research bonus” as well as in the Battles section in the messages area.

[h3]F.A.Q. (open spoiler)[/h3]
[expand type=details]
Here are some relevant scenarios and answers. Please feel free to ask any additional questions you might have.

[b]Q:[/b] I only play one nation, the USSR. I have a max rank vehicle unlocked and purchased in Aviation, Army and Helicopters for this nation, but have nothing unlocked in any other nation. How many bonuses will I get?
[b]A:[/b] For each nation, you’ll get 5 battles with a bonus every day. For example, 5 for American aviation, 5 for the American army tree and 5 for American helicopters and so on for each nation.

[b]Q:[/b] I only play the USA, and I have every single plane in the USA tree researched and purchased, but only up to rank IV for their ground tree. Will I get bonuses for the ground tree?
[b]A:[/b] Not in this case. Bonuses only apply to the same type of vehicle in other research trees. So if you have a “top” aircraft, you will receive bonuses to aircraft research in other nations, but not ground vehicles.

[b]Q:[/b] If I don’t plan to play with a vehicle from a nation that has a research bonus available, can I disable the display of the bonus icons?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. You can toggle the display of the bonus icon in the research branch using the “Show remaining bonus in headers” option.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ab3085c30075c03bdffe71278836f8d416614936.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Q:[/b] If a new vehicle is added to the only tree where I have a “top” vehicle, and mine is no longer “top”, will I lose the bonus?
[b]A:[/b] Yes, the bonus status will be updated when new a new vehicle is introduced. If you have only one “top” vehicle of only one nation, and the new vehicle becomes the new “top” of the sub-branch you are researching, then the bonus will disappear until you purchase the new vehicle or get another “top” vehicle.

[b]Q:[/b] If a new “top” vehicle is added to the tree, will I be able to research it using the bonus?
[b]A:[/b] Yes, you can, but not right away. While the vehicle is considered new the bonus will not apply to it. 
[/expand]

notes.title: CM Covert Disclosures No.3: Updates from Smin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/dc0f5f49a0f0e53a353c203320fe7f1f8155f91a.png[/img]

Hello everyone, Smin here!

[b]Welcome to the next edition of covert disclosures where we aim to bring you up to speed with some of the goings on behind the scenes outside of our normal scheduled news. [/b]

[h2]Vehicle reports[/h2]

With the release of the Dance of Dragons major update two weeks ago, [b]the devs have been hard at work addressing many of your reports and going through all the feedback raised.[/b] We would like to cover a few of those subjects to begin with and give you some news from the development frontlines.
 
With the mighty [b]J-10A arriving, many of you requested that we consider the PL-8B missile for this aircraft.[/b]  We didn’t give the aircraft this missile as it may be a bit of a strong combination given the missile’s potential performance in conjunction with the platform, so PL-5E II was a more logical and balanced starting point. [b]It may be given further consideration depending also on how the J-10A is performing in the current meta. At this time however we can’t say for sure it will come to the game at any point soon, just to be clear. We just wanted to keep you updated that we are indeed aware of the missile and are looking into it.[/b]

Staying on the subject of the [b]J-10, its drop tanks were also a point raised[/b], as the current wing tanks occupy a missile pylon. [b]The developers are indeed aware of this and we do have alternative tanks in the pipeline.[/b] So work is indeed underway. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/def2ac6e9cfe128a0e61a20eedf4ac6bf0af74df.jpg[/img]

[b]On the F-111C, the developers are studying further reports into GBU-15 and shoulder mounted Sidewinder options for this aircraft. [/b]You may have spotted some of these in the early [b]dev blog renders, however they were not quite confirmed and complete, which is why we always aim to stress that dev blogs themselves are very much a window into in-development matters[/b] and the final outcome of a vehicle can always change even from that moment. Lastly we are also taking a look into evidence that showed F-111Cs potentially with the additional wing mounted bomb racks found on the F-111A. Thanks for all your reports and details on these matters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e9d10518c281c409483d7c86687d04f3dd91e13b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Recent bug fixes[/h2]
The star of the current Battlepass, [b]the Sholef V.1 has had its gun designation corrected to the M845 along with its appropriate performance, accurately representing the L/45 cannon we have modelled and present on Sholef V.1.[/b] We know this was raised by many of you and we would like to thank you for the reports made on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e0ff41b25db185678aa7bdcfb8a49709353b5bfc.jpg[/img]

The most recent major also brought the [b]JANUS commander sight for the VBM Freccia. Its missing Thermal imagery[/b] has now been added and the vehicle has several other fixes on the way. Such as its [b]top speed[/b], a correction to its [b]smoke calibre[/b] and the [b]number of missiles possible to store in the hull. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b33524381369109ad694cea4da45c615e4c63c77.jpg[/img]

Lastly for ground forces, [b]we would like to touch on the subject of the M735 shell briefly.[/b] Since we changed this round to the LO formula last year there have been many requests to re-evaluate the changes and review extra source materials to ensure its performance is correct. Whilst we can’t at this time specify the outcome, we can let you know the devs will be taking a look into the shell again and we do have some additional materials to evaluate and take into consideration.

Onto aircraft, [b]the F-15C Baz Meshupar was a bit of an exception to the later versions of F-15s (such as F-15C and F-15J(M)), in that its radar differed by being an APG-63 PSP, thus lacking TWS.[/b] After reviewing some of the reports submitted and conducting further investigations of our own, [b]the developers have decided to provide the aircraft with a TWS updated radar.[/b] This should bring the aircraft more into line with its counterparts and drastically improve its AMRAAM handling capabilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/471b671065142a7c61159dbe7de0d2d912a29b00.jpg[/img]

[h2]Next event vehicle[/h2]
We’re nearing the end of the year now, and there are interesting times ahead. For now though, [b]the next event vehicle after HMS Barham will be a ground vehicle for Germany.[/b] Keep an eye on the news for the announcement for this event/vehicle!

[h2]Stats![/h2]
Here is some more interesting stats from the game in the past 30 days that we’ve pulled from the production server. For future stats, we want to do some interesting comparisons to make it more exciting! Stats date range is from 22.08 - 20.09.

[b]Make sure to let us know what kind of stats you’d like to see in the next article, and we’ll see if we can pull them.[/b]

[list]
[*] [i]Highest number of ground vehicle kills at once with the Pe-8’s FAB-5000 bomb and Lancaster B Mk I and B Mk III 12,000 lb bomb in Ground Realistic Battles in the past 30 days[/i][/list]
There were [b]11 enemy kills[/b] (not including accidental teamkills) at once with each of the Pe-8’s FAB-5000 and Lancaster B Mk I and B Mk III’s 12,000 lb bomb. 11 kills is great! 

[list]
[*] [i]Number of times there were number of kills per battle by a single player: 10 or above, 13 or above, 15 or above, 17 or above, 20 or above in each of Ground AB, RB and SB in the past 30 days[/i][/list]
Hundreds of thousands of times there were 10+ kills in Ground battles over a month period. Only a few thousand get over 20 kills, and in Ground SB, there were two times with over 20+ kills. Nice work! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/35111fec82470d1409be59b82b8ef49c6343f8d1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [i]Number of times that torpedoes destroyed the Battleship class in all naval battle modes in the past 30 days[/i][/list]
[b]40,499[/b] ships classed as a “Battleship” in-game were destroyed by torpedoes in the past month in all naval modes. Nice!

[list]
[*] [i]Number of successful landings in total in Air RB, AB and SB battles with “Severe Damage” in the past 30 days[/i][/list]
In the past month, many players resisted crashing their aircraft and made it back to the airfield to repair. Players whose aircraft had “Severe Damage” made [b]410,049[/b] successful landings in Air AB, [b]119,978[/b] in Air RB and [b]138,033[/b] in Air SB. That’s [b]668,060[/b] in total across all modes. Impressive numbers!

[h2]New training missions for ground vehicles[/h2]
The devs have created some new training missions for ground vehicles, similar to how the tutorials for testing aircraft weapons such as AAMs or AGMs work. [b]There’s 5 missions here for binoculars, laser rangefinder, SAM with IR homing head with uncaging
SAM with IR homing head without uncaging and SAM with multi-channel optical homing head.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/59543ba041d3557991f510e4a27770741696f2ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d486a301e60055d771526ef07f301369976a30a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/97abcb89f7ff3edcba92f2179e795831673041d3.png[/img]

[b]These tutorials are planned to be added to the game before the next major update[/b] and will provide new and experienced players alike with a proper tutorial area for all types of ground weapon systems and other functions in the game. Keep an eye out for this coming soon!

[h3]More tank sights [/h3]
As mentioned in the tank reticle blog, the devs will be adding more tank reticles to the game over time. Some of the first ones that were added to the game last week are for the Challenger 2, Leclerc, Ariete and Merkava. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d305e18c831e7d19b732d4964f5bc04549f6fa28.jpg[/img]

[h2]The next major[/h2]
Dance of Dragons just released and the devs are already working hard on the next major update. [b]Check out the below on some of the things in store for the next major update and beyond. [/b]

[h3]US SPAA plans, plus Skink and Ram II changes [/h3]
Recently, we’ve seen requests for new SPAA additions to the US ground forces tree at the lower to mid ranks. If all goes to plan and nothing prevents us, in the next major update, the devs will start to remedy this situation by [b]adding a new, domestic SPAA for the US[/b] (more information on this one will be revealed closer to the next major) as well as the addition of the Canadian Skink. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b854b53c805b17ca671fd2a324e4dd782b46b657.jpg[/img]

Since the Skink is already in the British tree, and for a long time now there have been requests for the M4A5 (Ram II) to go to the British tree, [b]the devs will also add the Ram II to the British tree as a premium as well. Both trees will keep both vehicles too, meaning both nations will now simply have both vehicles.[/b] The addition of these vehicles doesn’t affect any current or future plans for SPAA and other vehicles for these nations — this is simply an “extra bonus” on-top. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8cabdb4d7f08bdcdfd93753b39a2092153cd494d.jpg[/img]

[h3]New test flight for aircraft[/h3]
[b]The devs are also working on an overall revamp of aircraft test flights.[/b] Those of you who have been here since the early days probably know that aircraft test flight maps haven't changed much, but we do have a lot of them. [b]The new test flights are still very early on[/b], but we can say they will follow a similar sort of approach as what tank test drives offer, with a range of practical features like targets scaled for BR, selectable spawn positions, re-spawning targets and perhaps some other elements too that are still being discussed. 

[h3]HE fuze control[/h3]
Also in the works is a new mechanic for switching HE shells operating mode. [b]This primarily is for shells with a Radio or Remote fuse activation, as it allows you to disable this function and use them as a standard HE shell with a contact fuse.[/b] A cyclic switch function will allow you to toggle which mode your shell will have. 

[h3]Ship gameplay improvements[/h3]
Naval warfare will also see some improvements in gameplay interface features. The team are currently working on a range of features, [b]such as a new aiming sight for missiles as well as improvements to the prediction markers. Some of these will make it for the next major, and some for the future, all depending on how development goes. [/b]

[h3]New visual effects[/h3]
The next major will have a plethora of visual effect updates that we’ll likely cover close to the major. [b]However, one exciting addition that we wanted to point out is LERX Vapor for jet aircraft![/b] Take a look at some of the screenshots of this effect, [b]please bear in mind that this is still Work-In-Progress and is subject to change.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/05db43c96e3a1f482322f6f46e469c8012c58009.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/773a41b6b69dd63bc18e071414f3797bbe976bde.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5d70b22298be0a75666c751e17c284310bf63726.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3d2a5e4e454cb83d2f34980f04f95d093b59ef87.png[/img]

[h2]Let us know what you think[/h2]
We hope you have enjoyed this instalment and its updates on quite a wide range of subjects that the dev team have been working on since the last major update and well into the next! 
Please be sure to keep your bug reports coming for any issues and let us know your feedback below.

tags.bug: The star of the current Battlepass, [b]the Sholef V.1 has had its gun designation corrected to the M845 along with its appropriate performance, accurately representing the L/45 cannon we have modelled and present on Sholef V.1.[/b] We know this was raised by many of you and we would like to thank you for the reports made on this!
The most recent major also brought the [b]JANUS commander sight for the VBM Freccia. Its missing Thermal imagery[/b] has now been added and the vehicle has several other fixes on the way.
Such as its [b]top speed[/b], a correction to its [b]smoke calibre[/b] and the [b]number of missiles possible to store in the hull. [/b]

[b]the F-15C Baz Meshupar was a bit of an exception to the later versions of F-15s (such as F-15C and F-15J(M)), in that its radar differed by being an APG-63 PSP, thus lacking TWS.[/b] After reviewing some of the reports submitted and conducting further investigations of our own, [b]the developers have decided to provide the aircraft with a TWS updated radar.[/b] This should bring the aircraft more into line with its counterparts and drastically improve its AMRAAM handling capabilities.

[b]It may be given further consideration depending also on how the J-10A is performing in the current meta. At this time however we can’t say for sure it will come to the game at any point soon, just to be clear. We just wanted to keep you updated that we are indeed aware of the missile and are looking into it.[/b]
[b]The developers are indeed aware of this and we do have alternative tanks in the pipeline.[/b] So work is indeed underway.

[/b]You may have spotted some of these in the early [b]dev blog renders, however they were not quite confirmed and complete, which is why we always aim to stress that dev blogs themselves are very much a window into in-development matters[/b] and the final outcome of a vehicle can always change even from that moment. Thanks for all your reports and details on these matters!

[b]we would like to touch on the subject of the M735 shell briefly.[/b] Since we changed this round to the LO formula last year there have been many requests to re-evaluate the changes and review extra source materials to ensure its performance is correct. Whilst we can’t at this time specify the outcome, we can let you know the devs will be taking a look into the shell again and we do have some additional materials to evaluate and take into consideration.

notes.content:

[h2]Helicopters[/h2]
[list]
[*] For all helicopters that do not have the new avionic modules in their damage models, the chance of avionic damage after the fuselage has been damaged has been significantly reduced. Avionics will not be damaged by the high-explosive impact from ammunition of calibers less than 23 mm and kinetic impact of calibers less than 25 mm with the exception of shells with radio fuzes and air-to-air missiles. One-time damage to the fuselage by ammunition of calibers less than 30 mm will not lead to the disabling of all helicopter avionics.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e362d6409b5a423aef8a163377c93028108ed22b.png[/img]

The legendary Mi-24 made its maiden flight on September 19th 1969, 55 years ago. It remains one of the most widely used attack helicopters in the world to this day. More than 3,500 Mi-24s were produced, dozens of countries used it (and still do!), and it has taken part in more than 30 different armed conflicts. 

[h2]The Mi-24D temporarily returns to the game with a 30% discount![/h2]
This helicopter is available in the game with a 30% discount, at [strike]8560[/strike] 5,992 Golden Eagles.

[list]

Its armor can withstand small-caliber weapons fire, and its machine gun can deal with lightly armored opponents. But its main advantage is its wide selection of secondary weapons. From gun pods, free-falling bombs to missiles and rockets. The S-24 rockets and Falanga ATGM with up to 650 mm armor penetration are particularly good to use! 
[/list]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №96
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/815c9d38161872e266030efb25e2ef102ecaeab0.jpg[/img]

Today, we’ll be going over the bug fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game over the past 2 weeks. Let’s take a look!

If you’ve found a bug that you’d like to report, you can do so on [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder?from-ts=1704096000&to-ts=1722495599]our community bug reporting platform[/url].

[h2]Helicopter Avionics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/349299ed919d381df4a4720853a9e65d7b40e877.jpg[/img]
In the Dance of Dragons major update, detailed helicopter model modules have now been added, which we spoke about in our recent Roadmap dev blog here. So far, only the AH-64 and Ka-52 helicopters have received detailed internal modules. For all other helicopters, we’ve included on-board systems into the fuselage damage model — when receiving damage, there’s a chance that one or another module will still fail. 

There were times where players who took damage in a helicopter tried to use a particular feature and couldn’t, simply because the damage had disabled the corresponding avionics module. Previously, players didn’t understand why they couldn’t use it, but now a notification will let you know exactly what happened to your helicopter and what functionality has become unavailable. 

[h2]Interface Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d4a0c2bd21deee1a14e25385f49a3986d63e4513.jpg[/img]
We’ve found several bugs that crept into the game interface. Here, we’ll list them one by one. One bug caused the modification window to open after a battle, even if no modifications were researched. Another caused the “Reset” button in the Sight settings window to not reset the settings. And in Air Realistic Battles, player titles were sometimes not displayed. 

If the leader of a squad queuing for a battle had two or more server clusters selected, then only one cluster was displayed for squad members. The areas where active protection systems were shown in the damage indicator in-game were incorrectly displayed in the lower left corner (although the APS still worked correctly).

All of the bugs mentioned above have been fixed. Have a good game!

[h2]Garage for Sale![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/885d7ba8f8ffcaf7d43f4fe88ba41124ba099f91.jpg[/img]
Locations like Seversk-13 or Abandoned Town have quite a few fragile structures such as garages or kiosks. Penetrating them shouldn’t be a problem for solid or APHE shells, but for some reason it was! Even posts affected the flight of shells as well.

We’ve restored justice here, as these objects can now be destroyed and penetrated as they should be. 

[h2]Keep Your Eyes Peeled[/h2]
War Thunder provides players with a vital opportunity to see the impact of shells fired by you and at you. However, we found that in some cases the hit was not shown.

For example, if you fired an APFSDS round that had a penetrator of 15 mm or less in diameter and it did not penetrate the enemy’s armor, the hit camera was not displayed. Additionally, when a player’s ammo rack, protected by blowout panels exploded in their vehicle, the vehicle destruction replay was not shown.

We fixed these bugs earlier this week.

[h2]Burn, Burn Brightly![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/11ac81faeb3ea713c25c573937c3c60716cb32b6.jpg[/img]
After the release of the Dance of Dragons update, some of you noticed something strange. Fire and smoke on the remains of destroyed tanks were no longer visible at distances over 2 km on any graphics settings. 

You reported this to us and we’ve fixed it last week. Thanks for all of your reports on this!

[h2]That’s not all![/h2]
You can find the full list of fixes and improvements in each separate update note. Here’s some more: a bug that caused the time fuze to not set a distance when measuring the distance from the sights has been fixed, sudden brightness changes in the hangar and Air Battles will no longer bother you, and a bug that caused the award icons to not show in the after battle stats window under the “Awards” tab has been fixed as well.

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/6973349936527186300]Update 2.39.0.28[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/6973349936513390354]Update 2.39.0.23[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/4566175748881957931]Update 2.39.0.15[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Today's update: Update 2.39.0.30[/h2]


[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Leopard 2A4 (Sweden)[/b] — incorrect designation of the hydraulic pump as a horizontal guidance drive has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]G.91 R/4 (Germany)[/b] — a bug where the AA-20 misisles on the left pylon were missing a launcher has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/VhtjgK84O6Bl]Report[/url]). 
[*] [b]Su-24M[/b] — a bug that caused the rocket pods to remain floating even when the wing was torn off has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/uu2HdEOCrru7]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Baz Meshupar[/b] — a bug making it impossible to slave the radar with the HMD has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/h5JBSsiTnysr]Report[/url]) 
[*] [b]Baz Meshupar[/b] — a bug with the lack of track-while-scan (TWS) mode has been fixed.
[*] [b]KAB-500S, LS-6 250, LS-6 500, GBU-31, GBU-38[/b] — a bug where it was impossible to drop these guided bombs if the target was at an angle of more than 60 degrees from the direction of flight of the aircraft has been fixed.
[*] [b]AGMs with laser, TV and IR seekers, IR guided ATGMs[/b] — self-destruction of the missile in the air after losing the target has been removed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/C6zZ0MJH96f4]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tornade, Bourrasque[/b] — a bug where the rangefinders were not tied to the fire control room has been fixed.
[*] [b]IJN Amagi[/b] — the maximum horizontal aiming angle of the fourth main caliber turret has been increased from 150 to 160 degrees. 
[/list]
[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that could cause brightness changes in Air Battles and in the hangar has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/IOVjGjCKCmwE]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] In the research window for task markers and temporary sales, the list of vehicles have been added to the tooltip.
[*] A bug where a squad member’s queue information would not show all server clusters has been fixed. 
[*] A bug where the player would see the vehicle modification window after a battle, even if nothing had been researched has been fixed. 
[*] A bug where the settings in the Sight settings window would not reset when pressing the “Reset” button has been fixed. 
[/list]

[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcommunity.gaijin.net%2Fissues%2Fp%2Fwarthunder]bug reporting service[/url], forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]

notes.title: A Decal, Two Fighters & a Discount to Celebrate the U.S. Air Force’s Birthday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/82e69121389b725624ccd04f525bbaa0ced549bc.png[/img]

On September 18th, the U.S. Air Force turns 77 years old! It currently has nearly 500,000 service members (including the National Guard and reservists) and operates about 5,500 aircraft and 400 intercontinental ballistic missiles. 

[h2]Bostwick’s P-47M-1-RE and Wetmore’s P-51D-10 are temporarily available for Golden Eagles![/h2]
Two American premium aircraft, George Bostwick’s P-47M-1-RE and Raymond Wetmore’s P-51D-10 are temporarily available to purchase for 6090 and 4880 Golden Eagles respectively. 

[b]When:[/b] From today until September 23rd (07:00 GMT).
[b]Where:[/b] USA > Aviation > Premium vehicles

[b]About these aircraft[/b]
[list]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Bostwick%27s_P-47M-1-RE]P-47M-1-RE[/url] is an excellent aircraft for high-altitude fighting, where it proves to be unrivaled in speed and maneuverability. Armed with eight deadly 12.7 mm Browning machine guns, the P-47M-1-RE can also carry bombs and rockets. This aircraft was flown by American ace George Bostwick, who fought on the Western Front and destroyed at least eight German aircraft in the air, and 6 more on the ground. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ca7b4a0ccf75062106a81aac154b86b6d67d200c.jpg[/img]
[*] The [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/P-51D-10]P-51D-10[/url] is great at flyby and ground attacks in general! It has six excellent 12.7 mm guns with a large amount of ammo, a wide selection of bombs and rockets, and impressive dive speed. This aircraft belonged to Ray Wetmore, the eighth most successful American ace in the European war theater. He shot down 21 Luftwaffe aircraft and ended the war as a major at just 21 years old! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d7be734093aaa0027eb83d9c4e9a143cba36d4b4.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]50% Discount on the “Above All” Bundle![/h2]
[i]Can be purchased through the store in-game. Shop → Online Store[/i]

Until September 23rd (07:00 GMT) a bundle including both aircraft and a unique title is available at a discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/033a3f064ce81aae1ceb8f70d8064c4984611e08.jpg[/img]

This bundle includes:
[list]
[*] Ray Wetmore`s P-51D-10 Pack
[*] George Bostwick's P-47M-1-RE Thunderbolt Pack
[*]  Unique title “Above all”
[/list]

Players on all platforms who already own Ray Wetmore's Р-51D-10 or George Bostwick's P-47M-1-RE Thunderbolt can receive this title if they play 3 battles in either of these aircraft until September 23rd (07:00 GMT)

[h2]Get the “USAF Day 2024” decal![/h2]
To celebrate, we’ve also got a special decal for this day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b7bdf045273d7a56e4578511c923f34e84a62a2a.png[/img]
[b]“USAF Day 2024”[/b] decal

[b]When:[/b] From today until September 23rd (07:00 GMT).
[b]Task:[/b] Play 3 battles using US aircraft at rank III or higher to receive the “USAF Day 2024” decal.

[b]Additional details:[/b]
[list]
[*] You must use a minimum of rank III.
[*] Your activity must not be below 70%.
[*] Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and  [Assault] mode. 
[*] Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → US Air Force Birthday.
[*] You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customization menu.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5bac15a3860faafef1e6b20039bc4ca210b3f481.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Sholef V1[/b] — gun designation has been changed from M839 to M845. Muzzle velocity has been increased from 684 to 897 m/s. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/8i0rEAeU3bEo]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]ZSU-23-4M2[/b] — a bug where the gun cover model did not raise with the guns has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/dPHMAfCHKNUW]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]ZTZ99A[/b] — the animation for the dozer blade has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/4fgVjiCo5FTL]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Antelope[/b] — some inaccuracies in the missile model have been fixed.
[*] [b]Pz.II C[/b] — gaps in armor on the plate joints have been removed.
[*] A bug that caused the time fuze to not set a distance when measuring the distance from the sights has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the hit camera to not appear when the shot was made with APFSDS that had a penetrator with a caliber of 15 mm or less and the armor had not been penetrated has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]J-11A[/b] — the position of the missiles on the pylons has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/uIHPy1AfO4XO]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]F-16C Barak II[/b] — nozzle texture has been replaced with the correct one. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/lROLlNyxqk17]Report[/url]).
[*] [b]Hunter F.58 (Germany)[/b] — a bug that caused some textures to flicker in the cockpit has been fixed. 
[*] [b]AV-8B (NA)[/b] — a bug that caused no nozzle animation has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/mwW1wBIPKgTh]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Naval Vessels[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]La Combattante[/b] — ship textures have been improved.
[*] [b]IJN Amagi[/b] — the color of the emblem on the ship’s bow has been corrected. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/RmLblfcMAUOh]Report[/url]).
[*] A bug that sometimes caused two torpedoes to be launched simultaneously from fixed torpedo tubes if during the launch a player had abruptly shifted view to the side has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused some actions in the gamepad event selection menu to not work due to a conflict with other actions with the same keybinds has been fixed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Gxr4HHaV9mlX]Report[/url], [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/6J4xFib79HrI]Report[/url]).
[*] WEP is no longer disabled when a key combination which contains a key bound to throttle increase is pressed. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/VlseHXRC7q05]Report[/url]).
[/list]
[i]Patch notes reflect only key changes, meaning they may not include a complete list of all improvements made. Additionally, War Thunder is constantly being updated and some changes may not require an update. Changes reflected in patch notes are formed by taking reactions and requests of the community from the bug reporting service, forums and other official platforms into account. Bug fixes and changes are implemented in order of importance, for example a game-breaking bug will be worked on and implemented sooner.[/i]
