notes.title: Battle Pass vehicles: SPz 12-3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fa08c9e17f9f588373c5ab58df4251d2a7ed8fe3.gif[/img]

[i]The German anti-tank IFV comes to the game as one of the main prizes in the upcoming Battle Pass season “Armour Breaking Ambusher”![/i]

[h2]SPz 12-3, light tank, Germany, rank IV. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Recoilless anti-tank rifle
[*] 20mm autocannon
[*] Light armour
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e0d757db49d53f65d0bf26bcec1946117d6b137d.jpg[/img]

The SPz 12-3, one of the main prizes of the new season of the War Thunder Battle Pass “Armour Breaking Ambusher'', is built on a chassis already familiar to weathered commanders of German vehicles by the Raketenautomat tank destroyer. The new vehicle will offer players more flexible gameplay. Thanks to the fast-firing 20mm cannon, the SPz 12-3 will find use in reconnaissance raids on the flanks and rear of the enemy lines, reaping light vehicles. At the same time, a more powerful 106 mm cannon with HEAT rounds will cope with the conventional armour on any tank on the battlefield, since ERA, spaced or composite armour are yet very rare here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2a477320e0a85c00c776e139942567519dd29fb9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fd964b133624b3f8f9856f831c74249973d55274.jpg[/img]

As a ranger or armour breaking ambusher, the SPz 12-3 needs good mobility in order to quickly change positions and be the first to take advantage of cover. The weight of the machine is 16 tons, which creates low ground pressure. However, due to its relatively weak engine, the SPz 12-3 is not the best runner around, hitting a pretty decent 55 kph and handles off-road and low hills with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a47702d7ea695929878019b7286b33fab9a4aa15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ad5ef0aeb137c0d846449d54598c3e857ccf3fb7.jpg[/img]

Like all vehicles of this type, the SPz 12-3 is lightly armoured and can be penetrated at some parts of the hull and turret even with heavy machine guns.

The Armour Breaking Ambusher SPz 12-3 will be waiting for you in the new season of the War Thunder Battle Pass. Very soon we will tell you about all the prizes and the conditions for receiving them - stay tuned!

notes.title: Battle Pass vehicles: MC 485
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fdc2a9eb25adef990cecb90f72c171e1b2d850f3.gif[/img]

[i]A German E-Boat, that was used as a commercial cargo vessel after the war ended, gets new life in service with the Regia Marina![/i]

[h2]MC 485, torpedo boat, Italy, rank III. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Armored bridge
[*] Enhanced weapons
[*] High speed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/642682708fe87940a3aa871e051c87fdab39b5e7.jpg[/img]

The MC 485 is a German E-Boat of the S-38 series, which in the post-war period entered service with the Royal Italian Navy. The boat will become one of the main prizes of the next season of the War Thunder Battle Pass as a Premium torpedo boat of rank III in the Italian coastal fleet tech tree.

At first glance, you can see two main differences between the Italian boat and the German E-Boats - a high mast for a navigation radar and, most importantly, modified armament. The gun cockpit on the bow has been dismantled and changed to deck. The Italians replaced the German armament at the stern with a pair of 40 mm Bofors automatic cannons. Thus, on the one hand, the boat has somewhat lost combat effectiveness, since she can no longer fire forward, and on the other, the MC 485 broadside is dangerous not only for boats and aircraft, but even for small enemy ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5e5e3c569ed06f8205611ed39310e4ad8983410a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f056baf9e29662f2f63c6d918766ec71644c35fc.jpg[/img]

Why do we love the E-Boats? Of course, for excellent maneuvering performance and ease of performing torpedo attacks. The MC 485 keeps with this tradition, although the torpedoes themselves are now different, as they were made in Italy. The boat quickly reaches a maximum speed of 39 knots (over 70 km/h) and is excellent for both capturing points and maneuvering among islands and rocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b103139a14d8ba6ac41ca325dcb433b217fcde93.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/05314605dc5fc1c8fd507688b0acfe4b768ac35d.jpg[/img]

The Italian MC 485 will be one of the main prizes in the new season of the War Thunder Battle Pass. We will soon announce other prizes and the full list of rules, so stay tuned for the news!

notes.title: It’s fixed! №78
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/169c6b2df718b4abc8d9a8e9682f2e7cb25b7684.jpg[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder in the website special section.

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/3/3806155261061004324/][b][quote]Please feel free to leave your feedback on these changes in the dedicated "It’s fixed! №78" thread[/quote][/b][/url][/h3]


[h2]Know the enemy by sight[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0706f957d822f66004229e20dcea78e8d91e3436.jpg[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3655282771731025676]Last time[/url] we talked a lot about the importance of protection analysis, a feature that allows you to learn the vulnerabilities of the vehicles in the game. However War Thunder is constantly growing and there are more and more vehicles in the game - the choice of virtual enemies is truly huge!

That’s why we have added the ability to search for threat vehicles by name to the protection analysis. Spend less time searching and more time simulating hits!


[h2]Ghost bridge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c4ee60873f44fc3242fb9fe909818382703376f0.jpg[/img]
A curious situation happened on the “Alaska” map. One player told us in a report that after the destruction of the bridge from bombs he could freely drive on it - as if the bridge never disappeared!

However after investigating what happened we found out that the bombs didn’t matter at all! The bridge didn’t disappear - only its visual model vanished and only if some tank with bulldozer blade (for example T-80U) started digging under it.

Digging will no longer erase objects from reality - the ghost bridge will be a thing of the past.


[h2]Exceptional quality[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0fa8e91b1232cd525fc9fd24ab40eed90108c910.jpg[/img]
You must have noticed that the game’s launcher offers you a lot of presets to select from - from minimal and standard installation to a selection of high-quality models of aircraft or ground vehicles. 

In the Steam version of the game to install high quality models you need to add the corresponding free DLC pack to account first - but even if the player didn’t purchase them or if he disabled these DLC, the client itself set “Ultra quality of all models” and started downloading extra gigabytes. We have also fixed this bug. 


[h1]That’s Not All[/h1]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in a separate patch note — there are lots of interesting things! The operation of the gearboxes in a number of ground vehicles, the operation of radar for aircraft have been corrected and shells with contact fuzes will now be correctly suspended on water. 

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted using our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]special service[/url].

[h1]Update 2.27.1.42[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/09c14d83988a066a73a813c272005e079ef22adf.png[/img]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that might cause damage without penetration when smaller calibre APHE shells hit hinged tracks at higher angles has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/xTcvQwAiT9lZ]report[/url]).
[*] [b]M10 (France)[/b] — Crew models in US uniforms have been replaced with crew models in French uniforms. 
[*] [b]M8 LAC (all modifications)[/b] — Gear ratio values have been adjusted ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/6FKaYjw1aYNZ]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Merkava Mk.1[/b] — Gear ratio values have been adjusted and the total number of gears has been increased. Gearbox is changed to the gearbox used on the Merkava Mk.1B ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/GgA2SG25Sk21]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Turm III[/b] — Gear ratio values have been adjusted. Gearboxis changed to the gearbox used on the Leopard 1 ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/e3h2jP6BbQP9]report[/url]).
[*] [b]2S3М[/b] — Gear ratio values have been adjusted ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/ByLt53JQrVQt]report[/url]). 
[*] [b]AUBL/74, FIAT 6614, AUBL/74 HVG[/b] — Gear ratio values have been adjusted and the total number of gears has been increased ([url=https://old-forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/554409-aubl74-aubl74-hvg-incorrect-transmission-implementation/]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Centurion Mk.1[/b] — Values of reverse gear ratios have been corrected. Number of reverse gears has been changed from 1 to two. Reverse speed has been changed from 12 to 12.8 km/h. ([url=https://old-forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/576421-fwd-missing-reverse-gear-for-centurion-mk1-and-3/]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Centurion Mk.3 (all modifications)[/b] — Values of reverse gear ratios have been corrected. Number of reverse gears has been changed from 1 to two. Reverse speed has been changed from 12 to 11.9 km/h. ([url=https://old-forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/576421-fwd-missing-reverse-gear-for-centurion-mk1-and-3/]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Freccia[/b] — Vignette area in the gunner’s sight has been reduced ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/fqLBjORIZ4cg]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Panther II[/b] — Erroneous formation of secondary fragments from outer side skirts (“Schürzen”) has been removed.
[*] [b]M1 KVT[/b] — Mudguard material has been changed from structural steel to rubber-fabric skirt.
[*] [b]Chi-Ha LG[/b] — A bug that caused the gun’s guidance speed to decrease after the batteries were discharged has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/vZFG6LT7LdE3]report[/url]). 
[*] [b]Freccia[/b] — Missing thermal imager on the UAV has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/vhGIWNZAaCpO]report[/url]).
[*] 105mm DTW2-105 shell — The mass has been changed from 3.79 to 3.775 kg ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Q7g2FFmrlpxX]report[/url]). 
[*] 85mm O-365K, Type 56 shells — Muzzle velocity has been changed from 793 to 785 m/sec ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Zmhw4UrsBycE]report[/url]). 
[*] The designation of the О-243 shell has been corrected. New designation — [b]О-240[/b]. Muzzle velocity has been changed from 343 to 335 m/sec. Weight has been changed from 2.15 to 2.14 kg ([url=https://old-forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/572814-incorrect-mass-velocity-and-name-of-45-mm-o-243/]report[/url]).
[*] New type of the explosive has been added — JH-2 (China). Explosive type for the DTP-125 shell has been changed from RDX/TNT to JH-2 ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/EszuK8yeR6vB]report[/url]).
[*] [b]MGM-51 B/C[/b] — Type of explosives has been changed from TNT to Octol. source: “Shillelagh Information Booklet D-453”.
[*] [b]105 mm Type 91[/b] — Mass of the shell has been changed from 10.5 to 9.4 kg. Mass of explosives has been changed from 0.97 to 1.2 kg. Source: «予算執行事前審査等調書 (平成２２年度第３四半期)».
[*] [b]90 mm Granata da 90[/b] — Muzzle velocity has been changed from 850 to 830 m/sec. Mass has been changed from 10.1 to 10.3 kg. Mass of the explosive has been changed from 1 to 0.871 kg. Sources: “Sinossi di materiale di artiglieria, parte descrittiva, volume II, testo, 1957” and “Addestramento dell'artiglieria, cannone da 90/53 P, istruzione sul materiale e sulle munizioni, 1952”. 
[*] 90 mm Granata Perforante mod.43 — Mass has been changed from 11.1 to 11.25 kg. Mass of the explosive has been changed from 0.18 to 0.347 kg. Sources: “Sinossi di materiale di artiglieria, parte descrittiva, volume II, testo, 1957” and “Addestramento dell'artiglieria, cannone da 90/53 P, istruzione sul materiale e sulle munizioni, 1952”.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tornado F.3[/b] - A bug that caused the radar to lock the targets at greater range than its designated range has been fixed.
[*] [b]A-4E Early[/b] - A bug that caused the wrong launcher type to be used for the AGM-12C has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/UgTnqYOymeVX]report[/url]).
[*] [b]UH-1C XM-30[/b] - A bug that caused the right 30mm XM140 cannon in X-Ray view to have the description from the M134 Minigun has been fixed. The angle of deflection of the 30mm XM140 cannon has been changed from 2 to 5 degrees. Source: DTIC AD0827184: Engineering Flight Test Of The UH-1C Helicopter Equipped With The XM-30 Weapon System. November 1967.
[*] [b]F-84B[/b] - Ballistic calculator for bombs (navigational bombing) has been added. Source: AN 01-65BJB-1 Handbook Flight Operating Instructions F-84B, F-84C and F-84D.
[*] [b]F9F-8[/b] - A bug that made it impossible to copy a pre-installed weaponry preset of 114 FFAR missiles has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/FghcJXOw7CYo]report[/url]).
[*] [b]F-16A MLU, F-16AJ[/b] - A bug that caused the AGM-65 guidance camera to be blocked when the aircraft was damaged has been fixed.
[*] [b]Su-22M3[/b] - A bug that made it impossible to copy a pre-installed weaponry preset consisting of 8хFAB-500Sh has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/APvP6MOD28nQ]report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Armament[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused HE, HEAT, smoke and other shells with instant contact fuzes to not detonate on the surface  of water has been fixed. The fix affects shells of ship and tank cannons and air cannons.
[/list]
[h2]Graphical[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused the visual displaying of a bridge in the “Alaska” location to disappear after using bulldozer dumps underneath it has been fixed. 
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ability to search for a threat vehicle by name has been added to the protection analysis.
[*] Paragraphs for texts in the options tooltip in the squadron creation window have been removed.
[*] A bug where the radio message wasn’t displayed to the sending squad has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused one team’s points to start dwindling for no reason, leading to premature termination of the aircraft SB game session has been fixed.
[*] A bug that could cause the colour of allies in custom battles to not match the colour specified in the game settings has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Missions[/h2]
[list]
[*] In “Seversk-13” missions, AA guns that were stationed too close to the landing strip of the airfield have been moved.
[*] In the “[Conquest #2] Abandoned Town” mission, incorrect placement of the spawn point defence areas has been fixed. 
[/list]
[h2]Other fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] An error that caused armament and ammo of other vehicles to be displayed in the mid-battle vehicle selection window preventing the player from respawning in the battle has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: A Decal and Two Aircraft for Bastille Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4a5e8b89990af28df3ea057074f4db4989c00f98.jpg[/img]

On July 14th, 1789, Parisians stormed the Bastille — a prison fortress that became one of the symbols of French absolute monarchy. Since 1880 this date has been celebrated as the main national holiday in France, with an annual military parade held on Champs-Élysées, one of the oldest and largest in the entire world.

[h2]Milan and S.O.4050 Vautour IIN for Golden Eagles[/h2]

[h2][quote]From July 14th (12:00 GMT) until July 17th (12:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

The premium French jets Milan and S.O.4050 Vautour IIN will be available for Golden Eagles. 

[h3][b]Milan[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3599a5cae0625abbb86a65a88cc3ed3cb3c463b8.jpg[/img]
The Milan is an experimental version of the Mirage fighter that can reach amazing speeds and outrun most of the aircraft on its BR. It can drop bombs while maintaining speeds of over Mach 1, and also carry rockets and AGMs — it can also drop all its tanks to increase aerial performance: even without suspended weaponry, its DEFA cannons are a force to be reckoned with!

[h3][b]S.O.4050 Vautour IIN[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/83d6631bb4497e926bfbe666b17db9d5234054f9.jpg[/img]
The S.O.4050 Vautour IIN is a jet bomber, the bane of enemy bases. It can also fend for itself with the same four 30 mm DEFA cannons, and its wide assortment of suspended weaponry includes AA-20 Nord AGMs with proximity fuze. Also, if the skies are covered by your teammates, take AS-30 Nord AGMs to leave ground vehicles with no chance of survival!


[h2]“Cocarde de France” decal[/h2]

[h2][quote]From July 14th (10:00 GMT) until July 17th (10:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using French vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Cocarde de France” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9b0930e025255d85a9d7639d1632657ac4b6a8f6.png[/img]
[b]“Cocarde de France”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Bastille Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Combat Robots of Atomic Heart come to War Thunder!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8CYRTYkYKyk;full][/previewyoutube]

As you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/6332664591579216463]know[/url], combat robots from the Atomic Heart world are being tested on the battlefields of War Thunder.

[h2][quote]From July 11th (12:00 GMT) to July 31st (12:00 GMT), unique robots created at Enterprise 3826 will meet in battle with armored vehicles and helicopters of the Cold War era from the USSR and USA in Test Facility 2271.[/quote][/h2]

During the field tests, the testing personnel will be split into two teams - team ‘West’, and team ‘East’ - to deploy on the battlefield both conventional and experimental combat vehicles, such as Hedgie and Pchela robots. Players will have access to a predetermined set of vehicles, including M3 Bradley and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, M60A2 and T-55A medium tanks, and AH-1G and Mi-24A helicopters.

[h2]Join the event and get prizes![/h2]

Completing battle tasks in the special mission will allow you to open prize stages and receive rewards corresponding to the number of stages. Tasks are divided into two types: those that start on a specific date and are available until the very end of the event, and temporary ones, which are relevant only for two days. Special tasks highlighted in the list below, might be performed simultaneously with each other and with temporary tasks.

[list]
[*] July 11th - 31st: defeat 30 enemies while controlling the HOG-7 Hedgiev in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 13th - 15th: score 20,000 points in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 15th - 31st: score 10 assists in repairing or fire extinguishing in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 17th - 19th: score 20,000 points in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 19th - 31st: defeat 20 enemies while controlling the WSP-9 Laser Pchela in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 21st - 23rd: score 20,000 points in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 23rd - 31st: defeat 40 robots in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 25th - 27th: score 20,000 points in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 27th - 31st: defeat 5 enemies while controlling a helicopter in the Atomic Thunder event
[*] July 29th - 31st: score 20,000 points in the Atomic Thunder event
[/list]
Battle tasks activate and expire at 11:00 GMT. You can track the terms and progress in the game by clicking on your nickname - Achievements - Atomic Thunder.

[h2]Prizes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7cd7c1702d06f1d319da4e8ecbe17f9235bf9cb7.png[/img]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Thump it!” poster[/b][/td]
        [td][b]"Door Lock" decoration[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Profile icon “Twin Left”[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d1e8338be345b63e30bf69892a72cd293acf367a.png[/img]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]“Get ready" poster[/b][/td]
        [td][b]The “Swede” axe decoration[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Profile icon “Twin Right”[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Each unlocked stage will bring you a prize, depending on how many stages you have unlocked in total. In addition to each prize, you will receive a trophy containing RP and SL boosters for 10 battles, 5 backups, or 100,000 SL. List of prizes:
[list]
[*] 1 stage: only Trophy
[*] 2 stages: “Thump it!” or “Get ready” posters
[*] 3 stages: Door Lock or ‘Swede’ axe decorations
[*] 4 stages: “Thump it!” or “Get ready” posters
[*] 5 stages: Door Lock or ‘Swede’ axe decorations
[*] 6 stages: “Twin Left” or “Twin Right” profile icons
[*] 7 stages: “Atomic Heart - MiG-15” or “Atomic Heart - War Machines” loading screens
[*] 8 stages: “Twin Left” or “Twin Right” profile icons
[*] 9 stages: “Atomic Heart - MiG-15” or “Atomic Heart - War Machines” loading screens
[*] 10 stages: “Atomic Heart” title
[/list]
In addition, every day for 1 victory in the event, players will receive a combat trophy containing RP and SL boosters, a wager, an order, or an universal backup!

[h1]“Atomic Heart - MiG-15” or “Atomic Heart - War Machines” loading screens[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5104579c808f4878e054a5d74b8ddb45bccbbb7b.jpg[/img]
[b]"Atomic Hearts - MiG-15" - loading screen[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/eaa3c09cc727849a1bb9de6010f5a80e9c7839eb.jpg[/img]
[b]“Atomic Heart - War Machines” - loading screen[/b]

[h2]Meet the robots![/h2]

[h3]HOG-7 Hedgie[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/343f77aa25935f19f885e4658560fe3fdc995cf6.jpg[/img]

HOG-7 Hedgie is a topographic and geodetic robot with spherical armored hull and four legs. Features an alternative ‘tumbleweed’ moving mode, which allows the robot to accelerate to 30 mph, as well as jumping and slamming. Combat-ready HOG-7 robots come equipped with homing anti-tank missiles with HEAT warheads.

[h3]WSP-9 Laser Pchela[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/889b9f77d1bf85e4609e393e2a54ab83092b4eb8.jpg[/img]

The WSP-9 is a small multi-purpose helicopter drone, equipped with a laser pulse emitter for clearing rubble and demolishing small buildings. For military purposes, the emitter can be effectively used to engage lightly armored vehicles and enemy troops.The WSP-9 is a small multi-purpose helicopter drone, equipped with a laser pulse emitter for clearing rubble and demolishing small buildings. For military purposes, the emitter can be effectively used to engage lightly armored vehicles and enemy troops.

[h3]WSP-9 Repair Pchela[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ee9755232fbcff906abe62cd735f443e6f4b0742.jpg[/img]

To carry out repairs of agricultural, military and other equipment outside the repair shops, the WSP-9 drone is equipped with the electron beam welding torch, capable of repairing refractory metals of tank armor. In the army service, the Pchela repair drones are used by military technician and mechanic units. The Repair Pchela provides control over the BR-1 Burav robot.

[b]Ability: BR-1 Burav[/b]
The mining robot BR-1 Burav was created at Facility 3826 as an autonomous equipment for earthworks, including in rocky conditions, as well as terraforming the Moon and other planets. It is a worm-like mechanism consisting of rotating cylindrical sections and a head with rotary underreamers. The BR-1 is controlled by repair robots of the WSP-9 series.

See you in Test Facility 2271 in the Atomic Thunder event!

Combat-ready HOG-7 robots come equipped with homing anti-tank missiles with HEAT warheads.
WSP-9 Laser Pchela

The WSP-9 is a small multi-purpose helicopter drone, equipped with a laser pulse emitter for clearing rubble and demolishing small buildings. For military purposes, the emitter can be effectively used to engage lightly armored vehicles and enemy troops.The WSP-9 is a small multi-purpose helicopter drone, equipped with a laser pulse emitter for clearing rubble and demolishing small buildings. For military purposes, the emitter can be effectively used to engage lightly armored vehicles and enemy troops.
WSP-9 Repair Pchela

To carry out repairs of agricultural, military and other equipment outside the repair shops, the WSP-9 drone is equipped with the electron beam welding torch, capable of repairing refractory metals of tank armor. In the army service, the Pchela repair drones are used by military technician and mechanic units. The Repair Pchela provides control over the BR-1 Burav robot.
Ability: BR-1 Burav

The mining robot BR-1 Burav was created at Facility 3826 as an autonomous equipment for earthworks, including in rocky conditions, as well as terraforming the Moon and other planets. It is a worm-like mechanism consisting of rotating cylindrical sections and a head with rotary underreamers. The BR-1 is controlled by repair robots of the WSP-9 series.
See you in Test Facility 2271 in the Atomic Thunder event!

notes.title: A Decal and a 3D Decoration Commemorating 80 years from Operation Husky
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ce891911a9b0b77cb4109eb9990faa5124e82dcb.png[/img]

Operation Husky, a large-scale landing of the Allies on Sicily, began on July 9th, 1943. After a month and a half of fighting, the Allies gained full control of the island, opening naval routes through the Mediterranean sea. Soon after, Benito Mussolini was removed from power, Italy reached a peace agreement with the Allies, and Germany was forced to weaken the Eastern front to take hold of Central Italy.

notes.title: It’s fixed! №77
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/749c2e99ea04aba10c029f87cca55942f78df942.jpg[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder in the website special section.

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/3/3800524254168679728/][b][quote]Please feel free to leave your feedback on these changes in the dedicated "It’s fixed! №77" thread[/quote][/b][/url][/h3]


[h2]Going In Blind[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/96570689a41389084c36d1aab761e034c7bf6092.jpg[/img]
Various aircraft suffered from issues with their radar systems. Many fighters, including all versions of Tornado, MiG-23, MiG-27, Su-17, and Su-22, could have dropped an enemy long distance radar lock when a wing changed its sweep. The American F-14B lost its radar lock in the middle of the scanning sector in TWS mode, while radar homing missiles refused to launch even onto locked targets. 

Tornado ADS Marineflieger deserved a special fix. One of its key features is an option to carry up to four AS.34 Kormoran anti-ship missiles in its suspended armament, and in its case the radar’s refusal to lock onto aircraft carriers can easily make it into Top 10 Anime Betrayals. 

Well, all those problems are now behind us, and the radar is once again your trusty and very important instrument in battles.


[h2]Analyse This[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/66c286f17b066b58900d40e1462548cc0232c112.jpg[/img]
Protection analysis is an extremely important feature of War Thunder: it allows players to model different situations in the comfort of their hangar. Will this shell penetrate that armour from this angle? Many players use this opportunity to study the theory before putting it to the test in practice. That’s why when we saw a few issues with the way shots are modelled, we rushed to fix them.

For example, there were cases when an AP round that pierced a vehicle’s defences incorrectly, it changed its trajectory. Or when projectiles that, according to the protection analysis, shouldn’t have penetrated the armour, pierced it completely. But it’s all in the past now.


[h2]Ejecting from a Sinking Ship[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3f8dbfd730d874177ab907dbc0edb3f7a86a0858.jpg[/img]
When turning at maximum speed some ships heel really severely, and you should resist that. But what’s going to happen if you launch a hydroplane from a catapult while the vessel is suffering from a heavy heel?

Well, nothing good. The vessel kept rolling further than it was possible before, eventually capsizing — on its own, without your involvement. Well, these undeserved losses threaten you no more. 


[h1]That’s Not All[/h1]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in a separate patch note — there are lots of interesting things! We’ve eliminated the issues with VR, fixed the way the tank silhouettes are displayed through smoke screens with filters enabled, and made cross-platform settings work correctly on the Xbox again. 

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted using our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]special service[/url].

[h1]Update 2.27.0.78[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/02a2c83c6361a4eed9ef59c9a2cdbfab74db9170.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ground Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug has been fixed that might disable free FPE in online battles.
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused mud from tracks to stay in the air.
[*] A bug has been fixed where TVD was unable to detect enemy vehicles at distances of up to 300 metres while the engine smoke generating system was active.
[*] The incorrect animation of AP rounds in the protection analysis menu has been fixed.
[*] [b]Recon Micro[/b] — a bug has been fixed that caused the UAV to climb high while toggling from flying in orbit mode back to tank view.
[*] [b]Khrizantema-S[/b] — incorrect radar folding animation has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed that resulted in possible penetration in the protection analysis menu when selecting a projectile with insufficient penetration capability. 
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused the camera to zoom below ground on flipped over ground vehicles.
[*] A bug has been fixed that causes APHE rounds to do damage after the fuse is armed in the armour after penetrating through obstacles (side skirts, tracks, etc).
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused the RWS indicator to be active on vehicles without such a module.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused the gunner's camera to tremble with stabilisation enabled.
[*] A bug has been fixed where while selecting a weapon preset without drop tanks, the fuel level remained the same as with drop tanks equipped. 
[*] A bug has been fixed that resulted in the reduction and shift of the allowed ATGM launch frame after depleting all available missiles.
[*] [b]Harrier GR.7[/b] with AGM-65D missiles — incorrect operation of the crosshair has been fixed, this bug caused the crosshair to reset to the standard position while enabling the sight stabilisation.
[*] [b]F-14A Early, Tornado (all versions), MiG-23, MiG-27, Su-17, Su-22[/b] — a bug has been fixed that resulted in the opponent’s lock on reset while changing wing sweep.
[*] [b]Mirage 2000-5F[/b] — a bug has been fixed, where  in the 2xR530D and 2xMagic 2 preset, the R530D missile was unable to fire at a locked target with the report “No self-homing missiles”.
[*] [b]F-14B[/b] — a bug has been fixed in the radar TWS mode, that preserves the lock on target until the middle of the scanning sector, which then reset.
[*] [b]F-14B[/b] — a bug has been fixed that prevented radar homing missile fire at radar acquired targets ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bV5XxTjoEPvT]report[/url]).
[*] [b]F-14A Early[/b] — a bug has been fixed where the values of the attitude indicator in the radar were different from the actual pitch of the aircraft .
[*] [b]Fokker D.XXI-3, Fokker D.XXI[/b] - a bug has been fixed where a tail detachment resulted in massive damage to the aircraft’s fuselage.
[*] [b]SU-22UM3K[/b] - a bug has been fixed where OFAB-250Sh bombs interfered with the pylon. 
[*] [b]MiG-29[/b] - a bug has been fixed where the 6xFAB-500Sh bomb preset  was unable to be copied ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/dF11CFD1V0GS]report[/url])
[*] [b]Jaguar Gr.1[/b] -  a bug has been fixed where the 8x1000lbs Mk.13 No.117 bomb preset was unable to be copied ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/byjSMceG2XtH]report[/url]).
[*] [b]XA-38[/b] - separate bomb drop has been added.
[*] [b]F-104S.ASA[/b] - a bug has been fixed where the range was reset while toggling radar modes. 
[*] [b]Yak-141 and MiG-29[/b] - the inverted inclination indicator in the HUD has been fixed.
[*] [b]Mirage 2000-5F[/b] - a bug has been fixed that prevented missile launch at a radar locked AI target.
[*] [b]Tornado IDS[/b] - a bug has been fixed that prevented locking onto an aircraft carrier.
[*] [b]F-4J Phantom II, F-4S Phantom II[/b] - incorrect (reduced) radar range has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Naval[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Paris[/b] — auxiliary calibre shell types have been changed from Mle 1910 SAPBC to common SAP, and the Mle 1921 common SAP to SAPBC.
[*] [b]HMS Tiger[/b] — a bug has been fixed that resulted in the fire control system disabling after damage to the navigation bridge.
[*] [b]Vautour [/b]— data values of the torpedoes in the x-ray mode have been fixed.
[*] [b]Vautour[/b] — spare charges for the side mortars have been hidden in x-ray mode. 
[*] [b]Emile Bertin[/b] — velocity of the  OEA Mle 1937 HE round has been increased from 860 to 909 m\sec.
[*][b] Colbert[/b] — armouring data of the main turrets has been added to the data card of the ship.
[*] A bug has been fixed where some ships with a catapult might sink due to lurching after launching the scout plane.
[/list]
[h2]Missions and locations[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pradesh[/b] — A bug that caused the airfield air defence to appear on the runway has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Air strike request notification now only sounds when the player presses the corresponding button.
[/list]
[h2]Graphical[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that made it possible to see tank silhouettes through smoke screens when using some NVIDIA filters has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Tb17covApR7W]report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused armoured vehicles partially in smoke might disappear from visibility has been fixed.
[*] [b]Su-25[/b] - FPS drop when automatically dropping empty S-250 containers after ammo firing has been fixed. 
[*] A bug that caused the display of shadows of already destroyed objects has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused artefacts to appear in naval vessels’ reflections in water on low, medium and high graphic settings when moving the camera sideways has been fixed.
[*] Low polygonal display of aircraft crew in the X-Ray view in the spectator mode has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug when calculating the vehicle BR for the battle blocked vehicles have also been taken into account has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/6tlVGpfK9sin]report[/url]).
[*] A bug where in the control settings, instead of binding the axis to the joystick the binding of the axis to the mouse was shown has been fixed.
[*] A bug where the names of shells were displayed incorrectly in the block for selecting shells in battle in the vehicle selection window has been fixed.
[*] A bug where in the armour analysis the ability to select the shells of some types couldn't be seen as available has been fixed.
[*] Lack of localization in the control help window for the helicopter has been fixed.
[*] Missing friend request notification if friend request have been sent while the invited player was already logged out has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Xbox[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that made it impossible to join a cross-platform game has been fixed (report).
[*] A bug that made it impossible to play with users of other platforms in squads with the cross-platform game setting turned off has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Linux[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused mouse aiming to stop working when the chat window was active has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]VR[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed sky reprojection in Pimax
[*] A bug that led to incorrect stereoscopic displaying of the sky has been fixed.
[*] Binocular position of atmospheric effects on the horizon that made it difficult to form a single volumetric visual image has been fixed. 
[*] A bug that might cause the client to crash when launching the game in VR has been fixed.
[/list]
[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

notes.title: Decal for French Air Force Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/68388740abd4a7539fe4431506571bb3688d5451.jpg[/img]

France was one of the first countries to use aviation in combat: by the beginning of World War I it had 15 airships and almost 150 aircraft. Still, they were a part of the army until the French Air Force became independent on July 2nd, 1934. Today the French Air and Space Force employ over 40,000 people, and their main combat aircraft are the Mirage 2000 and Rafale.

[h2][quote]From July 3rd (10:00 GMT) until July 6th (10:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using French aircraft (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “French Air Force Day” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/271e4c1077e19f897f54e7d01ce81c6b5e294f57.png[/img]
[b]“French Air Force Day”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → French Air Force Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Decal for Canada Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6e89e63a11dd671bbe39aa9e541bc5a1a5238e02.jpg[/img]

On July 1st, 1867, the British North America Act united various provinces in a single Dominion of Canada. However, for the first 100 years the Canadians didn’t celebrate this date: it became more prominent the more independence Canada gained from the United Kingdom. Today it is a grand national holiday with parades, carnivals, and concerts.

notes.title: Three Different Vehicles and a Decal for The JSDF Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/452cc8f6c602db6cb2b4890d19cd174dafc403af.jpg[/img]

On July 1st, 1954 the Japan Self-Defense Forces were founded — the new armed forces that were to replace the Imperial Army and Navy that lost in WWII. Today the JSDF employs almost 250 thousand people, and, besides defending Japan, they often participate in peacekeeping and rescue operations around the world. 

[h2]J2M4 Kai, IJN Kiyoshimo, and Type 74 (G) for Golden Eagles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/817e7e1269b465bc54c5e2673299167038a1e394.jpg[/img]
[b]J2M4 Kai[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/789b7ab4be9e6e4435b7320e6d3bebd68394f943.jpg[/img]
[b]IJN Kiyoshimo[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e085f8913621710164f273d249cc8401e5c6a405.jpg[/img]
[b]Type 74 (G)[/b]

To commemorate the anniversary of the Japan Self-Defense Forces, from June 30th (11:00 GMT) until July 4th (9:00 GMT) three different Japanese vehicles — an aircraft, a ship, and a tank — will return for sale for Golden Eagles. Pick whichever you like!

J2M4 Kai Raiden is one of the most agile Japanese fighters of World War II era, with great climbing speed and strong armament, perfect for Boom and Zoom attacks. Fast, maneuverable and quite sturdy destroyer IJN Kiyoshimo is equipped with deadly torpedoes and 127 mm main calibre guns with great ballistics that reload really quickly and often make it the victor of naval duels. Finally, the Type 74 (G) is the final and most advanced modification of the main battle tank of the JSDF; it is outfitted with a thermal imager and a powerful laser rangefinder, and its APFSDS shells are one of the best on its rank!


[h2]“Japan Self-Defense Forces” decal[/h2]

[h2][quote]From June 30th (11:00 GMT) until July 4th (9:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using Japanese vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Japan Self-Defense Forces Day” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/fc07bbcdbe1c2047650053ed6528ca53aca95f9d.png[/img]
[b]“Japan Self-Defense Forces Day”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → JSDF Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Two fighters and a decal for Swedish Air Force Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3f578e66c116c68aa87a684518593e0260433113.jpg[/img]

On July 1st, 1926 the Swedish Air Force was created by merger of airborne divisions of army and navy. Even though it didn’t participate in World War II, it was preparing to by raising its numbers — and kept doing it in the beginning of the Cold War. By 1957 Sweden held the fourth most powerful air force in the world, consisting of a thousand modern aircraft. After the Cold War ended, Sweden massively decreased the number of aircraft in its service: currently its Air Force employs only about 200 vehicles. 

[h2]J29D and J35A Fighters for Golden Eagles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b2816a056492a299fadb142498a9657f206f9517.jpg[/img]
[b]J29D Tunnan[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4f5cbb4852838e539cd081296a25670a8e98b6af.jpg[/img]
[b]J35A Draken[/b]

[h2][quote]From June 30th (09:00 GMT) until July 4th (09:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

Two Swedish jet fighters will be available for purchase for Golden Eagles. J29D Tunnan looks really weird, but don’t let its appearance fool you: it’s really fast and well-equipped, perfect for any role! J35A Draken is capable of going supersonic, and yet it turns quite quickly, and thanks to that it often emerges victorious in air duels. 

[h2]“Swedish Air Force Day” decal[/h2]

[h2][quote]From 30th (09:00 GMT) until July 4th (09:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using Swedish aircraft (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Swedish Air Force Day” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5b0459b36e5c67e47bff820d12f8bf3b53b0ea15.png[/img]
[b]“Swedish Air Force Day”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Swedish Air Force Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Following the Roadmap: maps for aircraft, flares and repair
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3da077d6df4199b5eb413cf724a3b3a6971debb4.jpg[/img]

We continue to let you know about the improvements we are implementing based on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/6250480881382501852]War Thunder updates roadmap[/url]. Today, we are going to talk about improving the map rotation for air battles as well as increasing the availability of flares and the ability to extinguish fires and repair vehicles.

[h2]Flares from the start[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7a25e3c77fd25b4dd1e8ac5852ff9addef349760.jpg[/img]

An important point that we mentioned in our roadmap - increasing the availability of a number of mechanics. In the case of aircraft, countermeasures, and in the case of armoured vehicles and naval vessels, it is about repairing and extinguishing fires. The changes are already in the game: the default set of countermeasures is now available immediately after vehicle research and you no longer need to additionally unlock it!

When researching the “Flares/chaff” modification (or similar) you will unlock options such as “Chaff only”, “Flares reinforced” and “Flare priority”. Additional countermeasure kits such as BOL-type systems, additional containers with Chaff or additional countermeasures kits on the Mirage 2000 and Kurnass 2000 still require separate modifications to be researched.

[h2]Advanced FPE and repair kit[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c300b8f45f45a28d9efc003c5cd8e5211887ca09.jpg[/img]

FPE for ground vehicles is divided into a regular, single extinguishment, which is available without unlocking any modification, and advanced, which requires modification research, which once unlocked, adds the possibility of double extinguishment.

Repair kits for ground vehicles are also divided into normal and advanced. Normal, available without unlocking a modification, enables you to perform field repairs on all modules up to partial functionality. Penalties to vehicle characteristics after repair of modules with field repair in AB and RB are changed as follows:
[list]
[*] Gun spread multiplier has been changed from х15 to х5;
[*] Guidance angles have been changed from 3 to 6 degrees;
[*] Transmission losses have been changed from 50% to 25%;
[*] Engine power reduction has been changed from 60% to 40%.
[/list]

Once the advanced repair kit has been researched, this will speed up the repair process and allow you to make repairs without penalties to module functionality.

In naval battles, even vessels without upgrades now have all the tools for firefighting, module repair, breach repair and pumping water - their “field repair” is now replaced with battle for survivability. Without the researched modification, you will be able to conduct it in the former way. You can manually start each process with the buttons of firefighting, repair and water pumping. The crew of a new ship that just came into service will take longer to do this than an experienced trained crew, but even the normal firefighting system has no limit on the number of uses.

The crew can be trained in damage control and effective firefighting with the help of modifications. They are located in the place of the former tools and FPE. There is no need to upgrade them again: players who have previously researched these modifications already have them unlocked.

[h2]Improved map rotations for aircraft[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c4367281583b633b6fa6c07dd97da33e52426d63.jpg[/img]

We want battles to be as interesting and intense as possible and therefore based on our statistics and your feedback, we have revised the availability of a number of missions depending on the BR of the vehicles participating in the battle. Generally, smaller maps will now be available at low BR and larger maps at higher BR. Some missions, those that most often have fallen into the ban list of the players, have been completely removed from the rotation. Some of these changes have already been implemented in the major “La Royale” update and some we have just added. 

[b]Removed from the rotation:[/b]
[Air Battle] France 1944
[Operation] Husky
[Operation] The Last Battle of Khalkhyn Gol

[b]Only available up to BR 2.0:[/b]
[Operation] Middle East
[Operation] Cochinchina
[Operation] Battle for Vietnam

[b]Only available on BR from 2.3 to 5.0:[/b]
[Operation] Laizhou bay
[Operation] Battle of Spain

[b]Only available on BR from 2.3 to 6.7:[/b]
[Front Line] Kursk

[b]Only available on BR from 4.0:[/b]
[Operation] Pyrenees
[Operation] Bourbon Island
[Operation] Malta
[Operation] Peleliu
[Event] Attack on Wake Island
[Operation] Midway

[b]Only available on BR from 5.7:[/b]
[Operation] Battle at Malta

We also introduced the display of a mission’s BR in the window of the preferred missions - now you can ignore maps that you don’t get rated within when compiling your list.

Despite the fact that we have added a display of the BR in the maps filter, the distribution of bans, likes and dislikes has not changed much, and many players ban those maps that are not usually played. Please update your filters to reflect the selection of maps you do and don’t want to see. Please also continue to let us know what you think about the selection of maps for those or other vehicle ranks in this special thread on the forum so that we can adjust it further. 
 
We are continuing to make progress on the War Thunder development roadmap and we hope you will be pleased with these changes. Share your opinion in the comments, social media, on Steam or on the official forum!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7a70f30cba1396d0fee8042afe611898de551c35.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Decal for the British Armed Forces Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3af6f90bd3dc4898857f247b55e2e658f0f6ddee.png[/img]

The United Kingdom celebrates its armed forces on the last Saturday of June — which is 24th this year. A week before the holiday, flags of the armed forces are raised across the country, and on June 21st a Reserve Day is held: the UK celebrates its veterans, cadets, and civil servants alike! 


[h2][quote]From June 23rd (11:00 GMT) until June 26th (7:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[b]“British Armed Forces Day”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → British Armed Forces Day.

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Rankings Challenge: 2023 Grand Finals and Twitch Drops
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZqYv33PsZNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The first season of the Ranking Challenge is over — congratulations to all the participants! Over 70,000 competitors from around the world took part in aircraft and ground vehicle battles and received unique titles, sports camouflages, and other prizes. Final tournaments of the season are up next! The best of the best will challenge each other for the season champion status and will be able to receive camouflages, vehicle coupons, and Golden Eagles and will also split the $3000 prize pool! Also, to commemorate the release of La Royale major update and make watching eSports events even more pleasant, we are offering Drops for the Twitch viewers! Let’s break it down.

[h2]Rankings Challenge Leagues[/h2]

As we said before, players who were placed high enough in the leaderboards will gain access to the Super Finals. We’ve expanded the number of tournaments in the Finals while dividing them by Leagues: Gold, Silver, and Bronze. So in air 1v1 and ground 2v2 battles there will be three tournaments each instead of one — meaning that even more players will be able to compete for the special awards of the season! 5v5 mixed battles tournament will be available for everyone and will start with qualifications. 

All players who received access to the Grand Finals tournaments on the [url=https://tss.warthunder.com/index.php?action=current_tournaments]TSS.WARTHUNDER.COM[/url] portal will receive the “War Thunder eSports” decal, a notification in the game and a special ticket in their inventory that will unlock registration for the related tournament.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ee6e8a5a14d76ea5613aeaf157fc700111f65fa5.png[/img]

[b]“War Thunder eSports”[/b] decal

[h2]“Fire Front”: Qualifications and Grand Finals[/h2]

5v5 mixed battles are one of the most spectacular eSports formats. We decided to open up qualifications for all players. Qualifications consist of the group stage and the double elimination Bo1 play-off. The best 8 teams will fight for the status of ultimate champion of the season in the Grand Finals that will be held in the double elimination Bo3 format. 

[h2][quote]Registration for the Fire Front Grand Finals qualifications is already open, and the first battles will begin at 16:00 GMT on June 24th.[/quote][/h2]

[url=https://tss.warthunder.com/index.php?action=tournament&id=17854 style=button]REGISTRATION[/url] 

[h2]Qualifications rewards [/h2]
The best players in the qualifications will receive a special camouflage for the 2S3M and the Bf 109 F-4, coupons for Rankings Challenge camouflages for Spitfire XVI, Chieftain Mk.3, Wirbelwind, and T-44, memorable decals and titles, among which is “Jack of all Trades”. The combined prize pool of the qualifications is 100 100 Golden Eagles.

You can find the full list of rewards on the [url=https://tss.warthunder.com/index.php?action=tournament&id=17854#info-prize_infoTournament]tournament page[/url].

[h2]Grand Finals rewards[/h2]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/539123fc1170162d5715e2c89a24ac2d4e49f188.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/241e2a00921ba27081727b32df8c5316b1d00749.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f2b7d8603ade141998fd8af72a0cf295568ccab2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8bfa0732ebc1835e1b39a12488d03bd3edc72751.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

All Grand Finals participants will receive coupons for unique camouflages for Seafire F.Mk.XVII, N1K1-ja, Ikv 91, and AMX-13. Players who earn places 1 through 3 will each receive a coupon for VK 45.01 (P) (Germany).

The winning team will receive 2100 GJN!

[h1]“Fire Front” Grand Finals Streams and Twitch Drops[/h1]

Watch Thunder eSports streams on content partners’ channels and the Fire Front tournament exclusively on War Thunder eSports channels — and earn Twitch Drops!

notes.title: Update 2.27.0.48
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/97aaeef6addd687bd0d69783396c7a9c46e0a4da.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] The highlighting of values in the HUD interface in the “Fighter Control Basics” tutorial mission has been fixed.
[*] Now when you rotate the camera it will zoom if there is another player in a ship or ground vehicle between camera position and you.
[*] Search for decals and decorations by name has been added to the customization menu.
[*] A bug where queuing did not occur from the battle result window when pressing the “To battle” button has been fixed.
[*] A bug where after opening the contact window in the respawn menu, when opening the tactical map in the battle, it blinked, has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Ground vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]BMP-1, ZBD86, SPz BMP-1, BMP-2[/b] — The dissimilar thickness of the tracks and the thickness of the spare tracks has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/p/warthunder/i/xUnUACgi3bwZ]report[/url]).
[*] [b]BMP-2M[/b] — Missing tracks in damage model has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/p/warthunder/i/ZLg8DieOkqwx]report[/url]).
[*] [b]LAV-AD[/b] — A bug that caused flooding of the vehicle while moving on water has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/qW0n2v6G1hAt]report[/url]).
[*] [b]Begleitpanzer 57, M113A1 (TOW)[/b] — A bug which caused underestimation of armour penetration of TOW compared to the same ATGM on other vehicles has been fixed.
[*] [b]Stridsvagn 81[/b] — Incorrect designation of the bulkhead material in the X-Ray view has been fixed.
[*] Blinking of the engine status indicator on the DM panel when the radiator is damaged has been added.
[/list]
[h2]Naval[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Milan[/b] — A bug in the name of the anchored mine has been fixed.
[*] [b]Vautour[/b] — A bug in the name of the 75mm gun has been fixed.
[*] [b]Paris[/b] — The aiming speed of the main calibre turrets has been adjusted: on traverse 3 → 4.5 degrees per second; elevation 4 → 3 degrees per second.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Mirage 2000C-S5, Mirage 2000D-R1, Mirage 2000-5F[/b] - Drag has been adjusted and supersonic acceleration has been increased. 
[*] A bug in the ammunition type designation for unguided air missiles which led to the inability to perform destruction missions on vehicles using rockets has been fixed.
[*] [b]Lynx AH.Mk.1 / G-LYNX[/b] — A bug which made it impossible to copy the “Hydra-70 x38 and 20mm Oerlikon KDA” set when creating a new weaponry preset has been fixed.
[*] [b]H-34[/b] — A bug in the display of weapon launcher elements for presets with unguided air missiles and machine gun armament has been fixed.
[*] [b]Mirage 2000D-R1 / A-6E TRAM[/b] — A bug with inability to activate night vision mode during flight in 3rd person view has been fixed. 
[*] [b]Su-22M4 / Su-17М2[/b] — Icons in the weaponry menu for displaying H-29T and H-29L missiles have been fixed.
[*] [b]AIM-54C[/b] — Weight of the explosive mass has been changed from 47.3 to 42.7kg. Source: “Hazard classification of United States military explosives and munitions”.
[*] A bug where when editing suspended weapons for the Su-6 (AM-42) when replacing one paired cannon group with others, only one cannon was installed in the slots and not two, has been fixed.
[*] [b]UH-1C[/b] — A bug where ATGMs could fail to launch even if the sight was close to the middle of the allowed launch zone has been fixed.
[/list]
[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

notes.title: Server Update 20.06 (Economy)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/825c6118b0a3330690d7d6c7aab34cfa69aca0de.png[/img]

[list]
[*] According to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3667665767286001045]poll results[/url] (over 97% support for changes) and the  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3667665767286445746]War Thunder development roadmap[/url], the proposed economic changes are now in effect:
[list]
[*] Reward multiplier increased and repair cost reduced for the vast majority of vehicles in the game.  These changes are designed to make all vehicles ‘break even’, even without a Premium account.
[*] The calculation of economic indicators for each vehicle is created from the average values of the vehicle class and Battle Rating, instead of on the personal statistics of each vehicle. This change is aimed to make the reward multipliers and repair costs of similar vehicles (of the same class, BR, and economic rank) very similar or equal to each other.
[/list]
[*] In accordance with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3667665767286445746]development roadmap[/url], the available BR indicator has been added to the preferred locations and missions window.
[/list]
[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

notes.title: Following the Roadmap: Updated Economy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e7bca02b17ba34738f5ef01276d0a6037a8f8a37.png[/img]

We continue to move forward with the plans listed in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3667665767286445746]our roadmap[/url], and the next big news after the La Royale major update is the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3667665767286001045]updated economу[/url] that the majority of the community voted for.

The highly anticipated update is here! Repair costs have been reduced, while SL gain has been increased — so that, on average, players using vehicles of any rank will break even, even without a premium account. These changes affect the overwhelming majority of vehicles in the game, meaning that the average player is likely to notice them after several battles. 

Additionally, vehicles of the same class, battle rating, and economic rank will now have very similar economic characteristics. You can learn more from these spreadsheets:

[list]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQuMLRIzixGiLBG0RPTSRrTkb97eqxiZNQddMj_2NsAUsohhoDItb813kzoop8D2z8mTgw1epyBSDdt/pubhtml]Average repair cost and reward changes by ranks[/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRkkbL8XchYFqjxA8uoZTuPvCMVx5LmXbjszw8JJAka_SP9XImASlGUNvVKBae7gHFWubKTM5jy2Tdk/pubhtml]Repair cost changes by vehicle[/url]
[/list]

Another great new feature: now in the preferred locations and missions window you’ll instantly see which battle rating each mission is available at. This will make choosing your preferred locations and missions easier. 

As we release the planned changes in our roadmap, we'll also continue to update the infographic, so that you can easily see what we have already implemented. Here is the latest version!

Check out these improvements and tell us what you think: on Steam, social media or the official forums!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6474d367fe8214b955a02d2e7e7300568e8facab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.27.0.29
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/919a6b7e1c6b32162f7f21f105f57142a57630d2.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] An error on entering the hangar has been fixed that might occur with some graphic cards with outdated drivers.
[*] A bug has been fixed where enemy tanks were not displayed entirely in replays, only the 3d decorations were.
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused a game client crash while switching to the cockpit view on the MAC platform.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]J34[/b] - a bug has been fixed where rocket pods were displayed on the aircraft without secondary armament.
[*] [b]Tu-14T[/b] - bomb drop order has been corrected.
[*] [b]Late 298D[/b] - turret targeting angles have been corrected to avoid shooting through the tail.
[*] [b]T18B[/b] - a bug has been fixed where a dropping torpedo was displayed through the bomb bay doors.
[*] [b]SAAB-105G[/b] - a bug with a missing pylon for one of the Mk82 Snakeye bombs has been fixed.
[*] [b]MiG-29 (9-12А)[/b] - a bug has been fixed that prevented dubbing of the FAB-500Sh bomb preset.
[*] Low resolution of the 2nd generation TVD on some helicopters has been fixed.
[*] [b]A-7E, A-7D, A-7K[/b] - max wing payload has been corrected.
[*] [b]Buccaneer S1[/b] - a bug affecting display of the instruments in the cockpit view has been fixed.
[*] [b]Jaguar A/E[/b] - texture of the flare pod has been fixed
[*] [b]Phantom FG.1[/b] - drop tanks have been added.
[*] [b]J-8F[/b] - name of the radar has been fixed in the xray view.
[*] [b]F-4F Late[/b] - twin shots of the AGM-65 missiles have been fixed.
[*] [b]F-5E, F-104J[/b] - missing HUD in the cockpit view has been restored.
[*] A bug has been fixed that allowed drop tanks to be ejected whilst the aircraft was on the ground.
[/list]
[h2]Ground vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]SARC Mk IVa[/b] - smoke reload has been added.
[*] [b]AuF1[/b] - thickness of the barrel has been increased from 35 to 40 mm, similar to other vehicles with guns of the same calibre.
[*] [b]Freccia[/b] - magnification of the LOTHAR sight has been increased from 2-9х to 9-20х. Source.
[*] [b]Sherman III/IV[/b] - armouring has been fixed.
[*] [b]SANTAL[/b] — a bug has been fixed that prevented the vehicle from turning while floating in water. The discharge order of the smoke grenades has been changed.
[/list]
[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Voice messages of the tank crew about switching on/off of the night vision mode have been removed.
[*] Sound of the automatic cannon Vulcan M168, M61A1, JM61A1 has been corrected to exactly match the claimed 6000 rpm fire rate (3000 in the alternate mode).
[*] The sound of enemy/allied ground vehicles engines becomes more noticeable or muffled with distance.
[*] The work on the new dialogs of the ground vehicles crews is still in progress. Incorrect replies will be fixed, poor acting of voice-overs will be re-recorded. This will be implemented to all languages, but first of all for Polish and Chinese, since there are many complaints.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.27.0.22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ac307243958e20c463e787b38c448d30462224e6.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] A bug has been fixed that prevented completion of Battle tasks, Battle Pass tasks, as well as some other tasks and achievements.
[*] A bug has been fixed that caused trees to grow on some types of airfields in aircraft missions.
[*] Destruction mechanics of APDS and APCR rounds have been changed. Now, the projectile doesn’t destroy with impact, but loses armour piercing capability depending on thickness of the first armoured obstacle, as well as in the spaces between armoured elements affected.
[*] The fragments generation template of ground vehicles and aircraft HE shells has been changed. Piercing capability, spray and damage has increased.
[*] [b]Challenger 2[/b] — incorrect display of the dozer blade has been corrected.
[*] [b]SARC Mk IVA[/b] — missing parts have been returned to the damage model.
[*] [b]М1 KVT[/b] — gun elevation limits dependent on the Vismod modification have been removed.
[*] [b]IS-2 (1944)[/b] — smoke reload at captured points has been added.
[/list]

[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

notes.title: Become a Tester for the French Navy!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d1a9aad2511950a60fa5f6747bf042469414f7d2.jpg[/img]

One of the largest and oldest naval fleets in the world, nicknamed La Royale back in the 17th century, has arrived at War Thunder! Its research tree consists of destroyers and cruisers of the French Navy. You can receive access to the closed beta test of the French Navy by either completing a set of tasks or purchasing one of the French naval packs.

Complete the tasks or become the owners of French naval packs and instantly receive the Tester status.

[h2][quote]The tasks are available from June 14th, 11:00 GMT until July 24th, 11:00 GMT.[/quote][/h2]

[list]
[*] Complete 12 daily tasks to receive the Tester status.
[*] Become an owner of one of the French naval packs and be the first to receive the Tester status!
[/list]

[h2]How to get the Tester Star[/h2]

[list]
[*] Earn 10,000 mission points in random sea battles on vehicles of Rank III or higher.
[*] The task resets at 11:00 GMT every day.
[/list]

[h2]CBT access packs[/h2]

By purchasing one of these premium vehicle packs, you will instantly receive access to research for the French Navy. To purchase, click Shop > Online Store whilst in the in-game hangar.

[h3]Aigle Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/694e92073f5bdc30658101267c48ffa284c93e82.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Aigle-class C, Aigle 1942 (Rank II)
[*] 1000 Golden Eagles
[*] Premium account for 7 days
[*] [b]French Naval CBT Access[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Duguay-Trouin Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/29fc25f66078ac0ec115f6e48656a5fe519d0e40.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Duguay-Trouin-class, Duguay-Trouin, 1944 (Rank III)
[*] 2000 Golden Eagles
[*] Premium account for 15 days
[*] [b]French Naval CBT Access[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Terms[/h2]
[list]
[*] Receive 12 Tester Stars to unlock access to researching the French Navy. You can earn 1 star each day
[*] Tasks are reset at 11:00 GMT each day.
[*] For 10 Tester Stars you will receive a special decal “Emblem of the French Navy”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/654085598bf778b2dd37af5411a43c1f08a2ba55.png[/img]
[b]“Emblem of the French Navy”[/b] decal
[*] You can follow your progress by clicking on your Nickname → Achievements → “French Naval CBT".
[*] The time window for receiving the Tester Stars is not related to the completion of the French Naval CBT.
[*] We do not plan to reset any research progress for the French Navy after the CBT ends.
[/list]

notes.title: Meet Major Update "La Royale"!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bWL1aaaao8c;full][/previewyoutube]

The beginning of the Closed Beta Test for the French Naval forces, new and updated graphical effects for flares, afterburners, rockets and missiles along with new hit marks on ground vehicles. More than 50 new or updated vehicles. Amongst them 14 new ships for the French Navy! But sailors are not the only ones to find something for themselves here! The Mighty F-14B, three different Sukhoi jets, the unusual M1 KVT tank or the first tank from India in WT - Vijayanta! Two new locations, fortifications mechanics, new weapons for aircraft and much more awaits you in La Royale update!

[quote][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/0/3819662889073467517/]Please feel free to leave your feedback on this Major update in the feedback thread by clicking here[/url][/h3][/quote]

[h1]New mechanics and graphical updates[/h1]
Something nice for everyone! New fortification mechanics for naval maps, new flare effects,  new flight effects for rockets and missiles and updated flight physics for most anti-aircraft and anti-tank missiles. More realistic hit marks from high-explosive shells, functional radiators for armoured vehicles and wire-guided ATGMs trailing a visible wire behind them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/43badefa31cf8c02932389f2277e588cc300daed.gif[/img]

[h1]Ground vehicles[/h1]
18 new vehicles, among them the eye-catching German Raketenautomat, the Israeli Magach Hydra and a 155mm Au F.1 SPG from France! It is also impossible to ignore the early WWII Pz.38(t) n.A. or a US Cold War vision of the Soviet MTB - M1 KVT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/70df7291925636acce907bdca9be31feebb6db85.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/693c2b5391f74045a36aafba16214abfcd006735.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/930466627b458f5b0b35077e244aa7d89ffaaff2.png[/img]

[h1]Aviation[/h1]
A dozen aircraft, from the new reserve machine - the BF2C-1 biplane to the F-14B - a new top-tier naval jet for the American tech tree. Along with it will come the Su-25T and Su-39, J8F and Mirage 2000 5F. We haven't forgotten about older machines either. Wirrway has undergone a full facelift and received a new 3d model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8f0a708b65d6a81798bcb642b7cf4cd23b52dee2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/86b49f66275444ffdaa23e9d7e16ff92d73a2fd7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/13a55d85e8438da610a2f16912035adee2e48207.jpg[/img]

[h1]Helicopters[/h1]
6 machines received a brand new cockpit, and the Ka-50 and Ka-52 have been upgraded with a crew ejection animation.

[h1]Naval Fleet[/h1]
The 14 new ships will give the start of the French Navy's closed beta tests. On top of that, the following ships will be coming to the game: German Z-46, Soviet Braviy, British HMS Daring and Japanese Ise! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/57576439900e8d837d25d8ba87aafaf65c3e6e86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/be87c1ea14429260f9d73269445ad394e571f040.png[/img]

[h1]New locations and missions[/h1]
[list]
[*] New location for combined battles "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3683425829412718892]Iberian Castle[/url]".
[*] New location for naval battles "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/6504931091336174021]Franz Josef Land[/url]".

Two missions of the new type, Air Conquest, have been added on two locations: Israel and Smolensk. Mission rules:
[list]
[*] There are three capture zones in the mission: a small central air zone and two airfield zones on the sides of the central zone
[*] There is ground support in the mission as in the “assault” missions and the models and placing of the ground vehicles depend on the battle rank.
[*] There are bases for bombing in the mission which spawn 15 seconds after being destroyed.
[*] Player aircraft respawns are not as high as in Assault missions and the number of respawns has been reduced.
[*] Bomber respawns are higher than respawns for fighters and closer to the centre of the mission (in normal assault missions bomber respawns are further from the centre of the mission than fighters).
[/list]

[h2]Naval weaponry:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reloading on a captured point has been reworked.[/b] — ammunition of the non automatic artillery now replenishes in batches, instead of shell after shell. The number of rounds in a batch depends on the maximum capacity of the ammo stowage.

[*] [b]Mark 108 Weapon Alpha[/b] — engine characteristics and the drag have been adjusted to correct the trajectory.
[*] [b]Saetta P-494[/b] — fixed an error when launching the Nettuno missile with a high elevation angle against distant targets that caused the missile to collide with the water surface soon after launch.
[*] [b]Nettuno[/b] — Rocket engine operation mode parameters and air resistance have been specified. The weight of explosives in the missile’s warhead has been reduced to 6 kg.
[/list]
[h2]Naval characteristics, physics and damage model:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Propeller shafts are separated into independent modules. Now they have their own functionality and damage model: the propeller shaft pairs with the specific engine room and operates as a part of it. If the shaft is damaged, the ship loses speed in proportion to the force generated by this shaft. If there is no damage to the engine room, the maximum speed will still drop until the shaft is repaired. For now, shafts are separated only on battleships. With each new upcoming update, other vessels will also receive separate shafts.
[*] The damage model for battleships has been improved - the crew of a battleship is now distributed mainly in the citadel. Modules covered with armour are now of great value. A situation where significant losses might be inflicted on the crew located outside the armour protected area in auxiliary calibre mounts, on or below the upper deck has been fixed. Now another battleship or battlecruiser can deal serious one-time damage to a battleship if it successfully penetrates its armour and hits the most important internal modules. Note that this approach more clearly demonstrates the tactics of battle on battleships: choosing the distance to the enemy, choosing the angle by which the ship's hull is turned, etc. And let us recall that the losses in the ship's crew show not only and not so much the "killed and wounded", but, mainly, people who have lost the opportunity to perform their combat duties. The crew is always tied to a specific module, such as a boiler room, gun, or gun mount. A disabled mount is conditionally equal to the loss of its entire crew, before replenishment and repair.
[/list]
[b]The training system for new players have been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] Help for assigned keys, events, and abilities has been added, It will be shown more proportionally, no more than two or three tips/hints per battle. Displayed will be only the information which a new player needs and the function has not been used yet.
[*] The loading screens for the first naval battles have been redesigned to include up-to-date and visual information on targets and missions.
[*] The control help window (F1) has been redesigned - all information has been updated.
[*] Help on the orientation in the hangar between the first battles has been added.
[*] Help for modifications and ammo has been added.
[*] Dynamic training for blue water ships control has been integrated in the first sea battle.
[/list]

[list]
[*] PT-76 (China)  - The tank will be hidden (in two weeks from the major update release) from the Chinese ground vehicles tree and will be not available for research.
