SACLOS missiles are capable of acquiring targets at 16 kilometers and are excellent for destroying aircraft at long and medium distances.
Moreover, Volna-M missiles are also capable of hitting lightly armored surface targets, dealing tremendous damage when their 30 kg warheads detonate inside the hull.
The main guns of the destroyer are a pair of 130mm cannons in one mount with a total ammo of 500 rounds.
Radar and radio-fuzed shells make these guns an effective long-range air defense system, while three quadruple 45mm mounts shred to pieces any aircraft at low altitude.
Project 56K Braviy is a very specific ship that can be used in various battle scenarios, especially as an excellent air shield for early dreadnoughts or as an island ambusher.
Braviy will appear at rank IV of the Soviet bluewater fleet with the release of the upcoming major War Thunder update - goodness, we can't wait!

notes.title: Le Malin: the malign destroyer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/045848c4a4137ce5f1624442bbca7d822e1d5a29.png[/img]

[i]The French large destroyer Le Malin of the Le Fantasque class was built to chase and hunt other destroyers.[/i]

[h2]Le Malin, destroyer, French. Rank III.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Hard-hitting main caliber guns
[*] Effective AA guns
[*] Thin-skinned gun mounts
[*] Huge profile
[/list]
We continue to introduce you to the bluewater fleet of France, which will be added to the game with the release of the next major War Thunder update. The destroyers of the Le Fantasque class are among the most famous ships of this type in history. Meet Le Malin, “the malign one", the Le Fantasque-class destroyer with powerful main battery armament, excellent sailing performance and deadly anti-air battery!

Le Fantasque-class destroyers were originally designed as destroyer hunters that operate as part of a group of ships of the same type and fight more like light cruisers. That is why the main armament of the Le Malin besides torpedoes is very powerful artillery. The Mle 1929 138.6mm guns with half-closed 10 mm anti-fragmentation shields are placed along the ship in a linearly elevated layout. Due to their design, the gun mounts are poorly protected from enemy fire, especially from fragments and shrapnel, and have quite low traverse speed. However, the satisfying ballistics and effective semi-AP rounds make the destroyer a very dangerous enemy even for ships of heavier classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/65beed888f05ab631ddbe6e2d96d006f4adf25e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c40946ffcf42f5bb84c8dd691d3dbbd5ed5fc951.jpg[/img]

In our game, Le Malin will be presented in the latest configuration after the upgrade in Boston in 1943. The originally poor anti-aircraft armament, which they tried to strengthen in each of the five ship upgrades, finally turned out to be quite effective, including two twin-barreled and one quad mount of the 40mm Bofors autocannons and 10 20mm Oerlikons. During the same upgrade in Boston, the ship received two additional mortars for 100-kg depth charges, bringing their total number to four. But the torpedo armament had to be reduced, abandoning one of the three triple-tube launchers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/66171b42cfa9d268f5874178575c2983385f4c7d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/07002e4fb0db34ca9dbec71ef54a21aff313aebf.jpg[/img]

The Le Malin - big, fast and malign -  will appear in the game in the next major War Thunder update. Get early access packs to the French Navy СBT and you can be the first to test the amazing ships of one of the most distinctive fleets in the world!

notes.title: Grumman F-14B Tomcat: The Bombcat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2177e949211e9f36f82977ad9400d3d7561b1898.jpg[/img]

[i]A new top-tier US naval jet fighter that comes equipped with more powerful engines and new weapons![/i]

[h2]F-14B Tomcat, jet fighter, USA, rank VIII[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Better thrust and climb rate
[*] Gorgeous AIM-54 Phoenix missiles
[*] Guided bombs
[*] TISEO (Target Identification System, Electro Optical)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3e08f4b4c655e02e839c6edd215dcb890c35f9dd.jpg[/img]
Today we'll talk about the top-tier US naval fighter, which will be added to the game in the next major War Thunder update. So, meet the F-14B, a modified version of the formidable F-14A - a significantly expanded arsenal of weapons and improved rate of climb.

The upgraded version of the Tomcat received new, more high-torque engines, which give the fighter a noticeable increase in climb rate to about 225 m/s, while maintaining approximately the same speed and fuel consumption as the F-14A version. An interesting option for fans of Simulation Battles will be the TISEO optical target identification system. This system allows you to view the target acquired by the radar on the monitor in the cockpit, if the enemy aircraft is not too far away. However, the main good news for American pilots is the improved armament of the F-14B!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/dd3b17c38a66c6d03ed390bd30d3e080c7435edb.jpg[/img]

So, for air combat, the main specialty of the F-14, the new version is equipped with more advanced AIM-9L air-to-air missiles (up to four), a later version of the Sparrow missile AIM-7M (up to six), as well as two modifications of the magnificent Phoenix long range missiles: the AIM-54A and the new AIM-54C with an improved inertial navigation system, which improves the accuracy of the cruising to the target at medium and long distances. Both Phoenixes can also be taken into battle up to six missiles at once.

[b]Interesting: The F-14B Tomcat is sometimes called the “Bombcat” since it was the first fighter of the series, which could be equipped first with conventional, and then with other types of aircraft bombs.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2c143ec9a8d047169258eac3dda5e40a992ace7c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/18c69fe3f1494e50a41698c0e7cf9a5a773d4154.jpg[/img]

But that is not all! The F-14B can be equipped with a LANTIRN targeting pod, which turns the Tomcat into a true reaper of ground vehicles. Guided bombs of the Paveway II family, the GBU-12, GBU-16 and heavy GBU-10, with laser seekers are accurate and deadly weapons to destroy any tank on the battlefield. In addition to guided bombs, the aircraft can also be equipped with the good old Zuni rockets as well as conventional free-fall bombs in calibers up to 2,000 pounds. A nice addition will be the ability to use the already familiar Bol countermeasure pods with 160 charges each. Use the weapon configurator to setup your perfect set for each game mode! Well, and a small spoiler alert - the aircraft will also be equipped with a new to the game type of weapon, which we will present to you soon!

The ultimate US naval jet fighter is coming to the game together with the release of the next major update - it's coming soon, it's going to be exciting! Stay tuned to our Dev Diaries series to learn more!

notes.title: Victory Day in War Thunder
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0ed00fef6beaae3c344f6a8502927807f797ba77.png[/img]

Victory! Many allied countries spent years with trials and tribulations to end the bloodiest war in the history of humanity, and in early May of 1945 their efforts finally bore fruit. This victory is the most important event of the XXth century that is remembered and celebrated today by tens of millions of people. Join us in War Thunder to commemorate this event!

[h2][quote]From May 5th until May 10th (11:00 GMT) play War Thunder and receive rewards![/quote][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/01270c70ca29713c8c7135ab152bf8c0d13e0742.png[/img]

        [td][b]Maxim–Tokarev machine gun decoration for ground vehicles[/b][/td]
        [td][b]120-PM-38 naval decoration[/b][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Play 3 battles (with activity of no less than 70%).[/td]
        [td]Earn 20000 points in total while controlling vehicles of rank III and higher in tank battles.[/td]
       [td]Earn 10000 points in total while controlling vehicles of rank III and higher in naval battles.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

You can check your task progress by clicking on your nickname → Achievements → Victory Day.

In the in-game item shop you can find trophies that contain decorations of Allied weaponry or decals that you still don’t have. The decals represent three main Soviet military memorials: "[url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2022/05/events/vd/rear_front_decal_4ff98096c90499ddaf44be0c242598d0.png]Rear-front[/url]", "[url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2019/04%20April/motherland_decal_195df8e4ca0bacf4ac759b2c78c42f71.png]Motherland[/url]" and "[url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/05/warrior_liberator_decal_8fe22ca881af717552313ffc4be63009.png]Warrior Liberator[/url]". Decorations: [url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/05/bren_mk2_512_6564dcc1123fa9b79e968c272ff72ce6.png]Bren Mk II[/url], [url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/05/roks_flamethrowers_512_ec28d7557c0e8b785406e3a5a8a7ed76.png]ROKS-3[/url], [url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/05/m1_garand_512_582d810aa0c6486394313b573ac2dcb1.png]M1 Garand[/url], [url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2022/05/events/vd/sg43_512_79476ee15d2c5be74170ee3417e7cb0e.png]SG-43[/url], and[url=https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2022/05/events/vd/decor_tank_matilda_512_9c5433f64638c25b9b9a1e27c7ceec0b.png] Matilda II (for large vessels)[/url].

[h1]Discounts in shop[/h1]
From May 5th until May 12th in the Gaijin.Net store you’ll find discounts for many high rank vehicle packs, as well as rare thematic bundles commemorating Victory Day!

[h1]Legend of Victory: BM-31-12 “Andryusha”[/h1]

[h3][quote]From May 10th until May 22nd participate in the Legend of Victory event and earn decals, decorations, and the unique [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3683425195453001564]BM-31-12[/url], younger brother of the legendary Katyusha![/quote][/h3]

The BM-31-12 was designed to fire the heavy M-31 300mm unguided rockets. Guidance and launch are carried out with a welded framework of 12 rails mounted on the chassis of the Studebaker military truck. The machine was successfully tested in the spring of 1944 and was put into service in June under the designation BM-31-12. In the troops, by analogy with the Katyusha MLRS, the new vehicle was nicknamed Andryusha (“little Andrey” in Russian). It was widely used in the battles of the final stages of WWII in Europe, including the urban battles as a fire support for Soviet storming troops. In total, the Red Army received 1,807 BM-31-12 Andryusha vehicles until the end of the war.

notes.title: Legend of Victory: BM-31-12 “Andryusha”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/69e68b4cdb954081737acb75c5148ddda6383211.png[/img]

Meet the bane of the Wehrmacht — MLRS [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3683425195453001564]BM-31-12 “Andryusha”[/url]! This vehicle undertook its baptism by fire under Novgorod in Russia and helped push the front way back to Berlin — truly a Legend of Victory! You can receive it and many other prizes, including keys from the “Demolition crate” that contains items from past War Thunder events!

[h2][quote]From May 10th (11:00 GMT) until May 22nd (11:00 GMT) earn points in battles, unlock stages, and receive prizes![/quote][/h2]

[h2]BM-31-12, Rank III, USSR, Premium[/h2]
The BM-31-12 will surely please fans of rocket artillery with its powerful strikes that leave no chances of survival for light and medium vehicles. Its warheads carry almost 30 kg of explosives — six times the amount of the legendary BM-13 “Katyusha”! “Andryusha” joined the fight late — in the final year of the war — but it certainly contributed to the Great Victory!

[h3]How to earn prizes[/h3]
Each level unlocks for 35,000 mission points and earns you a new reward.

Score mission points in ground battles of rank III or above in Arcade, Realistic, or Simulator battles. See the score multiplier in the description of the mission, it depends on the gaming mode and maximum rank of the vehicles for the mission.

You may also score points using certain event vehicles of ranks I-II. Such vehicles have event names in their info cards.

[quote]Stages change every two days at 11:00 GMT: 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th, and 20th of May.[/quote]

Your rewards are based on the number of stages you’ve unlocked:
[list]
[*] For 1 stage: “T-54-412” decal
[*] For 2 stages: one of decals + Crowbar
[*] For 3 stages: one of decorations + Crowbar
[*] For 4 stages: one of decals + Crowbar
[*] For 5 stages: one of decorations + Crowbar
[*] For 6 stages: premium BM-31-12 “Andryusha”
[/list]

You can track your progress by clicking on your Nickname → Achievements → Legend of Victory. 

[b]If you don’t complete a stage in time, until May 25th you will be able to purchase the stages for Golden Eagles and receive the rewards.[/b]

[h2]Demolition crate[/h2]
A unique opportunity to receive items from previous War Thunder events, including rewards from Chronicles of World War II, three seasons of World War, Pages of History, War Thunder Birthdays, and last year’s Legend of Victory — over a hundred different prizes in total!

[quote]From May 10th (12:00 GMT) until June 5th (12:00 GMT) you can purchase a Demolition crate and a Crowbar to open the crate for Silver Lions in the in-game shop.[/quote]

Demolition crate contains unique decals, decorations, player icons, loading screens, vehicles, and camouflages. Some items from past events appear for the first time as coupons, and you can trade them on the Marketplace! There are also Silver Lions, boosters, universal backups, wagers, and orders. 

The price of a Demolition crate is 10 000 Silver Lions, the price of a Crowbar is 50 000 Silver Lions. You can also receive a Crowbar for unlocking 2, 3, 4, and 5 levels of the Legend of Victory event. On June 5th, 12:00 GMT all Demolition crates and Crowbars will disappear from your inventory, so be sure to use them before that time!

notes.title: Planned economy changes in May
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6b8a741778f9ca7b177112ca42cb1ae7742c3ed8.png[/img]

[h2]Continuing the transition to an economy based on vehicle ranks[/h2]
In [url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/545960-planned-economy-changes-in-february/]February last year[/url] we began the transition to a rank-based economy, which was chosen by the majority of players in a vote. We remind you that this transition requires several smoothed economy updates. With the release of the current economy update, the transition to the new system will be completed for most aircraft and ground vehicles of rank III and higher.

[h2]Maximum repair cost in the table sheet for economy changes[/h2]
Usually in the table sheet, economy changes indicate the minimum repair cost of vehicles without taking into account used modifications. This is the “default” repair cost of vehicles that will be shown in the vehicle card for example before research or purchase. However in the case of different number of modifications in the vehicle and accordingly different additions to the repair cost from modifications it is not quite correct to compare the minimum repair cost. For example, right now (before the economy changes), the repair cost of the T-80BVM in RB when all modifications are installed will be changed from 3690 to 7405 SL and for the Leopard 2A6 - from 5410 to 8050 SL. We see the estimated (maximum) repair cost of these vehicles differs by only 8.7% while the basic (minimum) - almost one and a half times. At the same time the change in the repair cost of vehicles must be of interest primarily to those players who own these vehicles; play them and have already researched a number of modifications or even all of them. And accordingly see and spend no longer the basic repair cost.

Beginning in this update we decided to use in the economy change tables, the maximum repair cost of the vehicle by taking into account all installed modifications.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vS-aZPPg1zlh8haYAi95yRimrfAUY859AcUTaBxmYLxBFM7uX1LTmSyRdLQe9yPLiuX6uSh1ALzu7-j/pubhtml]Open the table sheet of changes[/url]

However, in this update, for the last time a table with minimum repair cost will also be presented, so that everyone can make sure that the repair cost of all vehicles hasn’t been increased several times and these are two different parameters - the minimum (basic) repair cost and the maximum (estimated) repair cost.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTNya1Qn8xNb6518couhGx4eWp-7wfV-jHIhmgym4Xs4vKaPTWZNblvbmMYSKFfDncN6gPDbGlQuJcW/pubhtml]Open the table sheet of changes (with minimum repair cost)[/url]

[h2]Converting the repair time of vehicles in the hangar to the system of vehicle ranks[/h2]
Free vehicle repairs in the hangar allows you to save a certain amount of SL on vehicle repair. That’s why initially the time of free repair has been calculated from the repair cost of the vehicle. But for some vehicles in some game modes (aircraft in SB, fleet in AB and RB) the repair cost became very high due to the peculiarities of vehicles and modes (primarily because of the large average life span) which led to a very long time of free repair.

We decided to simplify this mechanics and fixed the free repair time depending on the economy rank of the vehicle (rank and position in the research tree) by analogy with such indicators as research cost, price, crew training price, RP multiplier and some others.

As a basis for calculating the new free repair time, the average repair time rates of ground vehicles were taken.

[h2]Changes of the cost of the expendable modification "Crew Replenishment"[/h2]
Repair costs are not the only expense in battle. Silver Lions will also be spent on ammo, suspended weaponry and the expendable modification "Crew Replenishment". All these expenses will be taken into account when calculating the repair cost and subtracted from the initially calculated value forming the final estimated repair cost. Moreover, the share of expenditures on consumables should be noticeably lower than the expenditures on repairs. However in the case of the “Crew Replenishment” modification this rule isn’t followed - the modification is too expensive for rank I vehicles but too cheap for rank V and higher and we will fix it in this economy update.

Now the cost of the "Crew Replenishment" will be linked not to vehicle rank but to the economy rank(rank and position in the research tree on the rank) which will allow to fine-tune the price of the modification for all vehicles. For reserve vehicles the price will drop from 100 to 10 SL, for other rank I vehicles it will drop from 100 to 40-70 SL, for rank VII vehicles it will increase from 700 to 1000-1100 SL. Once again, please note that an increase in the cost of an expendable modification does not mean an overall increase in costs, as it is taken into account when calculating the price of a vehicle repair.

[h2]Changes in the research and purchase cost of squadron vehicles[/h2]
There will be changes to the research and purchase costs for a number of squadron vehicles.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSFYdGP5Hd3uLKG0fkS27zN7rskdWFKzbL4UZpxr6vOyJEALSB1MyE0c4yqiebVEJaGESImDtN0tJTv/pubhtml]Open the table sheet with changes[/url]

[h2]Changes in the research tree[/h2]
M3A1 Stuart — taken out of the M3/M3A1 Stuart research group.
Pz.III J — taken out of the Pz.III F/J group.
Pz.IV C — moved to the position before  Pz.II C.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQSdlhn-48n4YDjlQH1bTIExSOf3-23xGvFLcNtDAyzhzAb9Zlo-tt2rfViG9bh-EW7r2QbeYRBrdgN/pubhtml]Open the table sheet with changes[/url]

notes.title: BF2C-1 Goshawk: new reserve aircraft of the USA
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/1a83842c0fe37eb8fe57a81465079575897d0547.jpg[/img]

[i]New reserve aircraft comes to the US tech tree in the upcoming War Thunder update. Meet first photos and details![/i]

[h2]BF2C-1, fighter, USA., rank I. Reserve aircraft.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Good turn rate
[*] 4x100 lb bombs
[*] Poor offensive armament
[/list]
The BF2C-1 carrier-based fighter project was proposed by Curtiss to equip the new American aircraft carriers, which began to enter service with the US Navy in the early 1930s. Curtiss modified its Curtiss F11C Goshawk fighter, equipping the aircraft with a retractable landing gear and reinforced metal wings. Despite the good speed performance, the aircraft became less maneuverable due to the heavier weight. Nevertheless, the naval command placed an order for a small batch of fighter-bomber modifications, designated BF2C-1 Goshawk. During trial service with the VB-5 squadron on the USS Ranger aircraft carrier, the fighter reveals serious issues with the landing gear, due to which it was soon decommissioned from service. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7e5c25947e5aa895372f1fcad46312749c853d9f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7b2c15e6fb7611c90ae5b6215428568c4b8cd1ab.jpg[/img]

Until recently, the US carrier-based aviation reserve aircraft was the P-26 Peashooter, an all-metal monoplane that was noticeably inferior to reserve biplanes of other nations in terms of maneuverability. With the release of the next major War Thunder update, the new reserve of the US tech tree will be the Curtiss BF2C-1 Goshawk biplane. Let's take a closer look at it, shall we?

The new BF2C-1 is one of the most advanced biplane generations in the history of warfare, combining the signature biplane maneuverability with a good speed performance, which can even be even higher than some early monoplanes. A special feature of the BF2C-1 is the ability to install four 100 lb bombs with a separate drop, which makes the new reserve a great choice for the low rank mixed battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b3c8a42c48159231d58d83ccdb0f626ad2e0d613.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/c3b7b0f5364958d402ca673b94d666be97851231.jpg[/img]

Like many other reserve biplanes, the BF2C-1 lacks firepower. A pair of rifle-caliber machine guns is usually not enough to instantly shoot down an enemy fighter with a short burst, while  heavier aircraft will most probably require several attacks. However, the huge ammunition load of machine guns and good cooling of the barrels make it possible to pray-and-spray, while sticking on the enemy's six o’clock.

You will be able to test the new American navy reserve aircraft in battle, or even start studying the excellent lineup of the US aviation with the new BF2C-1 in the upcoming major War Thunder update. More news in our Developers Diary series - stay tuned!

notes.title: BM-31-12: Katyusha’s Little Brother
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/4adaa0aa2049f65ad7578bf63c652d86eee0835e.jpg[/img]

[i]Soviet multiple-rocket launch system BM-31-12 will become the main prize of the upcoming Victory Day event in War Thunder.[/i]

[h2]BM-31-12, MLRS, USSR, rank III. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Deadly heavy rockets
[*] Lacks direct fire
[*] Light protection
[/list]
Unguided 300-mm M-30 rockets were used by the Red Army since 1942 as a field artillery, being fired from metal frames right in the transporting containers. Soon, an upgraded version of the rocket appeared under the designation M-31 with an improved engine and a significantly increased range. Engineers from the special design bureau of the Moscow Kompressor plant designed a combat vehicle on the chassis of the US-built Studebaker US6 three-axle truck with a framework of 12 welded rails to launch these powerful rockets. The machine was successfully tested in the spring of 1944 and was put into service in June under the designation BM-31-12. In the troops, by analogy with the Katyusha MLRS, the new vehicle was nicknamed Andryusha (“little Andrey” in Russian). Rocket launchers Andryusha were widely used in the battles of the final stages of WWII in Europe, including the urban battles as a fire support for Soviet storming troops. In total, the Red Army received 1,807 BM-31-12 Andryusha vehicles until the end of the war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a99c9c5eba4c294200f70f711273a8b3a43f8380.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/87d52fcad990bb2f09f202563034265304efd812.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to present to you the main prize of the upcoming special event, a collectable BM-31-12 Andryusha multiple launch rocket system, the younger brother of the legendary Katyusha.

The BM-31-12 was designed to fire the heavy M-31 300mm unguided rockets. Guidance and launch are carried out with a welded framework of 12 rails mounted on the chassis of the Studebaker military truck. Even with a full load of rockets, the vehicle moves very fast on paved roads and hard ground, which allows the commander to quickly change positions and reload. The crew of the BM-31-12 is only two people in the cabin, covered with very thin armor, so the BM-31-12 can’t survive any fire including machine-guns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/bbfc6a1adb789480d8e2fd90e1b1a82e9d59fc8d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/478eef0b2ff27ee2d0a540e12ad53a00d6d536f5.jpg[/img]

Like the Katyusha, the BM-31-12’s launcher is unable to fire directly, so commanders  have to be smart in finding the right position to hit close targets: place the vehicle on hillsides, in gullies and pits, it is also recommended to learn suspension control. Shooting from BM-31-12 is also difficult because of the spread of the rockets and limited ammunition load... but what a pleasure it is to hit targets! Light vehicles and even medium tanks can be destroyed by close hits, heavy tanks and self-propelled guns will require a direct hit to kill. In any case, you are advised to shoot multiple rockets, so the chances of hitting are much higher.

Master this challenging, but very interesting machine: come up with new tactics, invent custom sights, make tables of fire in different locations according to enemy congestion areas and camper sites. In a couple of days, we will publish the full list of prizes and tasks of the upcoming event, in which you can get the rocket Andryusha to your hangar! Follow the news!

tags.feature: We are pleased to present to you the main prize of the upcoming special event, a collectable BM-31-12 Andryusha multiple launch rocket system, the younger brother of the legendary Katyusha.

notes.title: It’s fixed! №74
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a7874503fbe318dd26bb021d86e4b87ce9ee7f35.jpg[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder in the website special section.

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/236390/discussions/3/3820784984083205242/][b][quote]Please feel free to leave your feedback on these changes in the dedicated "It’s fixed! №74" thread[/quote][/b][/url][/h3]

[h2]Get back![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f0da5317eb133e46840cd9e92a83f0fd4f7a7500.jpg[/img]
Numerous vehicles have a few reverse transmissions, and we’ve added automatic transmissions in War Thunder to make controlling them more comfortable. Turns out, it didn’t work exactly as intended and could get in the way of your hasty retreat from a dangerous position. When moving directly backwards, the Automatic Transmission worked correctly, but if you tried to turn your vehicle, it changed to the first reverse transmission gear! An issue with reverse movement also arose if the wheels of your vehicle were completely turned to one side. 

Now automatic transmission uses all the power of your vehicle — in several cases the speed of turning in reverse increased up to two times!


[h2]Weigh up![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5e4b3466b224cc539e6bc57144729c09192e65f5.jpg[/img]
Many players in mid ranks try to max out suspended weaponry of their aircraft. We found a way to make it more comfortable for them!

Now each weapon in the editor of the suspended weaponry will display its weight — as will the entire preset. You’ll be able to compare your current weight against the maximum — or check how much you’ve exceeded the limit if you did. Have fun experimenting with different sets of explosive cargo!


[h2]Fly high![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/38855fc0c6ccb9a865a39eddc51177c8359aefe2.jpg[/img]
We’ve noticed that the air-to-surface missile AGM-65 can’t reach its maximum range unless it’s launched from a very high altitude. The reason was simple: to reach that range, the missile has to loft, and it just couldn’t. Well, we taught it its signature move!

Now, AIM-54 actually could loft, but there was a catch: when pulling up, it could hit the aircraft it was launched from. We fixed that, and increased seeker warm-up angles and guidance equipment operational time. 

Autopilot of the L-UMTAS and Mokopa missiles weren’t functioning well enough on short and very long distances. It happened because they worked in relay mode, when the fins were constantly being switched from minimum to maximum, and the flight trajectory was determined by the time they spent in each position. Now the autopilot works in proportional mode, and that allows it to follow the set trajectory more precisely.

Lastly, we’ve almost doubled the maximum permissible overload of 9M331, the missile of the Torus. All listed missiles have received improvements to their dynamics and autopilot. Use them well!


[h1]That’s Not All[/h1]
You’ll find the full list of improvements in the separate changelog — there are many interesting things there. Weapon selector no longer prevents the camera from following the falling bombs or torpedoes, the position of the propeller of the aircraft now stays the same regardless of your point of view, and the parameters of dropping bombs now longer apply to other helicopter weaponry.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted using our [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder]special service[/url].

[h1]Update 2.25.1.83[/h1]

[h2]Ground vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]M60A2[/b] — A bug with the explosion of the smoke grenades at high altitude above the tank has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/t3Wfhd9gcfUC]report[/url]).
[*] [b]M18 GMC [/b]— A bug where AP shells might fly through the commander without causing damage has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/I6ITr9nbF3O0]report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused armoured vehicles with multiple reverse gears when using automatic transmission to reverse in first gear only has been fixed ([url=https://forum.warthunder.ru/index.php?/topic/322318-ispravit-povorot-zadom-u-tankov-nato/]report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused maximum reverse speed on wheeled vehicles to be unachievable if the wheels were turned to one side or another before moving has been fixed ([url=https://forum.warthunder.ru/index.php?/topic/302502-zt3a2-zadnii-khod/]report 1[/url], [url=https://forum.warthunder.ru/index.php?/topic/311935-ruikety-i-zadnii-khod/]report 2[/url]).
[*] [b]“Vietnam” and “Breslau” locations[/b] — Some physical materials that could significantly slow down the movement of wheeled vehicles has been corrected ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/Odi5Ux5A8sLk]report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]AGM-65A, AGM-65B, AGM-65D[/b] — The autopilot and rocket dynamics have been redesigned. The loft manoeuvre mode has been added to the autopilot.
[*] [b]F-84F[/b] — A bug where HVAR missiles under the fuselage were consumed incorrectly has been fixed.
[*] [b]Lightning F.53[/b] — A bug that made it possible to forcibly drop SNEB type 23 missile containers above the wings has been fixed.
[*] [b]Jaguar GR.1A[/b] — A bug that made it possible to forcibly drop AIM-9G missiles has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the parameters of dropping bombs in series to apply to other helicopter weaponry has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/NGoreIfuasBC]report[/url]).
[*] A bug that caused bomb/torpedo tracking not to work when the weapons selector was turned on after bombing has been fixed.
[*] A bug where when using the default settings for the “Takeoff-Landing '' training prompted the instructor to raise the mouse up when taking off, which caused a nose over, has been fixed.
[*] A bug when switching to premium piston aircraft in the hangar where the engine propeller might change the position has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused the position of the propeller blades to be different when viewed from the cockpit and from 3rd person view has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Display of the current and maximum allowed mass has been added to the suspended weaponry edit window. Also displaying the mass for each pod has been added to the drop-down suspended weaponry menu.
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ability to move the NVIDIA ANSEL camera by using WASD has been restored ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/2Fm0f6fc4Tum]report[/url]).
[*] VR — A bug that caused some objects like branches, trash and bricks in ground battles to be displayed only in the left eyepiece has been fixed. 
[/list]
[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

notes.title: Koi and Golden Week in Japan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a422dd65fc025a4c26b8062b2708461cff19ca47.jpg[/img]

In late April to early May Japan celebrates several holidays that form the Golden Week. April 29th, the birthday of Emperor Hirohito, is celebrated as Showa Day, May 3rd is the Constitution Day, May 4th is the Greenery Day, and May 5th is the Children’s Day. The latter is celebrated by Japanese families by putting out koinobori — windsocks in the shape of the koi carps that symbolize each member of the family. 

[h2][quote]From April 28th (13:00 GMT) until May 1st (11:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Pllay 3 battles using Japanese vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Koi” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f53d9b144accdaafb317b897ae239283791334f4.png[/img]
[b]“Koi”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Golden Week. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: “Her Majesty’s Hussar”: Warbonds
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8ffdb151f470069139fd92b47133151dbff59044.jpg[/img]

[h3][quote]The Warbond shop for the “Her Majesty’s Hussar” Battle Pass season will be open from 26th of April until 26th of July.[/quote][/h3]

Noble hussars, it’s time to learn what you can spend your Warbonds on that you will earn in the Battle Pass! As usual, we have decals, decorations, camouflages, a new stylish pinup, and six premium vehicles, three of which are available in the shop for the first time!

Pay special attention to the [b]M4A4 (1st PTG)[/b], the famous American Rank II tank flying the Chinese flag — it’s a versatile vehicle that can fight off almost any enemy tank.

[h3][quote]The Warbond shop is available to players that have vehicles of rank III and up and is part of the Battle Pass. You can purchase items with the special ‘Warbond’ currency that can be obtained by unlocking Battle Pass levels.[/quote][/h3]

Open “Shop” → “Warbond shop” to see an assortment where some of the more interesting items can be seen.

[h1]Premium vehicles in the new season:[/h1]

[h2]KM-5 — first time in the shop[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2ef86ac5394aaabd09f79721ce248255f8381b7e.jpg[/img]
A rank I German motor torpedo boat that was used in the Eastern front in World War II as a minelayer on lakes and rivers. Its fragility and lack of powerful armament are compensated by its high speed and low profile.

[h2]Hudson Mk V[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7aabc69d143fe6ca1ea326a9c7c89f30a2d4493e.jpg[/img]
A British Rank II bomber with an impressive suspended armament that’s capable of destroying an entire base and damaging another one. Featuring a double 7.7 mm Browning machine gun in its dorsal turret that can dismantle almost any enemy that approaches this aircraft!

[h2]SU-57[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/914d98b76a09089e07f273521e0d82c02d88a949.jpg[/img]
An American self-propelled tank destroyer T48 serving in the Soviet army. Thanks to its minimal armor, it’s quite agile and can easily move to a different place after each attack, while its 57 mm M1 cannon can easily penetrate armor of enemies on Ranks I-II.

[h2]Thunderbolt (PT-556)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7f8ea31a580da9f40d31222d7e66dd23b9819152.jpg[/img]
This rank III American motor torpedo boat has amazing speed: up to 106 km/h in Arcade battles! Onboard are four torpedoes, five 20 mm autocannons protecting its aft and front, two 12.7 mm machine guns and a frontal 37 mm gun that can be loaded with AP shells.

[h2]VL Pyörremyrsky — first time in the shop[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b6e42a94208d3bde799095c44e306de223621f2f.jpg[/img]
You’ll find this Finnish “Hurricane” in Rank III of the Swedish aviation tree. This fighter, which was created to replace the Bf 109, has very good climb rate and maneuverability, and also boasts a powerful front 20 mm cannon and a couple of 12.7 mm machine guns. To deal with ground targets, it can carry four 50 kg or 100 kg bombs.

[h2]M4A4 (1st PTG) — first time in the shop[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/8ffdb151f470069139fd92b47133151dbff59044.jpg[/img]
An American medium tank that arrived in China via Lend-Lease. Decent speed allows it to rush to tactically advantageous positions, while its 75 mm cannon with a vertical stabilizer rotates quite quickly. It can also frontally penetrate and even one-shot many opponents.

[h2]Other Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Taurus Zodiac" pinup
[*] decals
[*] player icon
[*] decorations
[/list]

[h2]"Taurus Zodiac" pinup[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3059f1d2302eef2b8d95f17f851f8285d5c741ec.png[/img]

Decals are represented in the trophy, alongside decals from the 2021 Warbonds shop, as well as a new “Taurus Zodiac” pinup which continues the series of themed decals. The camouflage decoration trophy will provide you with floral decorations that will help you make your vehicle less noticeable. The player icons in the corresponding trophy this time features USSR tankers. Trophies with random camouflages, as before, become available as new store levels are opened.

A large number of usable items are also available in the store: boosters, universal backups, wagers and orders, test drives of premium vehicles — even talismans on the highest levels of the shop. 

Check out the full assortment of available Warbond items for the current Battle Pass season and the terms for purchasing them in the game by opening the Battle Pass window or “Shop -> Warbond Shop”!

notes.title: Update 2.25.1.78
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/0a3510f37851e17b95015e9c2f282c18c555c1cc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ground vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]T25[/b] — The thickness (4 - >10 mm) and the material (structural steel -> rolled armour) of the grilles on the top of the engine-transmission compartment have been fixed. Previously, these grilles could be penetrated by machine gun fire from other ground vehicles.
[*] [b]Ariete (all modifications)[/b] — The material (structural steel - > combined armour plate) and thickness (4 - > 20 mm) of the side skirts have been fixed.
[*] [b]9М331[/b] — The missile's maximum permissible overload has been clarified. Permissible overload has been changed from 16 to 42G.
[*] [b]9М331[/b] — The missile dynamics has been reworked. The work of autopilots for guidance and orientation of the rocket has been clarified.
[*] [b]ZLT11[/b] — A bug where the absence of hatch main armour on the right side of the hull has been fixed (report).
[*] [b]QN506[/b] — A bug which made it impossible to use the commander’s sight except for the cannon’s direction has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/cwYFZK00ocXw]report 1[/url], [url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/FDfjVx0HWFPj]report 2[/url]).
[*] [b]QN506[/b] — Ammo of the 7.62 machine gun has been changed from 2000 to 1000 rounds.
[*] [b]QN506[/b] — A bug causing part of the hull roof armour to combine at the same time as the air intake grill has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/iihrXR1a91HV]report[/url]).
[*] [b]QN506[/b] — Partition between the unmanned combat compartment and control compartment has been added.
[*] [b]QN506[/b] — In the damage mode and X-Ray view, the ammo for the 30 mm cannon has been divided into two belts.
[*] [b]M6A1, T1E1[/b] — A bug which made it possible to fire the offensive machine guns after the loss of the gunner has been fixed.
[*] [b]M4A5[/b] — A bug with the inconsistent location of transmission geometry in the damage model and X-ray view has been fixed.
[*] [b]M163[/b] — A bug with absence in the DM of the breech part of the cannon has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/NSCqmPpkNOnK]report[/url]).
[*] [b]2S38[/b] — A bug with discrepancy of the location of the cannon’s breech geometry in DM and X-Ray view has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/rQQjZ72DerbR]report[/url]).
[*] [b]ZSU-23-4, ZSU-37-2[/b] — The mode of the circular scanning has been changed from “Circular” to “Accelerated circular” mode. Angular scanning speed has been changed from 20 to 60 degrees per second. Source: “Пособие по изучению правил стрельбы батареи, взвода, установки ЗСУ-23-4. 1969”
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]F-84G (Italy)[/b] — air respawn has been fixed.
[*] [b]PB4Y (all versions)[/b] — air respawn has been fixed.
[*] [b]Milan[/b] — a bug has been fixed where the fuel tank was overlapping the cannon magazines. 
[*] [b]F-5E (all versions)[/b] — a bug where the radar in the cockpit was shifted to the side has been fixed.
[*] [b]Kurnass 2000[/b] — a bug where the radar in the cockpit was shifted to the side; the radar colour scheme has been adjusted has been fixed.
[*] [b]A-7K[/b] — a bug where a data popup of the LANA targeting pod was similar to the A-7E pod has been fixed.
[*] [b]P.108A series 2[/b] — a bug where the modification “New 102mm cannons” increased a shell spread on distances over 500 metres has been fixed.
[*] [b]Ju 388 J[/b] — a bug where the windshield glass was specified as “armour” in the armour view tab in the hangar has been fixed.
[*] [b]A-4 (all versions)[/b] — jet boosters have been added to all A-4 aircraft, similar to A-4B versions. A bug with the infinite repair on the airfield has been fixed.
[*] [b]Yak-141[/b] — stealth belt has been added to the GSh-30-1 cannon.
[*] [b]MiG-29[/b] — a bug where the MFD remained idle after disabling the HUD has been fixed.
[*] A bug where the contrail was not displayed in the local replay has been fixed.
[*] A bug where while test flying the Soviet piston-engined aircraft, as well as French and British hydroplanes, the gunner’s sight was blinking in the allowed fire angles, which made it impossible to disable AI gunners, has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Aircraft missiles[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]9М39[/b] — altitude control engine and autopilot has been added.
[*] [b]L-UMTAS[/b] — autopilot has been improved. Significantly improved autopilot at short-range. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/qjkzxEMiiaN9]report[/url])
[*] [b]ZT-6 Mokopa[/b] —  the rocket dynamics and autopilot have been reworked. Significantly improved autopilot at short-range.
[*] [b]CIRIT[/b] — autopilot has been improved.
[*] [b]APKWS II (M151)[/b] — autopilot has been improved.
[*] [b]APKWS II (M282)[/b] — autopilot has been improved.
[*] [b]R-27Т, R-27R, R-27ER[/b] — control guidance delay upon launching has been reduced from 0.5  to 0.4 sec ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bsDpkr4DmEI5]report[/url]).
[*] [b]AIM-54A[/b] — the rocket dynamics and autopilot have been reworked. Max overload has been increased from 16G to 17G. Sources: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System”, “Grumman F-14 Tomcat by David Baker”, “Iranian F-14 Tomcat Units in Combat by Tom Cooper, Farzad Bishop (Author) & Chris Davey (Illustrator) form Osprey Publishing”
[*] [b]AIM-54A[/b] — a bug where the missile could destroy the carrier aircraft while pulling up has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/TKyr0Sc6y8qA]report[/url]).
[*] [b]AIM-54A[/b] — the seeker warm-up angles have been increased from 45 to 60 degrees. Source: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System” 
[*] [b]AIM-54A[/b] — guidance equipment operational time has been increased from 100 to 160 sec. Source: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System”
[*] [b]AIM-54A[/b] — the climbing up angle has been increased. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/LbZHpxi5blgm]report[/url]).
[/list]
[h2]Naval[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Z-47[/b] — The possibility of simultaneous firing of the 128 mm and 37 mm guns has been disabled.
[*] [b]Blagorodnyy[/b] — A bug where the first order ammo racks for the main calibre turrets weren’t displayed if the auxiliary armament wasn’t selected has been fixed.
[*] [b]Duguay-Trouin[/b] — The elevation angles of the 75mm anti-aircraft gun have been changed from 60 to 85 degrees.
[/list]
[h2]Game mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Respawn cost of the Pantsir-S1 in Ground RB has been increased to the SPG level: 90-130 RP instead of 70-110.
[*] Weapon RP costs for ATGM-carrying helicopters in Ground RB has been changed:
[list]
[*] Increased by 9% for ATGMs with proximity fuzes;
[*] Decreased by 10% for ATGMs with guiding distance of 2 km and below;
[*] Increased by 9% for ATGMs with guiding distance of 6 km and above.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused the vehicle in the research window not to update when replacing this vehicle in the setup has been fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] An FPS drop while sending long messages in the in-game chat has been fixed.
[*] Incorrect display of the aircraft gunner’s hands have been corrected.
[/list]
[i]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/i]

[b]M4A5[/b] — A bug with the inconsistent location of transmission geometry in the damage model and X-ray view has been fixed.
[b]M163[/b] — A bug with absence in the DM of the breech part of the cannon has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/NSCqmPpkNOnK]report[/url]).

[b]2S38[/b] — A bug with discrepancy of the location of the cannon’s breech geometry in DM and X-Ray view has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/rQQjZ72DerbR]report[/url]).

tags.balance_change: [b]ZSU-23-4, ZSU-37-2[/b] — The mode of the circular scanning has been changed from “Circular” to “Accelerated circular” mode. Angular scanning speed has been changed from 20 to 60 degrees per second. Source: “Пособие по изучению правил стрельбы батареи, взвода, установки ЗСУ-23-4. 1969”

tags.bug: [b]F-84G (Italy)[/b] — air respawn has been fixed.
[b]PB4Y (all versions)[/b] — air respawn has been fixed.
[b]Milan[/b] — a bug has been fixed where the fuel tank was overlapping the cannon magazines.
[b]F-5E (all versions)[/b] — a bug where the radar in the cockpit was shifted to the side has been fixed.
[b]Kurnass 2000[/b] — a bug where the radar in the cockpit was shifted to the side; the radar colour scheme has been adjusted has been fixed.
[b]A-7K[/b] — a bug where a data popup of the LANA targeting pod was similar to the A-7E pod has been fixed.
[b]P.108A series 2[/b] — a bug where the modification “New 102mm cannons” increased a shell spread on distances over 500 metres has been fixed.
[b]Ju 388 J[/b] — a bug where the windshield glass was specified as “armour” in the armour view tab in the hangar has been fixed.

tags.feature: [b]A-4 (all versions)[/b] — jet boosters have been added to all A-4 aircraft, similar to A-4B versions. A bug with the infinite repair on the airfield has been fixed.
[b]Yak-141[/b] — stealth belt has been added to the GSh-30-1 cannon.

tags.bug: [b]MiG-29[/b] — a bug where the MFD remained idle after disabling the HUD has been fixed.
A bug where the contrail was not displayed in the local replay has been fixed.

A bug where while test flying the Soviet piston-engined aircraft, as well as French and British hydroplanes, the gunner’s sight was blinking in the allowed fire angles, which made it impossible to disable AI gunners, has been fixed.

tags.feature: [b]9М39[/b] — altitude control engine and autopilot has been added.
[b]L-UMTAS[/b] — autopilot has been improved. Significantly improved autopilot at short-range. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/qjkzxEMiiaN9]report[/url])
[b]ZT-6 Mokopa[/b] — the rocket dynamics and autopilot have been reworked. Significantly improved autopilot at short-range.
[b]CIRIT[/b] — autopilot has been improved.
[b]APKWS II (M151)[/b] — autopilot has been improved.
[b]APKWS II (M282)[/b] — autopilot has been improved.

tags.balance_change: [b]R-27Т, R-27R, R-27ER[/b] — control guidance delay upon launching has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.4 sec ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/bsDpkr4DmEI5]report[/url]).

[b]AIM-54A[/b] — the rocket dynamics and autopilot have been reworked. Max overload has been increased from 16G to 17G. Sources: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System”, “Grumman F-14 Tomcat by David Baker”, “Iranian F-14 Tomcat Units in Combat by Tom Cooper, Farzad Bishop (Author) & Chris Davey (Illustrator) form Osprey Publishing”

tags.bug: [b]AIM-54A[/b] — a bug where the missile could destroy the carrier aircraft while pulling up has been fixed ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/TKyr0Sc6y8qA]report[/url]).

tags.balance_change: [b]AIM-54A[/b] — the seeker warm-up angles have been increased from 45 to 60 degrees. Source: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System”
[b]AIM-54A[/b] — guidance equipment operational time has been increased from 100 to 160 sec. Source: “An Outsider’s View Of The Phoenix/AWG-9 Weapon System”
[b]AIM-54A[/b] — the climbing up angle has been increased. ([url=https://community.gaijin.net/issues/p/warthunder/i/LbZHpxi5blgm]report[/url]).
[b]Z-47[/b] — The possibility of simultaneous firing of the 128 mm and 37 mm guns has been disabled.

tags.bug: [b]Blagorodnyy[/b] — A bug where the first order ammo racks for the main calibre turrets weren’t displayed if the auxiliary armament wasn’t selected has been fixed.

tags.balance_change: [b]Duguay-Trouin[/b] — The elevation angles of the 75mm anti-aircraft gun have been changed from 60 to 85 degrees.
Respawn cost of the Pantsir-S1 in Ground RB has been increased to the SPG level: 90-130 RP instead of 70-110.

tags.bug: A bug that caused the vehicle in the research window not to update when replacing this vehicle in the setup has been fixed.
An FPS drop while sending long messages in the in-game chat has been fixed.
Incorrect display of the aircraft gunner’s hands have been corrected.

notes.title: Israel Independence Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/717f32ef9c5b04d4c88d683a402d850e1d53584d.jpg[/img]

On May 14th 1948, Israel declared its independence — and then managed to defend it thanks to its armed forces. This holiday is celebrated on 5 Iyar in the Hebrew calendar, which in 2023 corresponds to April 25-26, from sunset till sunset. On this day, people decorate their houses and cars with Israeli flags and have picnics, the government gives out awards for contributions to Israeli culture, and some military bases open up to visitors. 

[h2][quote]From April 25th (12:00 GMT) until April 28th (7:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using Israeli vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Golden menorah” decal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/80385e5d328f4b886d254cf23deb44dc1d80f64b.png[/img]
[b]“Golden menorah”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Israel Independence Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

tags.feature: Play 3 battles using Israeli vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “Golden menorah” decal.

notes.title: Italy Liberation Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/eb06e3070f9ea75597139eea08f2652f3a1c09d9.png[/img]

By the end of April of 1945, Italy-based forces of the Wehrmacht and Republic of Salo had no supplies or manpower to oppose the Allies, and so on the 29th they capitulated at Caserta. However, it was the 25th of April that became Liberation Day — on this date the National Liberation Committee of Upper Italy called for all guerrillas to rise against the occupying forces and force their garrisons to surrender. 

25th of April became a holiday already a year later, in 1946, and ever since, it’s celebrated by marches, parades, and placing laurels upon the grave of the Unknown Soldier. 

[h2][quote]From April 25th (10:00 GMT) until April 28th (10:00 GMT)[/quote][/h2]

[h3]Play 3 battles using Italian vehicles (rank III or higher, with an activity of not less than 70%) to receive the “W L'Italia﻿ libera” decal.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a321a0805926ed9385251775e5e10efd50b515e2.png[/img]
[b]“W L'Italia﻿ libera”[/b] decal

Complete the task in random battles, except for Enduring Confrontation missions and [Assault] mode. Track your progress in the hangar by clicking Nickname → Achievements → Holidays → Italy Liberation Day. 

You can find the decal in the “Holidays” tab in the Customisation menu.

notes.title: Meet Her Majesty's Hussar, the 11th season of Battle Pass
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/d5361de2e472e37c1915c775a6b94b0b7e8ba06a.png[/img]

For hundreds of years, hussars were part of the cavalry, but technical progress in the 20th century forced them to ditch horses for tanks — which means they have a place in War Thunder! The eleventh Battle Pass season that will launch very soon is called "Her Majesty's Hussar" for a reason: its main prize, the Centurion (in its later modification), was used by hussar squadrons in the Korean War when Queen Elizabeth II was crowned.

To receive Battle Pass rewards, you need to regularly log into the game and complete tasks and challenges. Each level of Battle Pass will earn you a prize, be it a player icon, a loading screen, a title, decals, decorations, or new premium vehicles!

[h2][b][quote]April 26th — July 26th: Battle Pass season 11[/quote][/b][/h2]

[h1]Season awards[/h1]

Every season there’s a new set of awards. See the full list in the Battle Pass tab in the hangar, or check out our [url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Battle_Pass_Seasons]wiki[/url]. Here are the key awards for season 11:

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/5978007465998329668]S-701[/url][/h2]
[b]Germany, rank III, Premium[/b]

The latest modification of the legendary E-boat series wielding two additional torpedo tubes to shoot backwards while retreating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b13a27144088ab43760e9f4331c30206c0032dda.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3687927619408766018]J26 David[/url][/h2]
[b]Sweden, rank III, Premium[/b]

American P-51 Mustang in service with the Swedish air force got its own name David. This flawless mid-altitude fighter is also able to carry bombs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5d6a7fa22dfeab5855a677661f42f26815c24b62.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/236390/announcements/detail/3687927619412359504]Centurion Mk.2[/url][/h2]
[b]British, rank IV, Premium[/b]

British Centurion with a cast turret was designed to counter the latest Soviet tanks. The tank comes with a unique camo of the 8th King's Royal Irish Hussars regiment in the Korean War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a7257346519a3da1e0cbea1ec256abfd20c6b365.jpg[/img]


[h2]Decals[/h2]

4 decals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/098ede6eab93258a74df75932c598749c9bbb83b.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]Emblem of the 1st Hussars[/b][/td]
        [td][b]"April Son" text[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/cfe2780d9b5082ef7e1d2c35c74c8e12377a9824.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]"Humorist" text[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Emblem of the King’s Royal Hussars[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]


[h2]3D decorations[/h2]

3 decorations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a510d447594baf6b9fdedc4fd1651886c92553aa.png[/img]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][b]Horseman statue (ship)[/b][/td]
        [td][b]Shako (tank)[/b][/td]  
        [td][b]Lewis gun (tank)[/b][/td]  
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Profile Icon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/36346a9115c98d40865d7e3b6b85e1788de92532.png[/img]
[b]Hussar squadron officer[/b]

[url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Battle_Pass:_Season_XI,_"Her_Majesty%27s_Hussar"]All rewards and challenges for season 11[/url]


[h3]About the Battle Pass[/h3]

[h3][quote]Please note that the Battle Pass is completely free to claim if you obtain two Coupon Upgrades from stages in the previous season. They can be exchanged from the purchase menu for the “Field Testing” season Battle Pass![/quote][/h3]

[b]Battle Pass[/b] is a seasonal event during which you will earn progress points and use them to open new levels. Each opened level brings you a valuable reward, from Silver Lions and boosters to exclusive season prizes: decorations, profile icons and premium vehicles.

Open new stages and get awards at any time during the season.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/318c275070116f5d9abc04bd89c196c075a79e2d.jpg[/img]
You can access the “Battle Pass” window through the promo block on the right side of the hangar screen.

[h3]How to participate[/h3]
[b]Play[/b]
[list]
[*] You get progress points every day for entering the game.
[*] From 1 to 5 points.
[/list]
[b]Complete Battle Tasks[/b]
[list]
[*] See Battle Task descriptions in the game and get progress points for completing them.
[*] From 2 to 5 points.
[/list]
[b]Complete Season Challenges[/b]
[list]
[*] Season Challenges are very similar to Battle Tasks.  One Challenge is available at the season’s start. Every week you get another one or two challenges, three more can be unlocked by opening stages.
[*] 30 points.
[/list]
[b][url=https://wiki.warthunder.com/Battle_Pass_Seasons]Learn more about the Battle Pass[/url][/b]

notes.title: Rankings Challenge: Season 1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ofltXFFCo8w;full][/previewyoutube]

The first season of Rankings Challenge begins! In its debut you’ll earn unique camouflages and titles, and the best of the best will enter the finals with a prize pool of over $3000! Can you play War Thunder well? Then the prize can be yours!

[quote][h2]From April 24th until May 22nd fight in daily competitions “Wings of Prey” (1v1 aviation), “Shoulder to Shoulder” (2v2 ground vehicles) and “Fire Front” (5v5 mixed battles) and earn prizes in each of them![/h2][/quote]

[h2]Enter Rankings Challenge[/h2]
You don’t have to search for long — just press Battles → Rankings Challenge in the War Thunder client. The competitions are divided between air, ground, and mixed battles, and do not overlap in the schedule.

[quote]In Rankings Challenge, each participant receives a preset collection of upgraded vehicles and an experienced crew that allows the players to prove who’s stronger on an equal footing. Decals and decorations are disabled during Rankings Challenge battles. Parity is also enforced by the same limit of battles per day for each player, a realistic battle mode with markers, and small difference margin of battle rating of your competitors that you’ll be able to meet in the battles.[/quote]

Assemble your team, stay up-to-date and take part in discussions by joining the [url=https://discord.gg/Ma62Kr5YWd]official eSport War Thunder discord server[/url]! There you will find the section dedicated to ranked battles!

[list]
[*] [url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7853-development-rankings-challenge-en]About Rankings Challenges[/url]
[*] [url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/8206-esport-rankings-challenge-season-1-en]Season schedule[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
In the first season you can earn 14 sports camouflages, unique titles, “Cybersport’ trophy coupon, and a place in the finals that we’ll talk about in a separate news piece after Season 1 of Rankings Challenge is over.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/02d86a1ea618b4605b45a65054c79cf805d8dfe8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/21fad0e9768d25a184a5e30c4c2d8d0523285899.png[/img][/url]

So, the Krasnovian tank is an American Abrams M1 main battle tank with visual modifiers, such as a camo net on the gun barrel, an imitation of an IR searchlight, an imitation of a dozer blade in front of the hull, two barrels welded to the rear, an imitation of the ERA blocks on the hull and turret, dismantled side skirts, as well as confusing inscription "ЛОДКА" (‘boat’ in Russian) on the tower baskets.

Under the guise of a Soviet tank is the excellent M1 Abrams MBT, one of the best tanks in its rank. Great front protection of the turret, good front protection of the hull, high mobility, a thermal imaging device in the gunner’s sight, as well as an excellent stabilized gun with all popular types of rounds, including two variants of APFSDS. The KVT version also has a Premium status, which means it can greatly boost the research of any tank and armored vehicle in the US research tree from ranks I to VII! It is worth noting also that unchecking the modification box in the menu removes visual modifiers, returning the familiar look of the menacing Abrams M1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/a9350fb0e13b6a735674137100e67f720d630c3f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/077ef9dfd021fa05bef3e02db36e3593ec9ce1b7.jpg[/img]

The tank itself will be added to the game in the next major update. However, for connoisseurs of war machines our team has prepared a special pre-order pack, containing the M1 Abrams KVT tank, Golden Eagles, Premium account days, the unique title “Red Scare” and a special decal “Krasnovian Tank Division” - a great addition to the exotic look of the Krasnovian invader. Hurry up, comrade Krasnovian, the offer is limited until the release of the next major War Thunder update!

notes.title: Battle Pass vehicles: Centurion Mk 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f294b54816b23ca51569c30cff96b516ff7f04ae.gif[/img]

[i]The main tank prize of the new season is the British Centurion Mk 2 with a cast turret and gun stabiliser. Meet Her Majesty Hussar![/i]

[h2]Centurion Mk 2, medium tank, Britain, rank IV. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Very good frontal protection
[*] Gun stabiliser
[*] Low speed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/73bdd8a1f50b174f6df87850ce8e070551263b91.jpg[/img]

So, in War Thunder the Centurion Mk 2 is a transitional version from the first production vehicles to the Mk 3 version. From the Centurion Mk 1 we get the QF 17-pounder gun, a strong hull front with an upper glacis at a rational angle, and from the Mk 3 version we get a cast turret, gun stabiliser and improved armour of the gun mantlet.

The strong point of the Centurion Mk 2 is definitely its frontal protection. Indeed, the angled upper frontal plate of the hull, the cast turret, as well as the reinforced armour of the gun mantlet, allows the tank to survive enemy fire and be able to fire back. The chance of ricocheting is much higher when a commander turns the hull from the enemy and uses uneven terrain to increase hull angle of impact. The Centurion Mk 2 is armed with a 17-pounder familiar to British commanders, but in this version of the tank, the gun received a stabiliser that allows it to fire on the move at low speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f46f34ce6e9acaf531938f2bd7f7c154670a0393.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/7691e3a7b320919b3463bb9f26356f0a81d3cc4b.jpg[/img]

For a medium tank, the Centurion has a low maximum speed - only 37 km/h (41 km/h in arcade), although the tank reaches its maximum speed quite fast even on unpaved terrains, and maintains good dynamics and manoeuvrability. Another problematic point of the tank is the thin armour on the sides of the hull that can be penetrated, in general, by any tank guns and many autocannons. Commanders are advised to study the ammo replenishing order and clear a few internal niches from shells - this really increases the chances of survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/bf475eb998c1168254afc3d8bb324a17a7881008.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/e05025b6a5059f70f0ce3f3feb245304caf7c129.jpg[/img]

For the premium Centurion Mk 2, you can get a special camouflage inspired by the colour scheme of the 8th Royal Irish Hussars regiment from the period of participation in the Korean War, with American white stars on the sides so as not to get under friendly fire. In this camouflage the tank is damn good! We will tell you how to get the Centurion Mk 2 and the hussar camouflage in the upcoming announcement of the full list of rules for the new season of the War Thunder Battle Pass “Her Majesty's Hussar” - stay tuned for the news!

notes.title: Battle Pass vehicles: J26 David
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b9abf62b7682c415880683c1843f158f1725105f.gif[/img]

[i]J26 David is an interned and purchased American P-51B-7 Mustang fighter aircraft in service with the Swedish air forces. Meet the main aviation prize available for every War Thunder player![/i]

[h2]J26 David, fighter, Sweden, rank III. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Good performance at low and mid altitudes
[*] High G-tolerance
[*] Mediocre forward weapons
[*] Bombs
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/5d6a7fa22dfeab5855a677661f42f26815c24b62.jpg[/img]

The Swedish Premium Mustang J26 with own name “David” will be the main aviation prize of the new season of the War Thunder Battle Pass “Her Majesty's Hussar”, and all players who complete the required number of stages and progress points will be able to receive the fighter for free.

The P-51B-7 modification was one of the first to receive British Merlin engines, licensed as Packard V-1650. Thanks to the new engine, the Mustang performs great at low and medium altitudes, where it can slowly speed up to about 700 km/h. The aircraft retains energy well in level flight, and thanks to its strong fuselage, it can survive over 800 km/h in the dive. There are few aircraft on its rank which performs better in vertical or horizontal maneuvers, but still the P-51 is slightly inferior to them, while maintaining a stable high max speed at altitude and good rate of climb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/340de26c9819f6b6b553416210a92a7fdb97b3bd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/6cf542ff0257ba27c635244b02c90c6699a60115.jpg[/img]

The only con side of the Swedish Mustang might be its mediocre forward armament. Four wing-mount M2 machine guns, designated according to the Swedish classification as Akan m/45, are not bad, but surely not as good as cannons. But for mixed battles, the J26 (B-7) can be equipped with bombs - a pair of 100, 250 or 500-pounders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/ec8f33ed91b7564f62ca80ae501ff69e247bd3c2.jpg[/img]

The J26 David fighter will be available to all players in the new Battle Pass season - stay tuned for the news to find out more about the new prizes and rules of the season!

notes.title: Battle Pass vehicles: S-701
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3178fe870d217b28e18be8b92720ca493833ed38.gif[/img]

[i]Iconic German E-boats of the 701-st series had an additional pair of torpedo tubes to shoot sternwards![/i]

[h2]S-701, torpedo boat, Germany, rank III. Premium.[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Rear torpedo tubes
[*] Punchy guns
[*] Good mobility
[*] Lacks mines
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/b13a27144088ab43760e9f4331c30206c0032dda.jpg[/img]

The German S-701 torpedo boat will be one of the main naval prizes in the upcoming season of the War Thunder Battle Pass, which is called “Her Majesty's Hussar”. This is, perhaps, the most advanced version of the famous E-boats, the main difference being a pair of additional torpedo tubes with a unique game mechanic of shooting to the rear. In addition, the S-701 retains all the branded features of her family, such as excellent mobility and powerful weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/f481bf2218f8429ece676f71e78849f15bc6ddd0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/3ee36458e90b10b8a632f97eaeb0473e5596f056.jpg[/img]

The E-boat is a true symbol of the mosquito fleet and one of the most efficient torpedo boat designs in history. It is a fast, low profile boat with excellent seaworthiness and powerful torpedoes, perfect for the most daring missions, including night operations and rough seas. Boats of the S-701 series are the latest modification of torpedo boats of this family. Built with the combat experience of World War II, the S-701s offer their captains the optimal set of weapons while maintaining excellent dynamics. An additional pair of torpedo tubes for 533mm torpedoes which are turned backwards was placed on a stern, while her guns are capable of destroying smaller vessels, enemy boats, as well as enemy aircraft. The main weapon caliber of the S-701 is a stern mount with a 37mm autocannon. A 30mm MK-103 aircraft gun with deadly HEI-T rounds, but relatively small magazines, is installed on the boat's bow. Behind the wheelhouse, a pair of rapid-fire 20mm guns are installed, good for shooting down low-flying aircraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2582851c9de5ca38d015a5b43fb4c7a0333a83ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/9f6c6b4c98e254c9a71e71d51f4f4554aaa9b8d7.jpg[/img]

A decent speed of over 70 km/h and excellent maneuverability for its dimensions are best suited for providing shadow strikes with a pair of sternward torpedo tubes while retreating from your enemy under the cover of a smoke screen. 

The premium S-701 will be a “paid” prize for the new season of the Battle Pass, i.e., to receive it, you need to purchase the Battle Pass and complete a certain number of daily tasks. This is a good addition to an early German bluewater setup for capturing points and torpedo ambushes, and a great pick for mid-rank coastal fleet dogfights. Follow the news and learn more about the prizes and rules of the new season! See ya!
