notes.title: It’s fixed! №25 + Update 2.9.0.83
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/tank17_TW_e71ed072e77d8b04cd523478ae53a8aa.png[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder on the website [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]special section[/url].

[h1]Updated respawn point marker[/h1]

This improvement is based on a wish you left under one of previous digests. Even something as small as choosing a respawn point can be made better. So we have done it. 

Aircraft, ground and naval point markers are now much more distinct against any background and the point selected from those available is clearly distinguishable from neighbouring points. It just got so much better.

[h1]Continuing to add to weaponry cards[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/10%20October/Fixed25/ATGM2_(Maly)_b5eead3441fff63f36118d41bb7b7b8f.jpg[/img]

Know everything about your weaponry! We have already expanded the set of available data in the ammunition and missile cards several times. Now you even have a visual animation of how different ammo works, but it can be even better!

This time we have added such characteristics as time of guided flight interference immunity in the optical channel of ATGM and guaranteed launch range of an ATGM ((the range achievable by an ATGM under any acceptable atmospheric conditions) to the rocket's card. Also for the ATGMs mounted to ground vehicles we have added the display of information on the presence of a laser-beam control channel. Not unnecessary data for your battle effectiveness.

[h1]Fixing the sight in duplicate mode[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/10%20October/Fixed25/Commander2_(Maly)_d63a1314e783b0ab198632fe9bd8dffe.jpg[/img]

If you have high rank ground vehicles, you are definitely familiar with the capabilities of the commander sights and the benefits their fire control system provides. Amongst them is the duplicate control mode that allows you to fire using commander’s sight. 

Unfortunately due to a mistake when switching to the commander's sight and activating the dual control, the sight crosshair may have shifted to the right in some cases. We have fixed this bug as quickly as possible and now everything works like clockwork. Enjoy the bonuses on modern vehicles.

[h1]Vehicle service: Stage 2[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/10%20October/Fixed25/T722_(Maly)_670008d9445ec8ad2cf5209ceab68cbe.jpg[/img]

We continue to work on the maintenance of the many different vehicles in the game. This time we returned the missing pressure damage for TAM 2IP, clarified the description of the combined armour on the T-64B and all modifications of the T-72 and also fixed many visual bugs and errors in the installation of the modifications of aircraft and ground vehicles. We will not list them all but just invite you to visit the full list of changes - you should look there at all times.

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.9.0.83[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Aircraft/Aircraft%203%20Germany%20Red_e5d27747e18191f68137bac47dd43d58.jpg[/img][list]
[*] The crosshair shift  when switching to the commander’s camera has been fixed.
[*] Incorrect display of smoke and fire on specific graphic presets has been fixed.
[*] The playback of the video in the tutorial mission will no longer cause an FPS drop.
[*] A bug has been fixed where an enabled Japanese Microsoft IME keyboard would cause a switch to hiragana instead of Latin by default.
[*] BV 138 C-1 — a bug with the display of the water surface in the bomb sight has been fixed.
[*] New icons for the respawn points have been added.
[*] Camo preview has been added to the “Skins” tab of the user profile card.
[*] The missile info card now has data on the time of controlled flight, jamming resistance of the ATGM guiding optical channel, as well as guaranteed launch distance of the ATGM ( an attainable distance under any atmospheric conditions affordable). Availability of the laser-beam control channel now indicated for ATGMs based on ground vehicles.[/list]
[b]Ground vehicle model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes[/b][list]
[*] Challenger 2 (2F) — durability of combined armour has been specified.
[*] Challenger 2, Challenger 2 (2F) — aiming angles of the AA machine gun have been specified to avoid firing through the commander’s sight.
[*] Type 16 — camera position has been corrected. A bug has been fixed where the vehicle might disappear at certain angles of the camera view.
[*] Type 16, Dardo, Centauro I 105, Centauro I 105R, Centauro I 120 — a bug has been fixed with the display of bulkheads in xray mode with the armour view disabled (report).

[*] TAM 2IP — a bug with missing overpressure damage to the crew has been fixed.[/list]
[b]Aircraft model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes[/b][list]
[*] Ju 87 G-1, Ju 87 G-2 — a bug has been fixed where parts of the cannons remain in the air when the wings have detached.
[*] MiG-21MF — a bug has been fixed where parts of the wings remain in the air after the wings have detached.
[*] MiG-21MF, MiG-21SMT — a bug has been fixed where  the airbrake might pass through a suspended flare container.
[*] Attacker FB.1, Attacker FB.2 — the flap limitation has been added when using suspended armament.
[*] Saab A32A — a bug has been fixed where chaff was added to the 12xM/49 rockets preset.
[*] IL-2 (all series) — a separate launching of the 82mm and 32mm rockets has been added.
[*] Saab A21A-3 — a separate bomb drop has been added for the 50kg bombs.[/list]
[b]Naval forces model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes[/b][list]
[*] Pr.1204 — damage to the turrets with the vessel heaving  has been fixed.
[*] IJN Mutsuki, 120 mm/45 3rd Year Type — armour piercing and ballistics of shells Type 1 and Type 0 has been corrected.
[*] Characteristics of the Italian W.200/450X5,75 torpedo have been corrected: max distance has been increased to 8 km.
[*] Maxim Gorkiy - the parameters of explosions in the ammo stowages have been corrected. Explosion and fire in the auxiliary calibre ammo stowage does not lead to a guarantee of vessel destruction.[/list]
[b]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/b]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/aircraft21_TW_(Maly)_6c682f7500cc504ee2ea66db9712216b.png[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder on the website [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]special section[/url].

[h1]Set the injured free?[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_24/AAA1_(Maly)_282989bfb998e653ca354dfdc6769bbb.jpg[/img]

No way! Now, airfield anti-aircraft guns won’t stop shooting at the wounded and disabled enemy aircraft that are still able to fight even with a wing off. A crippled vulture is still dangerous, so let the shells from AA guns nail them for sure!

[h1]Vehicle service[/h1]

For this digest we focused primarily on servicing war machines. Still there are over 2,000 vehicles in War Thunder and some of them require attention. 

For example we have added separate 82mm launchers and 132mm rockets for several vehicle models of the Il-10. Separate bomb drop for Swedish A32A and also we have improved the armour plating for the pilot headrest of the Japanese lineup - Ki-84 ko, Ki-84 otsu, Ki-84 hei.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_24/Il103_(Maly)_5633ef86621aa02c5c6be8922bfcd522.jpg[/img]

Also we have corrected the firing angles of the defensive turrets for a number of vehicles such as the Il-10, which we already described above and Japanese “crocodiles” - H8K2 and H8K3. All of this of course according to the  historical documents some of which have been published by different attentive players.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_24/Ship1_(Maly)_8bf11784063970e8f19b8db6cb730620.jpg[/img]

USS Raleigh and USS Detroit received a wider angle of fire for their case mate cannons (these are those that are located in limited, usually inboard, locations on a ship). In addition, in their case it is the main calibre, so don’t underestimate this bonus.

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[*] Saab A32A — separate drop has been added for 120 and 250 kg bombs.

notes.title: It’s fixed! №23 + Update 2.9.0.50
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/aircraft10_TW_b2503da4b2da450b78cfa2cb20361428.png[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder on the website [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]special section[/url].

[h1]Contact![/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/Spot1_(Maly)_d499d781067d94d69db1b9a024cefebd.jpg[/img]

Let’s start with the great news! In the update “Direct Hit”, the display of contacts in the air was changed, but we found a few problems with it and received feedback from players - primarily from VR users - aircraft were more difficult to detect in the sky and control their position. In a recent update we improved the visibility of aerial contacts and their display distance. Including on the surface background. 

Let’s not go into a long description. It is better to see it for yourself!

[h1]Fixing the underfilling[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/Fuel1_(Maly)_8c9b301b5f4f52fce06b15f067db8b39.jpg[/img]

This error was caused by the discrepancy between the real amount of fuel and the selected amount for your aircraft.

We have found the initial problem and fixed it. Your fuel selection is now working correctly.

[h1]Notifying you about differences in BR[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/BR1_(Maly)_35d5623df3ab648c2ccdd1ab483b74f0.jpg[/img]

If you were a squad leader at least once, you know how difficult it is to keep track of the vehicles of every squad member.

We added a warning message for the squad leader if the BR of the squad’s vehicles is greater than the BR of the squad leader. In addition, we have improved the display of the current BR - in the queue window the BR score is now more noticeable and slightly bigger.

[h1]Corrected the helicopter ballistic calculator[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/Heli1_(Maly)_ce4b23c4abd8bdfa8d9b92278ae4aa13.jpg[/img]

It might break if you changed helicopter and literally saved the settings of the previous vehicle that you left or lost in battle. This caused a whole bunch of problems: missile and shell failures and an almost complete inability of the vehicle to participate in a high-tech modern battle. 

But we have fixed the problem quickly, and now this "smart system" performs its task as neatly as possible.

[h1]Returned the snow to vehicle decorations[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/Bush1_(Maly)_34f7f80b3a859ec28f0d76e2c9d16859.jpg[/img]

Winter is coming! We need to be ready for this. Let’s start with a small problem which caused some new well recognised decorations to be unevenly covered with snow in battles on winter maps.

Fixed the bug! As a bonus - it will be even more difficult to spot you!

[h1]Free the screen[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_23/Radar1_(Maly)_0d040dd310c1d476e4222cdd643fd209.jpg[/img]

Modern combat equipment has numerous systems that are sometimes duplicated in different areas of the interface. For example, data from the radar appeared at the bottom left corner, as well as at the top of the screen as an azimuth scale.

We’ve analyzed your preferences and decided to remove the scale to make observance of combat easier and clearer for you.

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.9.0.50[/h1]

[b]Improvements and fixes[/b][list]
[*] A bug has been fixed with the missing helicopter speed indicator if the “Indicated air speed” option is set to “IAS”.
[*] A torpedo reload indicator has been fixed in Naval AB for the vessels with on board reloading torpedo launchers ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/531905-torpedo-reload-indicator-not-working/]report[/url]).
[*] A bug has been fixed which in some cases prevented “Damage to naval targets” achievement progress .
[*] Incorrect ballistic calculator on helicopters has been fixed for the second and subsequent respawns. 
[*] SIDAM 25, SIDAM 25 (Mistral), Gepard, Chieftain Marksman, Type 87, PGZ09 — a bug with the quick reload of the main ammo belt has been fixed.
[*] HMS Norfolk — a bug with a constantly rotating port (left) torpedo launcher has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed that prevented item purchase or opening in the inventory while using a cursor with gamepad.
[*] AIM-7 —  a bug has been fixed where the missile was unable to lock on to MiG-23M and MiG-27M aircraft. The missile lock indicator didn’t turn red, the missile self-destructed in midair after the launch.
[*] MiG-23M — now being spawned at supersonic speeds will mean these aircraft have the wings 100% swept.
[*] Mi-24V — certain missing textures in the cockpit have been restored.
[*] Mi-35, Ka-50 — rear-view mirrors in the cockpit have been fixed.
[*] STB-1 — ammo rack position has been corrected ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/534744-29021-10092021-stb-1s-lower-armor-plate-model-or-ammorack-damage-model-is-incorrect/]report[/url]).
[*] BMP-2 — the position of the IR searchlight has been corrected.
[*] B17G — front turret has been fixed.
[*] Buccaneer S.1 — animation of the ailerons has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed with missing snow on vegetable 3D decorations while playing in winter locations.
[*] A rare client crash after changing account has been fixed.
[*] The azimuth scale at the top of the screen has been removed for aircraft equipped with a radar.[/list]
[b]Ground vehicle model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] STB-1 — ammo rack position has been corrected ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/534744-29021-10092021-stb-1s-lower-armor-plate-model-or-ammorack-damage-model-is-incorrect/]report[/url]).
[*] BTR-152А —  the number of forward and reverse gears has been increased, gear values have been specified. Source: Руководство по материальной части и эксплуатации БТР-152В, 1957 год.
[*] ARL-44, ARL-44 (ACL-1) — the number of forward and reverse gears has been increased, gear values have been specified. ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/498713-2020-09-21-1101075-arl-44-gear-box/]report[/url]).
[*] Leclerc S1, Leclerc S2 — the gear values have been specified. A bug with a slow pivot neutral gear turns has been fixed ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/453217-rptd-transmission-issue-of-char-leclerc-s1/]report[/url]).
[*] Abrams (all series) — gear values have been specified. Source: AGT 1500 POWERPACK IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (M1 TMEPS) CONTRACT NUMBER DAAE07-87-C-R006 J. Edwards and R. Brayer General Dynamics Land Systems Div. March 1991 // Propulsion System Performance Simulation (PS**2) Computer Simulation to Evaluate Tank-Automotive Engine and Transmission Performance A User's Guide September 1988.
[*] 9M133, 9M133FM-3 — a bug has been fixed where the optronic countermeasures were able to affect the missiles. Control type has been changed to the laser-beam. 
[*] TAM-2C — zoom has been added to the sight; sight magnification has been changed from x12 to separate magnifications x3-x10 ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/498908-1101075-tam-2c-should-have-2-separate-magnification-level]report[/url]).
[*] VFM5 — sight magnification has been specified from x12 to x10 ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/525203-251138-vfm-5-incorrect-gunner-sight-magnification/]report[/url]).
[*] T-72B (1989) — a bug has been fixed with missing layers of cast armour in the turret in x-ray mode.
[*] Leopard 2K — the incorrect display of 20mm gun horizontal and vertical aiming speed in x-ray mode has been fixed.
[*] MAUS, E100 — a bug with different aiming speeds in the main and auxiliary guns has been fixed.
[*] IS-7 — a bug has been fixed where it was impossible to repair AA and rear machine guns.
[*] Strv 103-0, Strv 103A, Strv 103C — duplicate drive controls have been added for the second driver/loader.
[*] ZPRK 2S6 — a bug has been fixed that prevented the IR lock and track system to lock on target at distances over 8,000 meters.
[*] 9P157 — a bug with infinite radar field repair has been fixed.
[*] Vickers Mk.3 — aiming angles at the sides of engine compartment has been specified; a gun will no longer cross the hull elements.
[*] M1A1HC - aiming angles of the 7.62mm AA MG have been specified; machine gun will no longer cross the ARCM searchlight.
[*] Roland 1, FlaRakPz 1, FlaRakRad - The name of the radar in X-Ray view has been clarified.
[*] Gepard - The name of the radar in X-Ray view has been clarified.
[*] B1 Bis, B1 Ter - Driver now has control of the 75mm cannon.[/list]
[b]Naval forces model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*]Falling shell marker - The ability to disable the falling shell marker has been added. You can find it in settings:[list]
[*]Options > Main parameters > Naval Battle Settings > Highlight targeting point[/list]
[*]Lead marker on weapon control - Indication of the distance correction with the lead maker has been fixed. Now it indicates more accurately whether you should aim closer or farther relative to the enemy ship.
[*]Realistic aiming in AB has been fixed - When switching in the settings menu to realistic aiming in AB, shooting is now identical to shooting in RB.
[*]Poltava - Angles for traverse in the aft main calibre turrets have been extended.[/list]
[b]Aircraft model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] MiG-27M - The opening of some presets of the suspended weaponry without researching the relevant modifications has been fixed.
[*] F-8E - Incorrect display of the icons of suspended weaponry for some presets with the AIM -9C missiles has been fixed.
[*] Il-10 (all modifications) - Separate bomb drop for bomb weaponry has been added.
[*] A32A - Incorrect displaying of the icons of suspended weaponry for some presets with the m/50 and m/61 bombs has been fixed. 
[*] Er-2 (ACh-30B) (all modifications) - Incorrect display of the icons of suspended weaponry for some presets with the 250kg and 500kg bombs has been fixed.
[*] A-4E - Full name of the aircraft has been added to the vehicle card.
[*] F-5 (all modifications) - Tearing off of the different wing parts where some elements of the aircraft structure and suspended weaponry were left hanging in the air has been fixed.[/list]
[b]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/b]

notes.title: US Air Force Day
notes.content:
[i]In 1909, the United States Military purchased its first aircraft. Through WWI and WWII, the importance of controlling airspace on the battlefield had grown significantly being used in every aspect of war and peacetime use. In 1947, the need for a formalized branch of service to be established to further the development and deployment of America’s Air Forces was seen as vital to modernization and organization efforts. Today we salute the USAF on their 74th Birthday! The USAF today continues to meet the highest standards possible, producing many of the finest pilots the world has ever seen.[/i]

[h3][b]Until 07:00 GMT on the 20th of September,
play 3 battles with an in-game activity of 70% or higher in random battles while flying US aircraft of rank II or higher and
get a unique “U.S. AIR FORCE” decal in honor of U.S. Air Force Day.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/25d09031a4305aa5cfa5d290b2227a1792000456.png[/img]
Terms
[list]
[*] You can follow your progress by clicking on your Nickname → Achievements → US Air Force Day.
[*] Prize decal can be found in “Customization” → USA.
[/list]

[h3]Temporarily in game for Golden Eagles: P-47M-1-RE and P-51D-10[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4649813/2f1b84d348c96c5cb2eb1afc4311567ada0a1892.jpg[/img]

For the period of the event, the premium Bostwick's P-47M-1-RE Thunderbolt and Wetmore's P-51D-10 Mustang are available for purchase for Golden Eagles in the USA research tree.

tags.feature: get a unique “U.S. AIR FORCE” decal in honor of U.S. Air Force Day.

notes.title: Update 2.9.0.36
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Aircraft/Aircraft%202%20Japan%20Red_70a82fa8869abeb53a106e90476e8a95.jpg[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b][list]
[*] A warning message when the BR of the squad player’s vehicles differs from the BR of the squad leader’s vehicles has been added when queuing.
[*] Display of the actual BR of a player’s vehicles or squad’s vehicles in the queue window has been improved. The numbers are now more visible.
[*] Display of an aircraft’s contacts has been improved and the distance of their appearance has been increased. This simplifies visual search and detection of the aircraft at medium and long range as well as against the surface background.[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b][list]
[*] Incorrect fuel load when entering a battle in an aircraft has been fixed for some cases where the change of the fuel amount and the appearance of the aircraft didn’t match the selection in the respawn window.
[*] A bug that caused the selected rocket detonation distance settings not to be applied, but to use presets of another aircraft in the setup, has been fixed. 
[*] A bug where the visual display of aircraft contacts in the sky depended on turning on or off the radar has been fixed.
[*] A  bug has been fixed with a hydroplane or flying boat with an aerial spawn point may be spawned on the ground far from the airfield in EC missions. 
[*] Kh-25 missile — a bug has been fixed with the missing laser guiding indicator.
[*] AGM-65 missile — missing target lock indicator has been fixed .
[*] A  bug has been fixed with heat sources that could not be rendered in the TVD with the very high resolution effects option enabled.
[*] A bug has been fixed with the hit camera, when the torpedoed ship might be displayed incorrectly or with missing modules.
[*] F-8E FN now has authentic radar without IRST.
[*] Notch sector for AIM-7 and R-23R has been increased.
[*] The maximum range of non-tracking target illumination with a fighter radar (due to radar sidelobes) has been decreased.
[*] Head-on target detection has been increased, low altitude tail-on target detection has been decreased for the Pulse-Doppler mode of the F-4K and F-4M FGR2 radars. Detection range has been slightly decreased for impulse mode.
[*] Pulse-Doppler mode is chosen by default for Saab 37 Viggen and F-4EJ KAI radars.[/list]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №22 + Update 2.9.0.33
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/news_direct_hit_mig_27m_com_fcb0cb6ab8d59e273d1e5a1251c6b025.jpg[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder on the website [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]special section[/url].

[h1]Returning fragments with penetration [/h1]

They could indeed disappear if a volumetric shell pierced the intersection of three or four armour parts. The problem occurred rather rarely but has nevertheless been fixed. Good luck hitting your targets!

[h1]Improving FPS and increasing stability[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/fps2_(Maly)_25c0ca73a665dc566abe0c3eda2559e2.jpg[/img]

Improved FPS since the “Direct Hit” update, improved game stability and [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]we continue to do so[/url]! A fatal client crash after a long game on PlayStation 4 has been fixed. But we wanted to remind you of one more important detail - an updated GPU driver on your PC is key to a stable FPS and client stability and every War Thunder player can do it.[list]
[*] You can find the latest driver for Nvidia [url=https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx]here[/url].
[*] You can find the latest driver for AMD [url=https://www.amd.com/ru/support]here[/url].[/list]
[h1]The commander was drawn to the east[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/bino2_(Maly)_f229a44d00eb9ed4139237b0561ebde9.jpg[/img]

There's no other way to explain why when you switched from the commander's sight to the good old binoculars, their gaze was always directed to the East. This bug was very recent, but you reported it to us in a timely manner. Fixed!

[h1]If you don't need “Automatic target lock”...[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/aim2_(Maly)_a2ddc98ed9d337c89fb67c6a94f5f24e.jpg[/img]

...you can turn it off. This is regarding Naval Battles, where target capture could still happen if the target was very close to the aiming marker. Now if you disable this feature, it will indeed be completely disabled. Thanks for your bug reports.

We have also fixed incorrect (inverted) mouse wheel movement when adjusting the distance when the target was very close.

[h1]MLRS crosshairs tuned[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/mlrs1_(Maly)_583bbb507d9ded42091f61b4241527e8.jpg[/img]

Remember our devblog about [url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7310-development-dynamics-of-war-thunder-missiles-en]rockets and missile ballistic changes[/url]? Multiple Launch Rocket Systems have been updated and adjusted crosshairs. It’s time for you to become a rocket sniper!

[h1]Weed’s back![/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_22/grass2_(Maly)_fffd1e715c023de7046c17f89dc0c590.jpg[/img]

Hey, hey, easy... for Linux only. Some time ago, grass disappeared from all graphic presets on the Linux platform, and players had to turn it on manually. Rejoice, Linux people! The weed is back!

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.9.0.33[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Ground/Tank%202%20UK%20Red_b9523082b7c02def4e5a82bf6d3062de.jpg[/img]

[b]Improvements and fixes[/b][list]
[*] A bug has been fixed when, if a voluminous shell hits a cross section area of 3 or 4 armoured elements, a shell didn’t form fragments after penetrating the armour. 
[*] A bug has been fixed where, when switching from commander’s sight to binoculars with “Save direction while switching current trigger” option enabled, the view in binoculars was directed to the east.  
[*] A bug has been fixed that resulted in locking on enemies nearby the selected one with the “Automatic target lock” option enabled in Naval battles.
[*] A bug has been fixed that resulted in incorrect range correction at nearer distances in Naval battles: rotating down in some cases increased correction, rotating up decreased it. 
[*] A bug has been fixed with missing grass on any graphic presets available on the Linux version.[/list]
[b]Ground vehicle model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] Chieftain Mk.10, Striker - “Late two tone” camo is now available for completing tasks, similar to other later British ground vehicles.
[*] ZSU-37-2 - NVD has been added for driver and commander.
[*] Type 87 - “Adjustment of fire”module has been added.
[*] M41A1 (SDF) - aiming speed of the anti-aircraft machine gun has been increased and brought in line with that of the M41A1 in the US branch ([url=https://forum.warthunder.ru/index.php?/topic/311946-m41-yaponiya-ne-uvelichili-kak-ostalnoi-tekhnike-skorost-navedeniya-zenitnogo-pulemeta/]report[/url])
[*] Type 60 ATM - crew number has been corrected in the info card. ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/518980-type-60-atm-crew-count/]report[/url])
[*] Leopard 2K - rubber-fabric mudguards have been added to the damage model.
[*] Сromwell V (RP-3) - incorrect rocket depletion order in xray mode has been fixed.
[*] Merkava Mk.3D - description of the bulkhead between engine and combat compartments has been corrected.
[*] Vickers Mk.3 - gun depression angles over the engine compartment have been reduced.
[*] MLRS sight crosshairs have been specified after changes to the ballistic characteristics of rockets ([url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7310-development-dynamics-of-war-thunder-missiles-en]devblog[/url]) 
[*] 25mm M791 - initial velocity for the the M242 gun has been specified.[/list]
[b]Aircraft model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes[/b][list]
[*] Pe-8 - icons in the secondary weaponry menu have been corrected for 100 kg bombs.
[*] Wfr.Gr.21 - explosives type display has been fixed in the info card.
[*] Hunter F.6 - the display of the protection caps on the empty rocket launchers for the twin SRAAM weapon preset have been fixed.
[*] AH-64DJP - the display of the launchers of the AIM-92 missiles have been fixed.
[*] Yak-30 - armoured backseat has been added.[/list]
[h1]Fleet model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes[/h1][list]
[*] LÉ Orla - traverse speed of the main calibre turret has been fixed.
[*] Clemson type destroyers - AI shooting at aerial targets has been fixed. Parameters of the remote fuse for the 76mm HE remote fuse rounds have been corrected.
[*] HMS Armada, HMAS Tobruk - a bug has been fixed where 40mm mountings remained at maximum elevation.[/list]
[b]Flight model changes[/b][list]
[*] AH-1z -  improved throttle response and revs recovery with increasing propeller pitch.
[*] Scout AH.Mk.1, Wasp HAS.Mk.1 - the roll has been fixed when increasing speed in arcade battles
[*] Do 217 (all series) - a bug has been fixed with incorrect position of wheels on the front landing gear. 
[*] Tu-1 - a bug with incorrect fuel loading has been fixed.
[*] MiG-23, MiG-27 - a dead zone in the yaw channel has been reduced when the automatic controls system is operating in the stabilization or damping mode[/list]
[b]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/b]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №21 + Update 2.9.0.17
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Direct_Hit/news_direct_hit_saab_ja37_com_5d9cad6e9f23f368dc1376df9f762b13.jpg[/img]

In this digest we would like to tell you about our continuing work on improvements and fixes in the game. You can find information about all updates that have been released in War Thunder on the website [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/]special section[/url].

[b]This time we are going to talk about some of the particularly interesting improvements in War Thunder that came out with the “[url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7325-news-meet-major-update-direct-hit-en]Direct Hit[/url]” major update![/b]

[h1]Great work on sounds[/h1]

With each update War Thunder sounds better and better. “Direct Hit” was no exception if your feedback from Open-DEV was to be believed.

This time we worked with the sounds of the engines so they not only sounded realistic but also changed the character of the sounds depending on the load. You can hear the result in the game! Engine roar and its speed will be noticeably different when driving on rutted tracks or when climbing a steep hill.

To consolidate the atmosphere of heavy vehicle movement, we added new sounds of surfaces under an armoured vehicle's tracks: water, sand, snow, asphalt, paving stones, mud and even ice will all sound different.

Major changes also occurred in the firing sounds of all automatic cannons and machine guns. Now they better correspond to the main features of the real guns: the detail of the sound depending on the location of the listener has increased and each shot is heard more clearly.

[h1]Arc of sight on the minimap[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/Map_940_3017b3d239019a9afe3064075cd269db.jpg[/img]

A simple but useful improvement for the minimap. The marker boundaries that display the sector of the map you see are now more visible and contrast better. No longer will they be lost against the background of bright winter locations. Look around more comfortably!

[h1]Destroyed enemies will become cooler[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/htvisor_940_4159719c0765435e8bdfeca28406c694.jpg[/img]

It is hard to imagine a battle of top tanks without the use of thermal imaging and therefore this mechanism deserves special attention.

We worked on the temperature of the wrecks of destroyed vehicles. Now the piles of metal that used to be your enemy will become colder than active vehicles if enough time has passed since the fire died down and the tracks, barrels, and hulls have cooled down. However it will still be possible to hide among destroyed enemies. Just don’t forget to turn the engine off.

[h1]DLSS 2.2[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/unknown_940_73e4a209696db9581c379878c1f9e41f.jpg[/img]

In War Thunder you will always find a lot of features that improve picture quality or improve game performance. Among these are smoothing with deep learning algorithms - Nvidia DLSS. This mechanism allows you to increase the FPS and at the same time get a higher resolution.

For the “Direct Hit” update we have updated the support for this technology to version 2.2 which brings two key fixes: an even more noticeable improvement in the picture and a victory over ghosting especially in dark scenes. If you own an Nvidia RTX GPU - go ahead and turn it on!

[h1]Weapon control for naval[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/fire_director_940_ab01bc4727b545df908cd738c8205c52.jpg[/img]

Weapon control - your trusted friend and comrade that makes shooting much easier by calculating your preemptives and making other adjustments for you. Pilots are very familiar with it but what about the Navy?

The fleet has it now too! Later ships have begun getting “Artillery Directors” whose job is to help aim at targets. Extremely useful mechanics especially when firing at very long distances.

These mechanisms are fully-fledged vehicle modules that means that they can be destroyed with a precise hit or even lucky shrapnel but until then the “Artillery Director” will faithfully help you shoot more accurately.

You can get acquainted with the characteristics of the new modules in the analysis of the modules on vehicles right in the hangar. There can be several of them and each is responsible for different cannons. Presented are “Artillery Directors” on those ships where they were used in reality.

[i]In addition, a noticeably updated interface for cannon guidance in binocular view.[/i]

[h1]Showing radar characteristics[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/radar_en_940_4d991f2042321c8303093e1d027f46e5.jpg[/img]

Not too far from being able to hover your mouse over a module and learn about its capabilities, we would like to inform you that you can now do the same with aircraft radar.

Turn on the module viewer and point your cursor at the vehicle or pilot radar where the head display can also tell you a lot about the aircraft’s capabilities.

[h1]Improved effects[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Fixed_21/War_Thunder_Screenshot_2021_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838_09_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838_08_-_11_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838_37_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838_16_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838_59_940_1770d70b03c8c5612c33496aa8051838.jpg[/img]

Explosions, splashes, sparks from hits and smoke you see virtually every second spent in a good battle. We devote a huge effort to make them better. Do you remember the improved effects of hits we introduced in the [url=https://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/1214]Ixwa Strike[/url] update? Now we’re ready to present the new improved effects for naval battles!

We have completely reworked the large calibre rounds hits to different surfaces, and thoroughly improved the effects of hits on the water for all calibres in the game. The effects of underwater explosions have been reworked for torpedoes, depth charges and sea mines. New splash pillar effects from large calibres allow you to see the results of a salvo much better.  We have also improved the effects for explosions on decks and introduced new beautiful splashes of stern waves.

You’d better visit naval battles to witness our work personally. See you there!

[b]Don’t forget to check out other types of vehicles. Another bulk of ground units received physically correct tracks, a few others got an empty cartridge animation.[/b]

[h1]Improved graphics on ULQ settings[/h1]

In the Direct Hit update we have improved the quality and overall picture perception on ultra-low graphic settings. New color correction and improved optical adaptation of the brightness in contrast scenes, such as dawn or evening, the picture looks deeper and more saturated. It looks better now!

Objects in War Thunder, such as trees or houses, now have a similar rendering distance for all graphics presets. New optimized shadows appear in a certain radius around you, which require minimal resource consumption from your PC.

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.9.0.17[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/upd/aircraft21_TW_574681ac9c9d55b6691080da443a539f.jpg[/img][list]
[*] A bug has been fixed where players couldn’t see the “Attention to the map” marker on the minimap during a battle.
[*] A bug has been where an afterburner flame looked black in ULQ settings. 
[*] A bug has been fixed that prevented a vehicle’s pop-up menu displaying in the test drive window whilst using a gamepad.
[*] A bug has been fixed that prevented the decal tab from closing whilst using a gamepad.
[*] A bug has been fixed that in some cases led to a crash on PlayStation consoles.
[*] The display of ground units at low heights has been fixed for weapons with TV seekers.
[*] IS-7 — a bug with an incorrect display of the coaxial 7.62mm machine guns in x-ray mode has been fixed.
[*] Vickers Mk.3 — vignette in the gunner’s sight has been fixed, field of view has been widened. .
[*] Pe-8 — separate fuel tanks have been enabled (reduced chance of fire). A more precise inertia calculation has been implemented depending on the current weight (fuel and armament load). Thermodynamics of engines has been specified. 
[*] AV-8A — a bug with the display of the flares block has been fixed in the preset “Flares/chaff x240”.
[*] MiG-27M — The R-60 missiles in the preset with 100kg bombs have been changed to R-60M.
[*] ZTZ99-III — reduced armour durability of the hull’s front in comparison to the ZTZ99-II has been fixed ([url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/533631-28027ztz-99iii-armour-problem/]report[/url]).
[*] ZTZ96, ZTZ96A, ZTZ99-II, ZTZ99-III — Reloading time for the 125 mm cannon has been changed from 7.5 to 7.1 seconds.
[*] Type 79 ASM — Elevation above the line of sight in flight has been added.
[*] ZSU-37-2 — Displaying of the different angular guidance speeds for the left and right cannons in the X-Ray view has been fixed.
[*] HMS Peacock — Radar has been added to the X-Ray view.
[*] Churchill I — A bug with reverse track rotation has been fixed.
[*] Aviation SB mode now requires Easy Anti-Cheat enabled.
[*] In air SB sessions, created by players, now disabled bots will change to missing or exited players.
[*] A bug has been fixed with disabled the rocket ballistic calculator in mixed battles, if a player previously played in a ground vehicle or naval vessel.
[*] A bug has been fixed with disabling the ballistic calculator when ammo is depleted. The fix means that it is not necessary to repeatedly switch it on in AB mode
[*] F-104G (Italy) — The AIM-9J has been added to the weaponry list. The AIM-9B modification has been moved to rank II, LAU-10/A to rank III. A preset with 2хAIM-9B is now available without modification research by default.
[*] F-104S — The AIM-9J has been added to the weaponry list. The AIM-7E modification has been moved to rank II. The LAU-10/A modification no longer requires research. The AIM-9B modification has been moved to rank III   
[*] F-8E — A Preset with 2х AIM-9C and 2x AIM-9D has been added.
[*] Tu-1 — Material and armour glass thickness in the nose section of the cockpit has been fixed.
[*] Conditions for obtaining some achievements and the rewards for completing them have been changed. This will not affect the reward of achievements already received and the progress of partially completed ones. The full list of changed achievements:[list]
[*]Miscellaneous — Custom-built
[*]Miscellaneous — Path of perfection
[*]Miscellaneous — Fully Equipped
[*]Miscellaneous — Rearmament
[*]Miscellaneous — Proved as Improved
[*]Crew — Expert
[*]Research — Only the Stars Are Higher
[*]Aircraft — Can't Catch Me!
[*]Tanks — Victory machine
[*]Fleet — Flagship[/list]
[*]Incorrect display of fuel has been corrected, that mistakenly depended on the connection quality.
[*]A bug has been fixed where AI aircraft in Test Drive spawned with low initial speed where they stalled and crashed.
[*]A bug has been fixed that in some cases led to a client crash on downloading the hangar on Nvidia graphic cards.
[*]B-29 (USA) nuke carrier - in ground RB, the incorrect respawn type “Bombers” has been removed.[/list]
[b]Sound[/b][list]
[*] A bug has been fixed with the overly loud sound of the Begleitpanzer’s gun and the British 40mm QF.2 gun, as well as the 57mm ZiS-4 gun from the gunner’s view. 
[*] The overly loud sound of the rotary barrel gear on the M61 gun (M163 SPAAG) has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed with the missing sound of the naval gun chase camera for the first 4 seconds of flight.
[*] The overly quiet sound of the beginning of an artillery barrage has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed where the sound of the M230 guns of the Apache series of helicopters didn’t depend on the rate of fire.[/list]
[b]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/b]

New color correction and improved optical adaptation of the brightness in contrast scenes, such as dawn or evening, the picture looks deeper and more saturated. It looks better now! Objects in War Thunder, such as trees or houses, now have a similar rendering distance for all graphics presets. New optimized shadows appear in a certain radius around you, which require minimal resource consumption from your PC.
MiG-27M — The R-60 missiles in the preset with 100kg bombs have been changed to R-60M.
Type 79 ASM — Elevation above the line of sight in flight has been added.

F-104S — The AIM-9J has been added to the weaponry list. The AIM-7E modification has been moved to rank II. The LAU-10/A modification no longer requires research. The AIM-9B modification has been moved to rank III

Conditions for obtaining some achievements and the rewards for completing them have been changed. This will not affect the reward of achievements already received and the progress of partially completed ones. notes.title: Updates to Japanese Ground Forces: New Vehicles, Camouflages & More
notes.content:
In the next major update coming to War Thunder, the Japanese ground forces tree will see several highly anticipated new additions and changes being implemented. In today’s devblog, we will showcase some of the most notable changes coming with the upcoming major update - let’s have a look!

[h1]New Variants of the Type 74[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Japanese_Ground_Forces/shot_2021_fa9955158fc66ea39fa4ba3e5e1b70d4_09_fa9955158fc66ea39fa4ba3e5e1b70d4_02_14_fa9955158fc66ea39fa4ba3e5e1b70d4_29_fa9955158fc66ea39fa4ba3e5e1b70d4_05_940_fa9955158fc66ea39fa4ba3e5e1b70d4.jpg[/img]

Coming as part of the next major update “Direct hit”, seasoned tankers may rejoice as new variants of the popular Type 74 make its way to the top ranks of the Japanese ground forces tree. Specifically, the current Type 74 in the game will be updated to the Type 74 E, while the earlier modification - the Type 74 C - will be introduced to reinforce the Japanese high tier lineup. As a result, the combat endurance of Japanese tank commanders should increase as they get the chance to bring more vehicles into battle!

Additionally, we also plan to update the ammunition selection of the Type 74 series, including that of the STB-1 prototype. While the Type 74 E will retain most of its current ammunition selection, it will lose access to HESH rounds. The STB-1 on the other hand will retain its subcaliber and HESH rounds, but will lose the option of carrying HEAT rounds. Lastly, the new Type 74 C will form a middle ground between the two existing modifications: it will carry the same ammunition as the STB-1 but will also have access to a more powerful HEATFS round which tankers will be able to unlock as they gain experience using the vehicle.

[h1]Reinforced SPAAG Line: Welcome the M16 & M19[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Japanese_Ground_Forces/shot_2021_04ba88a14384819f2c604e974f8c86d7_09_04ba88a14384819f2c604e974f8c86d7_02_14_04ba88a14384819f2c604e974f8c86d7_55_04ba88a14384819f2c604e974f8c86d7_28_940_04ba88a14384819f2c604e974f8c86d7.jpg[/img]

Apart from new additions to the top ranks, we also plan to introduce two new vehicles to the low and mid ranks of the Japanese ground forces tree, specifically its SPAAG branch. Already familiar to American tankers in particular, their Japanese colleagues will now also receive access to the well-known and no less deadly M16 and M19 SPAAGs. These will bolster the strength of the Japanese SPAAG line at ranks II and III, respectively.

With these two new additions we strive to make the progression through the ranks of the Japanese SPAAG branch smoother while at the same time offering tankers more adequate levels of anti-air protection at each rank. Beware pilots, the Japanese mobile air defences just got stronger!

[h1]Additional Camouflage for high-rank Vehicles[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/09%20September/Japanese_Ground_Forces/shot_2021_d3fdf752c168d582e632f37c82f58337_09_d3fdf752c168d582e632f37c82f58337_02_14_d3fdf752c168d582e632f37c82f58337_39_d3fdf752c168d582e632f37c82f58337_19_940_d3fdf752c168d582e632f37c82f58337.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, fans of Japanese ground forces will have one more new addition to look forward to in the next major War Thunder update. Namely, we plan to introduce an updated default single-tone camouflage, as well as two-tone  patterns to all JSDF vehicles, thus giving tankers the option to outfit their favorite Japanese high-rank vehicles with a fresh coat of paint! Quite neat, isn’t it?

These and many more new additions and improvements await you in the upcoming major update arriving soon to War Thunder. In the meantime, make sure to stay tuned to the news to find out what other exciting new content the next major update has in store for you. Until then, happy hunting tankers!

[quote][url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7322-development-updates-to-japanese-ground-forces-new-vehicles-camouflages-more-en][b]Check it out on the official War Thunder website[/b][/url][/quote][h3][/h3]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №20 + Update 2.7.0.229
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Harrier_19c4d2067fde80f69aedf1bd941267fa.jpg[/img]

[b]We are working on the upcoming major update “Direct Hit” and next start of the Open DEV server which will take place on the 1st of September. That’s why there are not many fixes this time, but it is still important for many players.[/b]

[h1]Fixing the opaque sight[/h1]

The glass of the gunsight in the cockpit of your aircraft could become opaque if you disable the sight function (yes, you can do that). The problem affected quite a lot of vehicles: AV-8A, AV-8C, Harrier GR.1, Harrier GR.3, F-4E Phantom II, F-4EJ Phantom II, F-4F Early, F-4F, Phantom FG.1, Phantom FGR.2, Su-17M2, Jaguar A, Jaguar GR.1, F-5E, A-7D.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_20/Harrier1_c89c4bab28dc4a04260405b9cfa92056.jpg[/img]

Fixed. The glass no longer fills with solid color and you can now use the option to remove the rectile when you don’t need it, for example to improve visibility.

[h1]Recycling Defective Nuclear Weapons[/h1]

Only the best of the best can collect the necessary amount of points needed to fly out with an aircraft with nuclear weaponry and end the battle with a victory for their own team by pushing just one button! But due to a strange error the nuclear alarm siren didn’t go off and the dropped bomb didn’t detonate.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_20/Atom1_ab0a9d340ecb5da0824ae61600400a77.jpg[/img]

This is very frustrating after overcoming so many difficulties, so we rushed to correct the error. Bomb confidently.

[h1]Fixed several client errors[/h1]

One of them could have occurred in spectator mode in the aircraft AB and crash the game client. The other one could occur at the moment of exiting the game without any reason.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_20/Arcade1_32ed4b94e46f0f93a3d871ccfd3d3f6b.jpg[/img]

They will not bother you again. Thank you for letting us know about these problems!

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.7.0.229[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Aircraft/Aircraft%201%20Battle%20Blue_0782fea0162963b35f34c5b82c5e2913.jpg[/img]

[*] A bug has been fixed due to which missiles within the launchers of destroyed tanks might appear undamaged.
[*] A bug has been fixed due to which a flight of a nuclear strike aircraft did not lead to the sound of a siren, nuclear blast and the mission’s end.
[*] A probable issue with the error message after quitting the game client has been fixed.
[*] A bug has been fixed that could lead to a crash when in the spectator mode in the Arcade battles.[/list]

[*]If the player is in the air or is on the airfield and the vehicle is under repair, or is on the airfield at a speed faster than repair time, the abandonment timer will be reset (will be set to maximum);
[*]If the player is on the ground outside the airfield, or is on the airfield at a speed equal to the repair time but will not be serviced (repaired, reloaded or refueled) then the abandonment timer will be activated.[/list]

notes.title: New Locations & Updated Test Drive
notes.content:
[b]Along with an abundance of new vehicles and features, the next major War Thunder update will also introduce two new locations for combined battles as well as an updated test drive environment for tankers. Today we would like to tell you more about these so let’s dive right into the details!
[/b]
[h1]New Locations [/h1]

In the next major update “Direct hit” arriving to War Thunder we look forward to further expanding the number of battlefields for players to engage in heated skirmishes on by introducing two new locations for combined battles. Tankers, welcome ‘Breslau’ and ‘Spaceport’ to the map rotation!

[b]Spaceport[/b]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/SpacePort1_(Maly)_3093f2fedb3b8d378ffcc678413b7d06.jpg[/img]

Spaceport is another new combined battle map awaiting players in the upcoming update. While also featuring some urban combat, Spaceport offers more open fighting grounds surrounding the confined city center.

Players who took part in the April Fools event ‘Warfare 2077’ may recall already battling it out on Spaceport. Those players who missed this opportunity won’t have to wait long for a second chance, however. Spaceport will become available in the regular map rotation with the arrival of the next major War Thunder update!

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/SpacePort2_(Maly)_026a77a6e69cf27c5cdd5ad1edd074be.jpg[/img]

[b]Breslau[/b]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Locations/Breslau1_(Maly)_c58e05f750fb1a9a7e718c23b2afa90e.jpg[/img]

Breslau is a new combined battles map, focused on urban combat. The location is inspired by the Siege of Breslau (Wrocław) which took place in the final months of WWII. While focused around intense close-quarter engagements for the most part, Breslau’s northern area is home to a more open battleground, ideally suited for nimble light vehicles to outflank their opponents or scout enemy positions.

On the other hand, the southern end of the map offers plenty of opportunities for brawlers to duke it out in head-on street battles while the occasional town square or park with its wide open space will enable tank commanders to more freely maneuver and potentially break a stalemate.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Locations/Breslau2_(Maly)_09629a9262ad37e8b8cf9cdefa156627.jpg[/img]

[b]Updated Test Drive [/b]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Locations/Test5_(Maly)_4bd8c630e355cb54c3a117a9f3b1a4ea.jpg[/img]

For some time now, tankers recall Kursk not only as a battleground, but also as the place where they give ground vehicles their first proper look outside the hangar. However, while Kursk was home to the largest tank battle in history, we believe that it didn’t do as good of a job of being a suitable proving ground in the game. That being said, we’ve decided to update the test drive for ground vehicles with a new location which gives tankers a much better environment to more thoroughly put their vehicle through its paces.

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Locations/Test2_(Maly)_989d37545d4dc5ecfef691d6e9f7962f.jpg[/img]

Unlike Kursk, the new test drive location is a lot more diverse. It features different terrain types, such as mud and paved roads, and also has more dynamic elevation while at the same time retaining the familiar dummy targets for shooting practice. As a result, tankers will be able to get a much better grasp of their vehicle’s performance under different conditions; for example how fast it accelerates on paved roads or how quickly it can get up a steep hill, or learn its vertical aiming angles. Also, aircraft AI targets are now available for all ground vehicle classes, not only SPAAGs. Eager to give it a shot already? The new test drive location will become available as part of the upcoming update, arriving soon to War Thunder!

The new locations and updated test drive will soon appear in War Thunder as they arrive as part of the next major update. Stay tuned for more!

[quote][url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/7302-development-new-locations-updated-test-drive-en][b]Check out more images on the Official War Thunder Website![/b][/url][/quote]

notes.title: It’s fixed! №19
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/aircraft15_TW_2af326f199ca7f3340d0127a0917d6c9.png[/img]

[h1]Several improvements for the protection analysis[/h1]

We continue to work on the popular test firing feature in the hangar. This time we “Fixed” the duplication of some autocannon and missile belts in the shell selection list and added an armour penetration display for individual shells that are not in the belts for individual vehicles that have such a selection possibility.

[h1]Improving decoration cards[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_19/Decor6_(Maly)_bc12fbbc9040d50808d672eaffb3482e.jpg[/img]

The collection of vehicle customization items in War Thunder is really huge but not all of them are suitable for different vehicle types. There are tank decorations and ship decorations - the latter are also divided by applicability to coastal and bluewater fleet. 

To avoid confusion for you we have added a tag to the decoration cards indicating the vehicle type on which the selected decoration can be used.

[h1]Fixed confusion in vehicle slots[/h1]

This bug occurred in many different ways and affected both vehicles and crews. To describe these cases simply, here is what could happen: the vehicle in the selected slot didn’t change by switching presets, you could get into an air battle not on the selected vehicle and after leaving the battle see the crew data not corresponding to the selected vehicle. 

Looks scary, but we found and fixed all the described troubles! Good luck in battle!

[h1]Fixed the “Bomber” tutorial for consoles[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_19/Bomber2_(Maly)_18726d0f061641697c46f1ef838a4f4e.jpg[/img]

Each newcomer to the game is offered training when you first meet a new vehicle type, but not every newcomer could pass the “Bomber” tutorial because of the error in it in the console version of War Thunder. 

The problem was reproduced only on the new generation of the game consoles and has been already fixed there! Now you can pass and finish the tutorial!

[h1]This Space is not for Rent![/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/Fixed_19/Trailer2_(Maly)_fe8d71b0960f812cfa0967cc0e1370aa.jpg[/img]

You know there is a room in the tank, aircraft and naval part of the hangar for premium vehicles which the game offers based on your preferred battle rank, right? But some players learned how to put other vehicles there even when those vehicles don’t fit into this part of the hangar at all.

Heavy cruiser on the tank trailer is actually a pretty impressive picture, but we decided to put such guests back in place. The bug has been fixed. Thanks for your bug reports!

[h1]More improvements[/h1]

For this digest we have prepared a large set of useful fixes and game improvements. Be sure to read the full list which we have prepared in the separate changelog - there are many interesting things.

Once again, many thanks for all your bug reports that you submitted in our bug report section on the War Thunder forums.

[h1]Update 2.7.0.218[/h1]

[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%20new/940%20-%20Changelog/Aircraft/Aircraft%202%20Germany%20Yellow_1f72196f11d2700c4a5c03fb3629deb0.jpg[/img]

[b]Improvements and fixes[/b][list]
[*] Armor piercing values of Ground forces rounds and bullets, that are separate from ammo belts, have been added to the protection analysis. 
[*] Duplicates of shells and rockets ammo belts have been removed from the protection analysis menu for ground vehicles and aviation.
[*] Overview and test drive options have been introduced for Warbond store vehicles.
[*] 3D decoration info cards now feature information about available types of vehicles.
[*] “Reset to default” warning has been added for switching to the new control device (gamepad or joystick).
[*] While hovering a cursor over your nickname in the statistics, if a player was grouped in autosquad, he will see a tip “You are joined in an automatic squad with this player - stay close and earn additional rewards for destroying an enemy”.
[*] Context menu interaction has been improved in vehicle slots and in the Research mode while using keyboard or gamepad.  
[*] A bug has been fixed which allowed selection of any vehicle instead of the recommended premium vehicle in the hangar via the “View” button in the “Inventory” tab. 
[*] A bug has been fixed due to which selected before mission aircraft in Aviation RB could be switched to another aircraft of this nation available in the slots.  
[*] A bug has been fixed resulted in displaying crew data for another vehicle in the hangar after leaving the battle. .
[*] A bug has been fixed due to which  in some cases, when switching between sets, the displayed vehicle could not change to the one selected in the slot.[/list]
[b]Fixes for consoles:[/b][list]
[*] A bug that made it impossible to interact with the research window in some cases after returning from the vehicle searching screen has been fixed.
[*] A bug that made it impossible to complete “Bomber” tutorial on XboxSeries X|S or Playstation 5 has been fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug which clicking on an empty space on the "Research" screen could lead to the opening of a group slot for vehicles.[/list]
[b]Ground vehicle model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] A bug that caused the vehicles with commander’s sight to have incorrect elevation angles of anti-aircraft machine guns has been fixed.
[*] BMD-4 — Displaying of the reload speed for the 100mm 2A70 cannon has been fixed in the X-Ray view.[/list]
[b]Aircraft model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] Fw 190 D9 - The amount of the rounds for the 13mm MG-131 machine gun has been changed from 450 to 400 shots per barrel.
[*] BV 238 — A bug whereby by the rotating of the camera in the X-Ray view the crew could visually change their position has been fixed.[/list]
[b]Fleet model, damage model, characteristic and weaponry changes:[/b][list]
[*] Displaying the guidance speed of small and medium calibre anti-aircraft artillery when pointing the cursor in X-Ray mode for some large ships, has been added.
[*] MBT 1st series - Influence of the “Torpedo Mode” modification which gave the opposite effect before, has been fixed.[/list]
[b]Economy and Battle Ratings:[/b][list]
[*] Hs 123 A-1 (China) — BR has been changed according to the German counterpart from 1.3 to 1.0 in AB and RB.
[*] He 112 B-2/U2 — BR has been changed according to the He 112 B-1/U2 in RB from 2.3 to 2.0.
[*] Su-11 — BR has been changed according to the table sheet with BR changes published earlier: AB from 7.0 to 7.3; RB from 7.7 to 7.0.[/list]
[b]The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes. War Thunder is constantly improving and specific fixes may be implemented without the client being updated.[/b]

notes.title: [Development] Reports concerning the protection of post-war combat vehicles
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/forum/news_com_58a1af1857e83cc52ff19458018b2559.jpg[/img]

Changes to the requirements of reports concerning the protection of post-war combat vehicles with complex armour schemes.

With the comments below, we would like to describe our approach to reports concerning the protection of modern MBT’s in more detail.

[h1]Modeling of protection for modern main battle tanks[/h1]

In War Thunder, we try to recreate real equipment as accurately as possible. For this we use all the available information. You, our players, help us with this, and we are grateful to you for this help. Together we have corrected a huge number of various inaccuracies and made the game better. In order to make this work in a more fruitful and understandable way, reports for correcting errors and inaccuracies are accepted only if they meet a specific set of requirements.

Unfortunately, these requirements may conflict with the availability and even the openness of information. Primarily, we are talking about the parameters of armour-piercing projectiles and an even more closed topic - the protection of modern tanks.

We are unable to just rely on primary sources in the reports, since in most cases concerning modern MBT’s, such sources are likely to be classified.

Therefore, like the projectile penetration formula, a different approach has been adopted. The protection in an armoured vehicle is a model based on available open information. In some cases, it might be calculated based on publicly available data. Examples are photos and videos of destroyed vehicles. In other cases, protection will be assessed only on the appearance of the vehicle, the location and size of the armour modules, as well as possible threats and requirements that could be presented during the development of the vehicle. At the same time, data with the protection ratings published in various scientific and popular sources are not always relevant and not verifiable.

In particularly difficult cases, we publish our research reasoning why this level of protection was chosen for a particular MBT (e.g. [url=https://warthunder.com/en/news/5782-development-to-minnesota-for-the-abrams-en]Abrams [/url]and [url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/419818-datasheet-challenger-historical-references/]Challenger[/url]), which can be used to understand the level of estimated protection and generalized information that surrounds modern MBT’s and can be found in publicly available sources. In view of this, we would like to announce a few of the main points on which we will consider reports related to armour protection in post-war MBTs with composite armour:[olist]
[*] We will consider every protection report that is made in compliance with the general guidelines and contains general, evaluative information from secondary sources, such as monographs, articles, and studies. Such reports will be treated as suggestions, not bugs or historical issues. Creating such a report can help us more accurately adjust our protection model of the specified vehicle, but it does not guarantee that the information specified in it will be implemented in the game.
[*] We originally created a table which was [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTyOX-h8GOOis7y2Z1o3TVw-_Sh7x03paaeh-qVO6t72UQZEW981FgBetgmaEo6m8J6Nx3Kb-dLLxgh/pubhtml]published previously[/url], with data on the protection of MBTs against ammunition. The following [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRbRmgebNJfxOJPvIf8nYiqZD-Y_bqjuPFNqJVm00ZpxliukJtkrPtbeNmRxEMnqHzIiOqnlTpkZoKs/pubhtml]table here[/url] contains the reference values for penetration calculation in game (valid at time of publication). As new MBT’s are added to the game, they will also be added to the table. We will also add modeled protection parameters for the remaining MBT’s that are not yet in the table
[*] The processing of reports regarding DM errors for MBT’s does not change. For example, reports regarding the non-penetration of parts that cannot withstand the impacted projectile (e.g. when an MBT is not penetrated by an APFSDS round with a high penetration value into a weak spot, such as the side or rear) are still considered bugs.[/olist]
These reports, provided under the general guidelines, continue to be treated as DM bugs.

These changes are aimed at streamlining the reporting process and to make changes to the protection parameters possible.

tags.bug: Reports regarding the non-penetration of parts that cannot withstand the impacted projectile (e.g. when an MBT is not penetrated by an APFSDS round with a high penetration value into a weak spot, such as the side or rear) are still considered bugs.

notes.title: New top-tier ZTZ99-III and A-5C
notes.content:
[img]https://static.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202021%20NEWS/08%20August/ZTZ99W/news_ztz_99_w_com_14013eb762f413a5fb18a5eea19d785c.jpg[/img][quote=author] Briefly: One of the more recent Chinese MBTs in service, featuring great firepower and mobility as well as sophisticated armour protection. [/quote]
[h1]ZTZ99-III, main battle tank, China, rank VII.[/h1]
ːsteamthumbsupː Excellent firepower
ːsteamthumbsupː Advanced protection
ːsteamthumbsupː Low silhouette
ːsteamthumbsdownː Poor reverse speed
ːsteamthumbsdownː Limited gun elevation angles

The ZTZ99-III is a version of the top-tier Chinese MBT with a welded turret, which will await players at rank VII of the Chinese ground forces tech tree with the release of the upcoming major update. Like its predecessors in the Chinese MBT branch, the ZTZ99-III is armed with a 125mm smoothbore cannon with ballistic characteristics and rate of fire comparable to those of the ZTZ96 tanks. Also, the ZTZ99-III is equipped with standard equipment for modern MBT - for example, a thermal imager, smoke grenade launchers and laser rangefinders.
[img]https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/08/1280h720_03_ztz_99_w_e563b3e99e16fefb5f9d3ad6e0285df5.jpg[/img]
The ZTZ99-III is the second MBT in China's top ground vehicles setup, which will be the best choice in both Arcade and Realistic battles. Especially for enthusiasts of Chinese combat vehicles, our store is launching a pre-order for the Premium A-5C attacker aircraft, which will be a handy and very profitable addition to the top-tier armored vehicle setup in mixed battles, as well as a good choice for air battles in any game mode!
[img]https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/08/1280h720_04_ztz_99_w_831f5dbf1d39bf5321a5508f8b5c29d0.jpg[/img]
[h1]A-5C attacker aircraft[/h1]
The Nanchang A-5C is an export modification of the Q-5B strike fighter, developed in the early 80’s for the Pakistani Air Force, which has also been supplied to Bangladesh, Myanmar and Sudan.
[img]https://static.warthunder.ru/upload/image/!2021/08/inner_a_5c_2861111ed3d1cfc1aabb2476e9a51661.jpg[/img]
This fighter is intensively used in combat to this day. Compared to the original, external suspension points for air-to-air guided missiles have been added to the aircraft. The A-5C is capable of a top speed of over 1.400 km/h, and armed with two 23mm cannons with eight external suspension mounts: four under the fuselage and four under the wings. The A-5C carries a variety of the suspended weapons: 14 Type 90-1 HEAT rockets, two Matra R550 Magic 1 or AIM-9P Sidewinder air-to-air missiles, as well as four 250 kg or four 500 lbs bombs.
